files.shabads/10/5061.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5061,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1369,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58229,"last_verse_id":58230,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58229,"page_no":1369,"line_no":8,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਰੀਐ ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਅੰਤਿ ਕਰੈ ਨਿਰਬਾਹੁ ॥","translit_en":"kabeer sa(n)gat kareeaai saadh kee a(n)t karai nirabaahu ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer, associate with the Holy people, who will take you to Nirvaanaa in the end.","ms":"Kabir, associate thou only with the saint, who shall emancipate thee in the end."},"pu":{"ss":" ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਵਿਚ ਜੁੜਨਾ ਚਾਹੀਦਾ ਹੈ, ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਵਾਲਾ ਸਾਥ ਤੋੜ ਨਿਭਦਾ ਹੈ;"}}},{"verse_id":58230,"page_no":1369,"line_no":8,"gurmukhi":"ਸਾਕਤ ਸੰਗੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੀਐ ਜਾ ਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਬਿਨਾਹੁ ॥੯੩॥","translit_en":"saakat sa(n)g na keejeeaai jaa te hoi binaahu ||93||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Do not associate with the faithless cynics; they would bring you to ruin. ||93||","ms":"Associate thou not with the mammon worshipper, through which, thou shall be ruined."},"pu":{"ss":"ਰੱਬ ਨਾਲੋਂ ਟੁੱਟੇ ਬੰਦਿਆਂ ਦੀ ਸੁਹਬਤਿ ਨਹੀਂ ਕਰਨੀ ਚਾਹੀਦੀ, ਇਸ ਤੋਂ ਆਤਮਕ ਮੌਤ (ਹੋਣ ਦਾ ਡਰ) ਹੈ ।੯੩।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5060,"next":5062}}
files.shabads/10/5062.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5062,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1369,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58231,"last_verse_id":58232,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58231,"page_no":1369,"line_no":9,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਜਾਨਿ ਕੈ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਮਾਇ ॥","translit_en":"kabeer jag meh chetio jaan kai jag meh rahio samai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer, I contemplate the Lord in the world; I know that He is permeating the world.","ms":"Kabir, realising that the Lord is contained in the world, contemplate His I in this world."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਜਗਤ ਵਿਚ ਜਨਮ ਲੈ ਕੇ ਉਸ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ, ਇਉਂ ਪਛਾਣ ਕੇ ਕਿ ਉਹ ਸਾਰੇ ਜਗਤ ਵਿਚ ਵਿਆਪਕ ਹੈ, ਸਿਮਰਿਆ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":58232,"page_no":1369,"line_no":9,"gurmukhi":"ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਬਾਦਹਿ ਜਨਮੇਂ ਆਇ ॥੯੪॥","translit_en":"jin har kaa naam na chetio baadheh janame(n) aai ||94||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Those who do not contemplate the Name of the Lord - their birth into this world is useless. ||94||","ms":"They, who meditate not on the God's Name, have been born in vain in this world."},"pu":{"ss":" ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਦਾ ਨਾਮ ਨਹੀਂ ਸਿਮਰਿਆ, ਉਹ ਵਿਅਰਥ ਹੀ ਜੰਮੇ ।੯੪।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5061,"next":5063}}
files.shabads/10/5063.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5063,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1369,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58233,"last_verse_id":58234,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58233,"page_no":1369,"line_no":10,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰ ਆਸਾ ਕਰੀਐ ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ਅਵਰੈ ਆਸ ਨਿਰਾਸ ॥","translit_en":"kabeer aasaa kareeaai raam kee avarai aas niraas ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer, place your hopes in the Lord; other hopes lead to despair.","ms":"Kabir lean thou on the Lord's hope alone. All other hopes lead to despair."},"pu":{"ss":"ਇਕ ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਉਤੇ ਡੋਰੀ ਰੱਖਣੀ ਚਾਹੀਦੀ ਹੈ, ਹੋਰ ਆਸਾਂ ਛੱਡ ਦੇਣੀਆਂ ਚਾਹੀਦੀਆਂ ਹਨ ।"}}},{"verse_id":58234,"page_no":1369,"line_no":10,"gurmukhi":"ਨਰਕਿ ਪਰਹਿ ਤੇ ਮਾਨਈ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਉਦਾਸ ॥੯੫॥","translit_en":"narak pareh te maaniee jo har naam udhaas ||95||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Those who dissociate themselves from the Lord's Name - when they fall into hell, then they will appreciate its value. ||95||","ms":"They, who forsake the God's Name, shall realise its worth, when they fall into hell."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜੋ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਦੀ ਯਾਦ ਵਲੋਂ ਮੂੰਹ ਮੋੜ ਲੈਂਦੇ ਹਨ ਉਹ ਨਰਕ ਵਿਚ ਪਏ ਰਹਿੰਦੇ ਹਨ (ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੀ ਰਹਿੰਦੇ ਹਨ) ।੯੫।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5062,"next":5064}}
files.shabads/10/5064.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5064,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1369,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58235,"last_verse_id":58236,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58235,"page_no":1369,"line_no":11,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰ ਸਿਖ ਸਾਖਾ ਬਹੁਤੇ ਕੀਏ ਕੇਸੋ ਕੀਓ ਨ ਮੀਤੁ ॥","translit_en":"kabeer sikh saakhaa bahute ke'ee keso keeo na meet ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer has made many students and disciples, but he has not made God his friend.","ms":"Kabir has made many disciples and followers, however, he has not made God his friend."},"pu":{"ss":" ਹੇ ਕਬੀਰ!ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਨੂੰ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਹ ਬਣਾਇਆ (ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਨਾਲ ਸਾਂਝ ਨਾਹ ਬਣਾਈ, ਤੇ) ਕਈ ਚੇਲੇ-ਚਾਟੜੇ ਬਣਾ ਲਏ,"}}},{"verse_id":58236,"page_no":1369,"line_no":11,"gurmukhi":"ਚਾਲੇ ਥੇ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਨ ਕਉ ਬੀਚੈ ਅਟਕਿਓ ਚੀਤੁ ॥੯੬॥","translit_en":"chaale the har milan kau beechai aTakio cheet ||96||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He set out on a journey to meet the Lord, but his consciousness failed him half-way. ||96||","ms":"He had set out to meet his God, however, his mind failed him halfway."},"pu":{"ss":"ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਨੂੰ ਮਿਲਣ ਲਈ ਉੱਦਮ ਕੀਤਾ ਸੀ, ਪਰ ਉਹਨਾਂ ਦਾ ਮਨ ਰਾਹ ਵਿਚ ਹੀ ਅਟਕ ਗਿਆ ।੯੬।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5063,"next":5065}}
files.shabads/10/5065.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5065,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1369,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58237,"last_verse_id":58238,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58237,"page_no":1369,"line_no":12,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰ ਕਾਰਨੁ ਬਪੁਰਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੈ ਜਉ ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਕਰੈ ਸਹਾਇ ॥","translit_en":"kabeer kaaran bapuraa kiaa karai jau raam na karai sahai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer, what can the poor creature do, if the Lord does not give him assistance?","ms":"Kabir, what can the poor creature do, it the Lord assists him not?"},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਕਬੀਰ! ਜੇ ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਆਪ ਸਹੈਤਾ ਨਾਹ ਕਰੇ ,ਤਾਂ ਇਹ ਵਸੀਲਾ ਕਮਜ਼ੋਰ ਹੋ ਜਾਣ ਦੇ ਕਾਰਨ ਕੋਈ ਲਾਭ ਨਹੀਂ ਪੁਚਾਂਦਾ । "}}},{"verse_id":58238,"page_no":1369,"line_no":13,"gurmukhi":"ਜਿਹ ਜਿਹ ਡਾਲੀ ਪਗੁ ਧਰਉ ਸੋਈ ਮੁਰਿ ਮੁਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੯੭॥","translit_en":"jeh jeh ddaalee pag dharau soiee mur mur jai ||97||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Whatever branch he steps on breaks and collapses. ||97||","ms":"On whatever branch he places his foot, that one cracks, and breaks down."},"pu":{"ss":"ਮੈਂ ਤਾਂ (ਅਜੇਹੀ) ਜਿਸ ਜਿਸ ਡਾਲੀ ਉੱਤੇ ਪੈਰ ਧਰਦਾ ਹਾਂ ਉਹ (ਸੁਆਰਥ ਵਿਚ ਕਮਜ਼ੋਰ ਹੋਣ ਕਰਕੇ) ਟੁੱਟਦੀ ਜਾ ਰਹੀ ਹੈ ।੯੭।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5064,"next":5066}}
files.shabads/10/5066.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5066,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1369,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58239,"last_verse_id":58240,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58239,"page_no":1369,"line_no":13,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰ ਅਵਰਹ ਕਉ ਉਪਦੇਸਤੇ ਮੁਖ ਮੈ ਪਰਿ ਹੈ ਰੇਤੁ ॥","translit_en":"kabeer avareh kau upadhesate mukh mai par hai ret ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer, those who only preach to others - sand falls into their mouths.","ms":"Kabir falls into the mouth of those, who practise not what they preach to others."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਕਬੀਰ! ਜੋ (‘ਸਾਧ’ ਨਿਰਾ) ਹੋਰਨਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਮੱਤਾਂ ਦੇਂਦੇ ਹਨ, ਪਰ ਉਹਨਾਂ ਦੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਅੰਦਰ ਕੋਈ ਰਸ ਨਹੀਂ ਆਉਂਦਾ । "}}},{"verse_id":58240,"page_no":1369,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਰਾਸਿ ਬਿਰਾਨੀ ਰਾਖਤੇ ਖਾਯਾ ਘਰ ਕਾ ਖੇਤੁ ॥੯੮॥","translit_en":"raas biraanee raakhate khaayaa ghar kaa khet ||98||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"They keep their eyes on the property of others, while their own farm is being eaten up. ||98||","ms":"They keep an eye on other's property, however, their own farm is being eaten up."},"pu":{"ss":"ਅਜੇਹੇ (‘ਸਾਧ’) ਹੋਰਨਾਂ ਦੀ ਰਾਸ-ਪੂੰਜੀ ਦੀ ਤਾਂ ਰਾਖੀ ਕਰਨ ਦਾ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਦੇ ਹਨ, ਪਰ ਆਪਣੇ ਪਿਛਲੇ ਸਾਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਮੁਕਾ ਲੈਂਦੇ ਹਨ ।੯੮।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5065,"next":5067}}
files.shabads/10/5067.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5067,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1369,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58241,"last_verse_id":58242,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58241,"page_no":1369,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰ ਸਾਧੂ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਰਹਉ ਜਉ ਕੀ ਭੂਸੀ ਖਾਉ ॥","translit_en":"kabeer saadhoo kee sa(n)gat rahau jau kee bhoosee khaau ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer, I will remain in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, even if I have only coarse bread to eat.","ms":"Kabir, I will associate only with the saints, even if I may have to eat barley bread."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਕਬੀਰ! ਮੈਂ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾਂ ਦੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਵਿਚ ਟਿਕਿਆ ਰਹਾਂ ,ਤੇ ਮੈਂ ਜੌਂ ਦੇ ਛਿੱਲੜ ਖਾ ਕੇ ਗੁਜ਼ਾਰਾ ਕਰਾਂ । "}}},{"verse_id":58242,"page_no":1369,"line_no":15,"gurmukhi":"ਹੋਨਹਾਰੁ ਸੋ ਹੋਇਹੈ ਸਾਕਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਜਾਉ ॥੯੯॥","translit_en":"honahaar so hoihai saakat sa(n)g na jaau ||99||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Whatever will be, will be. I will not associate with the faithless cynics. ||99||","ms":"What is to be, let it happen. I shall associate not with the mammon worshippers."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜੇਹੜਾ ਕਸ਼ਟ ਭੀ ਆਵੇ ਪਿਆ ਆਵੇ । ਪਰ ਮੈਂ ਰੱਬ ਤੋਂ ਟੁੱਟੇ ਹੋਏ ਬੰਦਿਆਂ ਦੀ ਸੁਹਬਤਿ ਵਿਚ ਨਾਹ ਜਾਵਾਂ ।੯੯।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5066,"next":5068}}
files.shabads/10/5068.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5068,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1369,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58243,"last_verse_id":58244,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58243,"page_no":1369,"line_no":15,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਦਿਨ ਦਿਨ ਦੂਨਾ ਹੇਤੁ ॥","translit_en":"kabeer sa(n)gat saadh kee dhin dhin dhoonaa het ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer, in the Saadh Sangat, love for the Lord doubles day by day.","ms":"Kabir, associating with the saints, the Lord's love doubles day-by-day."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਕਬੀਰ! ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾਂ ਦੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਵਿਚ ਰਿਹਾਂ ਦਿਨੋ ਦਿਨ ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਨਾਲ ਪਿਆਰ ਵਧਦਾ ਹੀ ਵਧਦਾ ਹੈ । "}}},{"verse_id":58244,"page_no":1369,"line_no":15,"gurmukhi":"ਸਾਕਤ ਕਾਰੀ ਕਾਂਬਰੀ ਧੋਏ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਸੇਤੁ ॥੧੦੦॥","translit_en":"saakat kaaree kaa(n)baree dhoe hoi na set ||100||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The faithless cynic is like a black blanket, which does not become white by being washed. ||100||","ms":"The infidel is like the black blanket that becomes not white by washing."},"pu":{"ss":"ਪਰ ਰੱਬ ਨਾਲੋਂ ਟੁੱਟਾ ਹੋਇਆ ਮਨੁੱਖ, ਮਾਨੋ, ਕਾਲੀ ਕੰਬਲੀ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਧੋਤਿਆਂ ਭੀ ਕਦੇ ਚਿੱਟੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੁੰਦੀ । ਉਸ ਦੀ ਸੁਹਬਤਿ ਵਿਚ ਟਿਕਿਆਂ ਮਨ ਦੀ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰਤਾ ਨਹੀਂ ਮਿਲ ਸਕਦੀ ।੧੦੦।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5067,"next":5069}}
files.shabads/10/5069.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5069,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1369,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58245,"last_verse_id":58246,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58245,"page_no":1369,"line_no":16,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰ ਮਨੁ ਮੂੰਡਿਆ ਨਹੀ ਕੇਸ ਮੁੰਡਾਏ ਕਾਂਇ ॥","translit_en":"kabeer man moo(n)ddiaa nahee kes mu(n)ddaae kaa(n)i ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer, you have not shaved your mind, so why do you shave your head?","ms":"Kabir, thou have shaved not thy mind, why shave thou thy hair."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਕਬੀਰ! ਆਪਣਾ ਮਨ ਨਹੀਂ ਮੁੰਨਿਆ ,ਸਿਰ ਦੇ ਕੇਸ ਮੁਨਾਇਆਂ ਤਾਂ ਇਹ ‘ਸਾਧੂ’ ਨਹੀਂ ਬਣ ਗਿਆ ।"}}},{"verse_id":58246,"page_no":1369,"line_no":16,"gurmukhi":"ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਆ ਸੋ ਮਨ ਕੀਆ ਮੂੰਡਾ ਮੂੰਡੁ ਅਜਾਂਇ ॥੧੦੧॥","translit_en":"jo kichh keeaa so man keeaa moo(n)ddaa moo(n)dd ajaa(n)i ||101||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Whatever is done, is done by the mind; it is useless to shave your head. ||101||","ms":"Whatever is done that is done by the mind, so vain is thy shaving the head."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਿਸ ਭੀ ਮੰਦੇ ਕਰਮ ਦੀ ਪ੍ਰੇਰਨਾ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ (ਜੇ ‘ਸਾਧੂ’ ਬਣਨ ਦੀ ਖ਼ਾਤਰ ਹੀ ਸਿਰ ਮੁਨਾਇਆ ਹੈ ਤਾਂ) ਸਿਰ ਮੁਨਾਉਣਾ ਵਿਅਰਥ ਹੈ ।੧੦੧।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5068,"next":5070}}
files.shabads/10/5070.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5070,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1369,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58247,"last_verse_id":58248,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58247,"page_no":1369,"line_no":17,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰ ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਛੋਡੀਐ ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਜਾਇ ਤ ਜਾਉ ॥","translit_en":"kabeer raam na chhoddeeaai tan dhan jai ta jaau ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer, do not abandon the Lord; your body and wealth shall go, so let them go.","ms":"Kabir, leave thou not thy Lord, however, if the body or wealth go, let those go."},"pu":{"ss":" ਹੇ ਕਬੀਰ! ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਦਾ ਨਾਮ ਕਦੇ ਨਾਹ ਭੁਲਾਈਏ, ਸਰੀਰ ਤੇ ਧਨ ਨਾਸ ਹੋਣ ਲੱਗੇ ਤਾਂ ਬੇਸ਼ੱਕ ਨਾਸ ਹੋ ਜਾਏ । "}}},{"verse_id":58248,"page_no":1369,"line_no":17,"gurmukhi":"ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਚਿਤੁ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਰਾਮਹਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਉ ॥੧੦੨॥","translit_en":"charan kamal chit bedhiaa raameh naam samaau ||102||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"My consciousness is pierced by the Lord's Lotus Feet; I am absorbed in the Name of the Lord. ||102||","ms":"My mind is pierced through with the Lord's lotus feet and I am absorbed in His Name."},"pu":{"ss":"ਪਰ ਅਸਾਡਾ ਚਿੱਤ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦੇ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਚਰਨਾਂ ਵਿਚ ਜ਼ਰੂਰ ਵਿੱਝਿਆ ਰਹੇ, ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਦੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਚ ਜ਼ਰੂਰ ਸਮਾਇਆ ਰਹੇ ।੧੦੨।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5069,"next":5071}}
files.shabads/10/5071.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5071,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1369,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58249,"last_verse_id":58250,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58249,"page_no":1369,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰ ਜੋ ਹਮ ਜੰਤੁ ਬਜਾਵਤੇ ਟੂਟਿ ਗਈਂ ਸਭ ਤਾਰ ॥","translit_en":"kabeer jo ham ja(n)t bajaavate TooT giee(n) sabh taar ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer, all the strings of the instrument I played are broken.","ms":"Kabir, all the strings of the instrument, which I played upon, are broken."},"pu":{"ss":" ਹੇ ਕਬੀਰ! ਸਰੀਰਕ ਮੋਹ ਦਾ ਜੇਹੜਾ ਵਾਜਾ ਮੈਂ ਸਦਾ ਵਜਾਂਦਾ ਰਹਿੰਦਾ ਸਾਂ ,ਉਸ ਦੀਆਂ (ਮੋਹ ਦੀਆਂ) ਸਾਰੀਆਂ ਤਾਰਾਂ ਟੁੱਟ ਗਈਆਂ ਹਨ ।"}}},{"verse_id":58250,"page_no":1369,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਜੰਤੁ ਬਿਚਾਰਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੈ ਚਲੇ ਬਜਾਵਨਹਾਰ ॥੧੦੩॥","translit_en":"ja(n)t bichaaraa kiaa karai chale bajaavanahaar ||103||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"What can the poor instrument do, when the player has departed as well. ||103||","ms":"What can the poor instrument do, when the player has departed?"},"pu":{"ss":"ਵਿਚਾਰਾ ਵਾਜਾ (ਹੁਣ) ਕੀਹ ਕਰ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ?ਭਾਵ, ਨਾਮ ਦੀ ਬਰਕਤਿ ਨਾਲ ਸਰੀਰਕ ਮੋਹ ਮਾਤ ਪੈ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ ।ਉਹ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਰਿਹਾ ਜੋ ਸਰੀਰਕ ਮੋਹ ਦਾ ਵਾਜਾ ਵਜਾ ਰਿਹਾ ਸੀ ।੧੦੩।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5070,"next":5072}}
files.shabads/10/5072.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5072,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1369,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58251,"last_verse_id":58252,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58251,"page_no":1369,"line_no":19,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰ ਮਾਇ ਮੂੰਡਉ ਤਿਹ ਗੁਰੂ ਕੀ ਜਾ ਤੇ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥","translit_en":"kabeer mai moo(n)ddau teh guroo kee jaa te bharam na jai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer, shave the mother of that guru, who does not take away one's doubt.","ms":"Kabir, shave thou the mother of that Guru, through whom doubt departs not."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਕਬੀਰ! ਮੈਂ ਅਜੇਹੇ ਗੁਰੂ ਦੀ ਮਾਂ ਦਾ ਸਿਰ ਮੁੰਨ ਦਿਆਂ, ਇਸ ਦੇ ਰਾਹ ਤੇ ਤੁਰਿਆਂ (ਸਰੀਰਕ ਮੋਹ ਦੀ) ਭਟਕਣਾ ਦੂਰ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੋ ਸਕਦੀ ।"}}},{"verse_id":58252,"page_no":1370,"line_no":1,"gurmukhi":"ਆਪ ਡੁਬੇ ਚਹੁ ਬੇਦ ਮਹਿ ਚੇਲੇ ਦੀਏ ਬਹਾਇ ॥੧੦੪॥","translit_en":"aap ddube chahu bedh meh chele dhe'ee bahai ||104||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He himself is drowning in the four Vedas; he drowns his disciples as well. ||104||","ms":"He himself is drowned in the four Vedas and drowns his disciples as well."},"pu":{"ss":"ਇਹ ਲੋਕ ਆਪ ਭੀ ਚਹੁੰਆਂ ਵੇਦਾਂ ਵਿਚ ਪੈ ਕੇ ਡੁੱਬੇ ਹੋਏ ਹਨ, ਜੋ ਜੋ ਬੰਦੇ ਇਹਨਾਂ ਦੇ ਪਿੱਛੇ ਲੱਗਦੇ ਹਨ ਉਹਨਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਭੀ ਇਹਨਾਂ ਉਸੇ ਮੋਹ ਵਿਚ ਰੋੜ੍ਹ ਦਿੱਤਾ ਹੈ ।੧੦੪।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5071,"next":5073}}
files.shabads/10/5073.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5073,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1370,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58253,"last_verse_id":58254,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58253,"page_no":1370,"line_no":1,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰ ਜੇਤੇ ਪਾਪ ਕੀਏ ਰਾਖੇ ਤਲੈ ਦੁਰਾਇ ॥","translit_en":"kabeer jete paap ke'ee raakhe talai dhurai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer, whatever sins the mortal has committed, he tries to keep hidden under cover.","ms":"Kabir, whatever sins the mortal commits, he tries to keep them hidden under s cover."},"pu":{"ss":" ਹੇ ਕਬੀਰ! ਜੋ ਜੋ ਪਾਪ ਕੀਤੇ ਜਾਂਦੇ ਹਨ (ਭਾਵੇਂ ਉਹ ਪਾਪ) ਆਪਣੇ ਅੰਦਰ ਲੁਕਾ ਕੇ ਰੱਖੇ ਜਾਂਦੇ ਹਨ, "}}},{"verse_id":58254,"page_no":1370,"line_no":1,"gurmukhi":"ਪਰਗਟ ਭਏ ਨਿਦਾਨ ਸਭ ਜਬ ਪੂਛੇ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ॥੧੦੫॥","translit_en":"paragaT bhe nidhaan sabh jab poochhe dharam rai ||105||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"But in the end, they shall all be revealed, when the Righteous Judge of Dharma investigates. ||105||","ms":"At last they are all disclosed, when the Lord-Justiciar holds and inquiry."},"pu":{"ss":"ਫਿਰ ਭੀ ਜਦੋਂ ਧਰਮਰਾਜ ਪੁੱਛਦਾ ਹੈ ਉਹ ਪਾਪ ਆਖ਼ਰ ਸਾਰੇ ਉੱਘੜ ਆਉਂਦੇ ਹਨ ।੧੦੫।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5072,"next":5074}}
files.shabads/10/5074.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5074,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1370,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58255,"last_verse_id":58256,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58255,"page_no":1370,"line_no":2,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਛਾਡਿ ਕੈ ਪਾਲਿਓ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ॥","translit_en":"kabeer har kaa simaran chhaadd kai paalio bahut kuTa(n)b ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer, you have given up meditating on the Lord, and you have raised a large family.","ms":"Kabir, abandoning the Lord's meditation, thou have reared a large family."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਕਬੀਰ! ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਦਾ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਛੱਡਣ ਦਾ ਹੀ ਇਹ ਨਤੀਜਾ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਸਾਰੀ ਉਮਰ ਨਿਰਾ ਟੱਬਰ ਹੀ ਪਾਲਦਾ ਰਹਿੰਦਾ ਹੈ, "}}},{"verse_id":58256,"page_no":1370,"line_no":3,"gurmukhi":"ਧੰਧਾ ਕਰਤਾ ਰਹਿ ਗਇਆ ਭਾਈ ਰਹਿਆ ਨ ਬੰਧੁ ॥੧੦੬॥","translit_en":"dha(n)dhaa karataa reh giaa bhaiee rahiaa na ba(n)dh ||106||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"You continue to involve yourself in worldly affairs, but none of your brothers and relatives remain. ||106||","ms":"Thou continue to do worldly affairs, though none of thine brothers and kinsmen had remained stable."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਗਤ ਦੇ ਧੰੰਧੇ ਕਰਦਾ ਆਖ਼ਰ ਆਤਮਕ ਮੌਤੇ ਮਰ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ ,ਕੋਈ ਰਿਸ਼ਤੇਦਾਰ ਬਚਾਣ-ਜੋਗਾ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੁੰਦਾ ।੧੦੬।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5073,"next":5075}}
files.shabads/10/5075.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5075,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1370,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58257,"last_verse_id":58258,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58257,"page_no":1370,"line_no":3,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਛਾਡਿ ਕੈ ਰਾਤਿ ਜਗਾਵਨ ਜਾਇ ॥","translit_en":"kabeer har kaa simaran chhaadd kai raat jagaavan jai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer, those who give up meditation on the Lord, and get up at night to wake the spirits of the dead,","ms":"Kabir, abandoning the God's meditation, the woman, who wakes at night and goes to the cremation ground to practise witch craft;"},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਕਬੀਰ! ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਦੇ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਤੋਂ ਵਾਂਜੀ ਰਹਿਣ ਕਰਕੇ ਹੀ, ਰਾਤ ਨੂੰ ਮਸਾਣ ਜਗਾਣ ਲਈ (ਮਸਾਣ-ਭੂਮੀ ਵਿਚ) ਜਾਂਦੀ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":58258,"page_no":1370,"line_no":4,"gurmukhi":"ਸਰਪਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਅਉਤਰੈ ਜਾਏ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਖਾਇ ॥੧੦੭॥","translit_en":"sarapan hoi kai aautarai jaae apune khai ||107||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"shall be reincarnated as snakes, and eat their own offspring. ||107||","ms":"She is born as a serpent and eats her own offspring."},"pu":{"ss":"ਸੱਪਣੀ ਬਣ ਕੇ ਜੰਮਦੀ ਹੈ, ਤੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਹੀ ਬੱਚੇ ਖਾਂਦੀ ਹੈ ।੧੦੭।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5074,"next":5076}}
files.shabads/10/5076.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5076,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1370,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58259,"last_verse_id":58260,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58259,"page_no":1370,"line_no":4,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਛਾਡਿ ਕੈ ਅਹੋਈ ਰਾਖੈ ਨਾਰਿ ॥","translit_en":"kabeer har kaa simaran chhaadd kai ahoiee raakhai naar ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer, the woman who gives up meditation on the Lord, and observes the ritual fast of Ahoi,","ms":"Kabir, abandoning the Lord's meditation, if a woman observes the fast of the smallpox-Goddess,"},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਕਬੀਰ!ਰਾਮ-ਨਾਮ ਛੱਡਣ ਦਾ ਹੀ ਇਹ ਨਤੀਜਾ ਹੈ ਕਿ (ਮੂਰਖ) ਇਸਤ੍ਰੀ ਸੀਤਲਾ ਦੀ ਵਰਤ ਰੱਖਦੀ ਫਿਰਦੀ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":58260,"page_no":1370,"line_no":5,"gurmukhi":"ਗਦਹੀ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਅਉਤਰੈ ਭਾਰੁ ਸਹੈ ਮਨ ਚਾਰਿ ॥੧੦੮॥","translit_en":"gadhahee hoi kai aautarai bhaar sahai man chaar ||108||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"shall be reincarnated as a donkey, to carry heavy burdens. ||108||","ms":"she is then reborn as a she-donkey and carries a load of four maunds."},"pu":{"ss":"ਉਹ ਮੂਰਖ ਇਸਤ੍ਰੀ ਖੋਤੀ ਦੀ ਜੂਨੇ ਪੈਂਦੀ ਹੈ ਤੇ (ਹੋਰ ਖੋਤੇ ਖੋਤੀਆਂ ਵਾਂਗ ਛੱਟਾ ਆਦਿਕ ਦਾ) ਚਾਰ ਮਣ ਭਾਰ ਢੋਂਦੀ ਹੈ ।੧੦੮।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5075,"next":5077}}
files.shabads/10/5077.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5077,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1370,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58261,"last_verse_id":58262,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58261,"page_no":1370,"line_no":5,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਅਤਿ ਘਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਮਾਹਿ ॥","translit_en":"kabeer chaturaiee at ghanee har jap hiradhai maeh ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer, it is the most clever wisdom, to chant and meditate on the Lord in the heart.","ms":"Kabir, exceedingly great wisdom is in this, that man should remember God in his mind."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਕਬੀਰ!ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਡੀ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਇਹੀ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਦਾ ਨਾਮ ਹਿਰਦੇ ਵਿਚ ਹੀ ਯਾਦ ਕਰ । (ਪਰ) ਇਹ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਕਰਨਾ ਕੋਈ ਸੌਖੀ ਕਾਰ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ; "}}},{"verse_id":58262,"page_no":1370,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਸੂਰੀ ਊਪਰਿ ਖੇਲਨਾ ਗਿਰੈ ਤ ਠਾਹਰ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੧੦੯॥","translit_en":"sooree uoopar khelanaa girai ta Thaahar naeh ||109||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"It is like playing on a pig; if you fall off, you will find no place of rest. ||109||","ms":"The Lord's meditation is like playing on the noose and if man falls from it, then finds he no place of rest."},"pu":{"ss":"ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦਾ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਸੂਲੀ ਉਤੇ ਚੜ੍ਹਨ ਸਮਾਨ ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਸੂਲੀ ਤੋਂ ਡਿਗਿਆਂ ਹੋਰ ਕੋਈ ਆਸਰਾ ਭੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ ।੧੦੯।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5076,"next":5078}}
files.shabads/10/5078.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5078,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1370,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58263,"last_verse_id":58264,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58263,"page_no":1370,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰ ਸੋੁਈ ਮੁਖੁ ਧੰਨਿ ਹੈ ਜਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਕਹੀਐ ਰਾਮੁ ॥","translit_en":"kabeer suoiee mukh dha(n)n hai jaa mukh kaheeaai raam ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer, blessed is that mouth, which utters the Lord's Name.","ms":"Kabir, blessed is the mouth, with which mouth the Lord's Name is recited."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਕਬੀਰ! ਉਹੀ ਮੂੰਹ ਭਾਗਾਂ ਵਾਲਾ ਹੈ ਜਿਸ ਮੂੰਹ ਨਾਲ ਰਾਮ ਦਾ ਨਾਮ ਉਚਾਰਿਆ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ । "}}},{"verse_id":58264,"page_no":1370,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਦੇਹੀ ਕਿਸ ਕੀ ਬਾਪੁਰੀ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਹੋਇਗੋ ਗ੍ਰਾਮੁ ॥੧੧੦॥","translit_en":"dhehee kis kee baapuree pavitr hoigo graam ||110||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"It purifies the body, and the whole village as well. ||110||","ms":"What to say of the poor body of that creature, even his village shall be purified."},"pu":{"ss":"ਉਸ ਸਰੀਰ ਵਿਚਾਰੇ ਦੀ ਕੀਹ ਗੱਲ ਹੈ? ਉਹ ਸਾਰਾ ਪਿੰਡ ਹੀ ਪਵਿੱਤ੍ਰ ਹੋ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ । ਜਿਥੇ ਰਹਿੰਦਾ ਹੋਇਆ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਮਰਦਾ ਹੈ ।੧੧੦।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5077,"next":5079}}
files.shabads/10/5079.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5079,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1370,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58265,"last_verse_id":58266,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58265,"page_no":1370,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰ ਸੋਈ ਕੁਲ ਭਲੀ ਜਾ ਕੁਲ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਦਾਸੁ ॥","translit_en":"kabeer soiee kul bhalee jaa kul har ko dhaas ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer, that family is good, in which the Lord's slave is born.","ms":"Kabir, blessed is the family, is which family God's slave is born."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਕਬੀਰ! ਜਿਸ ਕੁਲ ਵਿਚ ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਦਾ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲਾ ਭਗਤ ਪਰਗਟ ਹੋ ਪਏ, ਉਹੀ ਕੁਲ ਸੁਲੱਖਣੀ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":58266,"page_no":1370,"line_no":8,"gurmukhi":"ਜਿਹ ਕੁਲ ਦਾਸੁ ਨ ਊਪਜੈ ਸੋ ਕੁਲ ਢਾਕੁ ਪਲਾਸੁ ॥੧੧੧॥","translit_en":"jeh kul dhaas na uoopajai so kul ddaak palaas ||111||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"But that family in which the Lord's slave is not born is as useless as weeds. ||111||","ms":"The family, is which the Lord's slave is born not; that family is useless like the buteafrondosa."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਿਸ ਕੁਲ ਵਿਚ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦੀ ਭਗਤੀ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲਾ ਬੰਦਾ ਨਹੀਂ ਪਰਗਟਦਾ, ਉਹ ਕੁਲ ਢਾਕ ਪਲਾਹ ।੧੧੧।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5078,"next":5080}}
files.shabads/10/5080.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5080,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1370,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58267,"last_verse_id":58268,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58267,"page_no":1370,"line_no":8,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰ ਹੈ ਗਇ ਬਾਹਨ ਸਘਨ ਘਨ ਲਾਖ ਧਜਾ ਫਹਰਾਹਿ ॥","translit_en":"kabeer hai gi baahan saghan ghan laakh dhajaa faharaeh ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer, some have lots of horses, elephants and carriages, and thousands of banners waving.","ms":"Kabir, the possession of very great number of horses, elephants and carriages and the waving of lacs of banners;"},"pu":{"ss":" ਹੇ ਕਬੀਰ! ਜੇ ਸਵਾਰੀ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਘੋੜੇ ਤੇ ਹਾਥੀ ਹੋਣ,"}}},{"verse_id":58268,"page_no":1370,"line_no":9,"gurmukhi":"ਇਆ ਸੁਖ ਤੇ ਭਿਖੵਾ ਭਲੀ ਜਉ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਦਿਨ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੧੧੨॥","translit_en":"eiaa sukh te bhikhayeaa bhalee jau har simarat dhin jaeh ||112||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"But begging is better than these comforts, if one spends his days meditating in remembrance on the Lord. ||112||","ms":"Begging is better than these comforts, if the days pass in contemplating the Lord."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜੇ ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਦਾ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਕਰਦਿਆਂ (ਜ਼ਿੰਦਗੀ ਦੇ) ਦਿਨ ਗੁਜ਼ਰਨ ਤਾਂ ਉਸ  ਸੁਖ ਨਾਲੋਂ ਉਹ ਟੁੱਕਰ ਚੰਗਾ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਲੋਕਾਂ ਦੇ ਦਰ ਤੋਂ ਮੰਗ ਕੇ ਮੰਗਤੇ ਫ਼ਕੀਰ ਖਾਂਦੇ ਹਨ ।੧੧੨।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5079,"next":5081}}
files.shabads/10/5081.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5081,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1370,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58269,"last_verse_id":58270,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58269,"page_no":1370,"line_no":9,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਹਉ ਫਿਰਿਓ ਮਾਂਦਲੁ ਕੰਧ ਚਢਾਇ ॥","translit_en":"kabeer sabh jag hau firio maa(n)dhal ka(n)dh chaddai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer, I have wandered all over the world, carrying the drum on my shoulder.","ms":"Kabir, carrying the drum on my shoulder, I have traversed the whole world."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਕਬੀਰ! ਢੋਲ ਮੋਢਿਆਂ ਤੇ ਰੱਖ ਕੇ ਮੈਂ (ਵਜਾਂਦਾ ਫਿਰਿਆ ਹਾਂ ਤੇ) ਸਾਰਾ ਜਗਤ ਗਾਹਿਆ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":58270,"page_no":1370,"line_no":10,"gurmukhi":"ਕੋਈ ਕਾਹੂ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਸਭ ਦੇਖੀ ਠੋਕਿ ਬਜਾਇ ॥੧੧੩॥","translit_en":"koiee kaahoo ko nahee sabh dhekhee Thok bajai ||113||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"No one belongs to anyone else; I have looked and carefully studied it. ||113||","ms":"No one is the friend of any one else, I have seen and carefully examined all."},"pu":{"ss":"ਸਾਰੀ ਸ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਟੀ ਮੈਂ ਚੰਗੀ ਤਰ੍ਹਾਂ ਪਰਖ ਕੇ ਵੇਖ ਲਈ ਹੈ ਕੋਈ ਭੀ ਕਿਸੇ ਦਾ (ਤੋੜ ਨਿਭਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਸਾਥੀ) ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ ।੧੧੩।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5080,"next":5082}}
files.shabads/10/5082.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5082,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1370,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58271,"last_verse_id":58272,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58271,"page_no":1370,"line_no":10,"gurmukhi":"ਮਾਰਗਿ ਮੋਤੀ ਬੀਥਰੇ ਅੰਧਾ ਨਿਕਸਿਓ ਆਇ ॥","translit_en":"maarag motee beethare a(n)dhaa nikasio aai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The pearls are scattered on the road; the blind man comes along.","ms":"Kabir, the pearls are scattered on the road and a blind man comes that way."},"pu":{"ss":"ਮੋਤੀ ਰਸਤੇ ਵਿਚ ਖਿੱਲਰੇ ਹੋਏ ਹਨ,ਅੰਨ੍ਹਾ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਆ ਅੱਪੜਿਆ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":58272,"page_no":1370,"line_no":11,"gurmukhi":"ਜੋਤਿ ਬਿਨਾ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਕੀ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਲੰਘੇ ਜਾਇ ॥੧੧੪॥","translit_en":"jot binaa jagadhees kee jagat ula(n)ghe jai ||114||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Without the Light of the Lord of the Universe, the world just passes them by. ||114||","ms":"Without the Light of the Lord of the universe, the mortal passes the pearls by."},"pu":{"ss":"ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਦੀ ਬਖ਼ਸ਼ੀ ਹੋਈ (ਗਿਆਨ ਦੀ) ਜੋਤਿ ਤੋਂ ਬਿਨਾਂ ਜਗਤ ਇਹਨਾਂ ਮੋਤੀਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਪੈਰਾਂ ਹੇਠ ਲਤਾੜਦਾ ਤੁਰਿਆ ਜਾ ਰਿਹਾ ਹੈ ।੧੧੪।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5081,"next":5083}}
files.shabads/10/5083.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5083,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1370,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58273,"last_verse_id":58274,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58273,"page_no":1370,"line_no":11,"gurmukhi":"ਬੂਡਾ ਬੰਸੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਕਾ ਉਪਜਿਓ ਪੂਤੁ ਕਮਾਲੁ ॥","translit_en":"booddaa ba(n)s kabeer kaa upajio poot kamaal ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"My family is drowned, O Kabeer, since the birth of my son Kamaal.","ms":"Kabir, drowned is my family, when my son Kamal was born."},"pu":{"ss":"ਕਬੀਰ ਦਾ ਸਾਰਾ ਹੀ ਟੱਬਰ (ਅੱਖਾਂ, ਕੰਨ, ਨੱਕ ਆਦਿਕ ਸਾਰੇ ਹੀ ਇੰਦ੍ਰਿਆਂ ਦਾ ਟੋਲਾ ਵਿਕਾਰਾਂ ਵਿਚ ਜ਼ਰੂਰ) ਡੁੱਬ ਗਿਆ ਜਾਣੋ ।"}}},{"verse_id":58274,"page_no":1370,"line_no":12,"gurmukhi":"ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਛਾਡਿ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਲੇ ਆਯਾ ਮਾਲੁ ॥੧੧੫॥","translit_en":"har kaa simaran chhaadd kai ghar le aayaa maal ||115||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He has given up meditating on the Lord, in order to bring home wealth. ||115||","ms":"Forsaking the God's meditation, he has brought home wealth."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਮੂਰਖ ਮਨ ਅਜੇਹੀ (ਨੀਵੀਂ) ਅਵਸਥਾ ਤੇ ਆ ਅੱਪੜਿਆ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਦਾ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਛੱਡ ਕੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਅੰਦਰ ਮਾਇਆ ਦਾ ਮੋਹ ਵਸਾ ਰਿਹਾ ਹੈ ।੧੧੫।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5082,"next":5084}}
files.shabads/10/5084.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5084,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1370,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58275,"last_verse_id":58276,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58275,"page_no":1370,"line_no":12,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰ ਸਾਧੂ ਕਉ ਮਿਲਨੇ ਜਾਈਐ ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਲੀਜੈ ਕੋਇ ॥","translit_en":"kabeer saadhoo kau milane jaieeaai saath na leejai koi ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer, go out to meet the holy man; do not take anyone else with you.","ms":"Kabir, when thou go to meet the saint, take not another with thee,"},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਕਬੀਰ! ਜੇ ਕਿਸੇ ਸਾਧੂ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇ ਦਰਸ਼ਨ ਕਰਨ ਜਾਈਏ, ਤਾਂ ਕਿਸੇ ਨੂੰ ਆਪਣੇ ਨਾਲ ਨਹੀਂ ਲੈ ਜਾਣਾ ਚਾਹੀਦਾ ।"}}},{"verse_id":58276,"page_no":1370,"line_no":13,"gurmukhi":"ਪਾਛੈ ਪਾਉ ਨ ਦੀਜੀਐ ਆਗੈ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧੧੬॥","translit_en":"paachhai paau na dheejeeaai aagai hoi su hoi ||116||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Do not turn back - keep on going. Whatever will be, will be. ||116||","ms":"then turn thou not thy foot backward and march on ahead., and whatever else happens, let that happen."},"pu":{"ss":" ਕਿਸੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦਾ ਦੀਦਾਰ ਕਰਨ ਗਿਆਂ ਕਦੇ ਪੈਰ ਪਿਛਾਂਹ ਨਾਹ ਰੱਖੀਏ, ਸਗੋਂ ਉਧਰ ਜਾਂਦਿਆਂ ਜੇ ਕੋਈ ਔਖਿਆਈ ਭੀ ਆਵੇ ਤਾਂ ਪਈ ਆਵੇ ।੧੧੬।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5083,"next":5085}}
files.shabads/10/5085.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5085,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1370,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58277,"last_verse_id":58278,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58277,"page_no":1370,"line_no":13,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰ ਜਗੁ ਬਾਧਿਓ ਜਿਹ ਜੇਵਰੀ ਤਿਹ ਮਤ ਬੰਧਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ॥","translit_en":"kabeer jag baadhio jeh jevaree teh mat ba(n)dhahu kabeer ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer, do not bind yourself with that chain, which binds the whole world.","ms":"Kabir, blind thou not thyself with the chain, with which the world is bound."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਕਬੀਰ! ਮਾਇਆ-ਮੋਹ ਦੀ ਜਿਸ ਰੱਸੀ ਨਾਲ ਜਗਤ (ਦਾ ਹਰੇਕ ਜੀਵ) ਬੱਝਾ ਪਿਆ ਹੈ, ਉਸ ਰੱਸੀ ਨਾਲ ਆਪਣੇ ਆਪ ਨੂੰ ਬੱਝਣ ਨਾ ਦੇਈਂ ।"}}},{"verse_id":58278,"page_no":1370,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਹਹਿ ਆਟਾ ਲੋਨ ਜਿਉ ਸੋਨ ਸਮਾਨਿ ਸਰੀਰੁ ॥੧੧੭॥","translit_en":"jaiheh aaTaa lon jiau son samaan sareer ||117||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As the salt is lost in the flour, so shall your golden body be lost. ||117||","ms":"As the salt is lost in flour, so shall thy gold like body disappear."},"pu":{"ss":"ਇਹ ਸੋਨੇ ਵਰਗਾ (ਕੀਮਤੀ) ਮਨੁੱਖਾ ਸਰੀਰ (ਮਿਲਿਆ) ਹੈ ,ਸਸਤੇ ਭਾ ਅਜਾਈਂ ਤਬਾਹ ਹੋ ਜਾਹਿਂਗਾ ।੧੧੭।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5084,"next":5086}}
files.shabads/10/5086.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5086,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1370,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58279,"last_verse_id":58280,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58279,"page_no":1370,"line_no":15,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰ ਹੰਸੁ ਉਡਿਓ ਤਨੁ ਗਾਡਿਓ ਸੋਝਾਈ ਸੈਨਾਹ ॥","translit_en":"kabeer ha(n)s uddio tan gaaddio sojhaiee sainaeh ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer, the soul-swan is flying away, and the body is being buried, and still he makes gestures.","ms":"Kabir, when the soul-swan is about to fly and the body is about to be bruised, even then mortal instructs with gestures."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਕਬੀਰ! , ਸਰੀਰ (ਆਤਮਾ ਦੇ ਵਿਛੁੜਨ ਤੇ) ਢਹਿ-ਢੇਰੀ ਹੋਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ, ਫਿਰ ਵੀ ਮੋਹ ਦੀ ਜੇਵੜੀ ਨਾਲ ਬੱਝਾ ਹੋਇਆ ਜੀਵ ਸੈਣਤਾਂ ਨਾਲ ਹੀ (ਪਿਛਲੇ ਸੰਬੰਧੀਆਂ ਨੂੰ) ਸਮਝਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ,"}}},{"verse_id":58280,"page_no":1370,"line_no":15,"gurmukhi":"ਅਜਹੂ ਜੀਉ ਨ ਛੋਡਈ ਰੰਕਾਈ ਨੈਨਾਹ ॥੧੧੮॥","translit_en":"ajahoo jeeau na chhoddiee ra(n)kaiee nainaeh ||118||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Even then, the mortal does not give up the cruel look in his eyes. ||118||","ms":"Even then, the mortal leaves not the meanness of his eyes."},"pu":{"ss":"ਅਜੇ ਭੀ ਜੀਵ ਅੱਖਾਂ ਦੀ ਕੰਗਾਲਤਾ ਨਹੀਂ ਛੱਡਦਾ ।੧੧੮।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5085,"next":5087}}
files.shabads/10/5087.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5087,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1370,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58281,"last_verse_id":58282,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58281,"page_no":1370,"line_no":15,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰ ਨੈਨ ਨਿਹਾਰਉ ਤੁਝ ਕਉ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਸੁਨਉ ਤੁਅ ਨਾਉ ॥","translit_en":"kabeer nain nihaarau tujh kau sravan sunau tua naau ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer: with my eyes, I see You, Lord; with my ears, I hear Your Name.","ms":"Kabir, O my Lord, with my eyes I see Thee and with mine ears hear I Thy Name."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਕਬੀਰ! ਮੈਂ ਆਪਣੀਆਂ ਅੱਖਾਂ ਨਾਲ (ਹਰ ਪਾਸੇ) ਤੇਰਾ ਹੀ ਦੀਦਾਰ ਕਰਦਾ ਰਹਾਂ, ਤੇਰਾ ਹੀ ਨਾਮ ਮੈਂ ਆਪਣੇ ਕੰਨਾਂ ਨਾਲ ਸੁਣਦਾ ਰਹਾਂ, "}}},{"verse_id":58282,"page_no":1370,"line_no":16,"gurmukhi":"ਬੈਨ ਉਚਰਉ ਤੁਅ ਨਾਮ ਜੀ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਰਿਦ ਠਾਉ ॥੧੧੯॥","translit_en":"bain ucharau tua naam jee charan kamal ridh Thaau ||119||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"With my tongue I chant Your Name; I enshrine Your Lotus Feet within my heart. ||119||","ms":"With my tongue I recite Thy Name and enshrine Thine lotus feet within my mind."},"pu":{"ss":"ਬਚਨਾਂ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਮੈਂ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮ ਹੀ ਉਚਾਰਦਾ ਰਹਾਂ, ਅਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਚਰਨਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਆਪਣੇ ਹਿਰਦੇ ਵਿਚ ਥਾਂ ਦੇਈ ਰੱਖਾਂ ।੧੧੯।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5086,"next":5088}}
files.shabads/10/5088.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5088,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1370,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58283,"last_verse_id":58284,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58283,"page_no":1370,"line_no":17,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰ ਸੁਰਗ ਨਰਕ ਤੇ ਮੈ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ॥","translit_en":"kabeer surag narak te mai rahio satigur ke parasaadh ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer, I have been spared from heaven and hell, by the Grace of the True Guru.","ms":"Kabir, by the True Guru's grace, I have escaped from paradise and hell."},"pu":{"ss":"ਆਪਣੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਦੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਾਲ ਮੈਂ ਸੁਰਗ (ਦੀ ਲਾਲਸਾ) ਅਤੇ ਨਰਕ (ਦੇ ਡਰ) ਤੋਂ ਬਚ ਗਿਆ ਹਾਂ ।"}}},{"verse_id":58284,"page_no":1370,"line_no":17,"gurmukhi":"ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਕੀ ਮਉਜ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਉ ਅੰਤਿ ਅਰੁ ਆਦਿ ॥੧੨੦॥","translit_en":"charan kamal kee mauj meh rahau a(n)t ar aadh ||120||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"From beginning to end, I abide in the joy of the Lord's Lotus Feet. ||120||","ms":"In enjoy abiding in the Lord's lotus feet, in the beginning and at the end."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਕਬੀਰ! ਮੈਂ ਤਾਂ ਸਦਾ ਹੀ ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਦੇ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਚਰਨਾਂ (ਦੀ ਯਾਦ) ਦੇ ਹੁਲਾਰੇ ਵਿਚ ਰਹਿੰਦਾ ਹਾਂ; । ੧੨੦।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5087,"next":5089}}
files.shabads/10/5089.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5089,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1370,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58285,"last_verse_id":58286,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58285,"page_no":1370,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਕੀ ਮਉਜ ਕੋ ਕਹਿ ਕੈਸੇ ਉਨਮਾਨ ॥","translit_en":"kabeer charan kamal kee mauj ko keh kaise unamaan ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer, how can I even describe the extent of the joy of the Lord's Lotus Feet?","ms":"Kabir, how can I tell thee, the extent of the joy of the Lord's lotus feet?"},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਕਬੀਰ! ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦੇ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਚਰਨਾਂ ਵਿਚ ਟਿਕੇ ਰਹਿਣ ਦੇ ਹੁਲਾਰੇ ਦਾ ਅੰਦਾਜ਼ਾ ਕਿਵੇਂ ਕੋਈ ਦੱਸ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ? "}}},{"verse_id":58286,"page_no":1370,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਕਹਿਬੇ ਕਉ ਸੋਭਾ ਨਹੀ ਦੇਖਾ ਹੀ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥੧੨੧॥","translit_en":"kahibe kau sobhaa nahee dhekhaa hee paravaan ||121||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"I cannot describe its sublime glory; it has to be seen to be appreciated. ||121||","ms":"Its sublimity can be described not. it can only be seen and realised."},"pu":{"ss":"ਉਸ ਮੌਜ ਦਾ ਬਿਆਨ ਕਰਨਾ ਫਬਦਾ ਹੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ; ਉਹ ਕੇਡਾ ਕੁ ਹੁਲਾਰਾ ਹੈ?—ਇਹ ਤਾਂ ਉਹ ਹੁਲਾਰਾ ਲਿਆਂ ਹੀ ਤਸੱਲੀ ਹੁੰਦੀ ਹੈ ।੧੨੧।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5088,"next":5090}}
files.shabads/10/5090.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5090,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1370,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58287,"last_verse_id":58288,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58287,"page_no":1370,"line_no":19,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰ ਦੇਖਿ ਕੈ ਕਿਹ ਕਹਉ ਕਹੇ ਨ ਕੋ ਪਤੀਆਇ ॥","translit_en":"kabeer dhekh kai keh kahau kahe na ko pateeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer, how can I describe what I have seen? No one will believe my words.","ms":"Kabir, seeing my Lord, how can I describe Him? No one can be satisfied with my words."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਕਬੀਰ! ਉਸ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦਾ ਦੀਦਾਰ ਕਰਕੇ ਮੈਂ ਦੱਸ ਭੀ ਕੁਝ ਨਹੀਂ ਸਕਦਾ, ਤੇ ਦੱਸਿਆਂ ਕਿਸੇ ਨੂੰ ਤਸੱਲੀ ਭੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੋ ਸਕਦੀ ,"}}},{"verse_id":58288,"page_no":1370,"line_no":19,"gurmukhi":"ਹਰਿ ਜੈਸਾ ਤੈਸਾ ਉਹੀ ਰਹਉ ਹਰਖਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ॥੧੨੨॥","translit_en":"har jaisaa taisaa uhee rahau harakh gun gai ||122||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Lord is just as He is. I dwell in delight, singing His Glorious Praises. ||122||","ms":"As God is, so is He Himself alone. I abide in the delight of singing His praises."},"pu":{"ss":"ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਆਪਣੇ ਵਰਗਾ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਹੈ; ਉਸ ਦੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾ ਗਾ ਕੇ ਮੈਂ ਮੌਜ ਵਿਚ ਟਿਕਿਆ ਰਹਿੰਦਾ ਹਾਂ ।੧੨੨।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5089,"next":5091}}
files.shabads/10/5091.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5091,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1371,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":1,"first_verse_id":58289,"last_verse_id":58289,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58289,"page_no":1371,"line_no":1,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰ ਚੁਗੈ ਚਿਤਾਰੈ ਭੀ ਚੁਗੈ ਚੁਗਿ ਚੁਗਿ ਚਿਤਾਰੇ ॥ ਜੈਸੇ ਬਚਰਹਿ ਕੂੰਜ ਮਨ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਮਤਾ ਰੇ ॥੧੨੩॥","translit_en":"kabeer chugai chitaarai bhee chugai chug chug chitaare || jaise bachareh koo(n)j man maiaa mamataa re ||123||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer, the flamingo pecks and feeds, and remembers her chicks. She pecks and pecks and feeds, and remembers them always. Her chicks are very dear to her, just like the love of wealth and Maya is dear to the mortal's mind. ||123||","ms":"Kabir, the flamingo pecks, at her feet and remembers her offspring. As she pecks and pecks, she again remembers her offspring."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਕਬੀਰ! ਕੂੰਜ ਚੋਗਾ ਚੁਗਦੀ ਹੈ ਤੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਬੱਚਿਆਂ ਦਾ ਭੀ ਚੇਤਾ ਕਰਦੀ ਹੈ, ਮੁੜ ਚੁਗਦੀ ਹੈ, ਚੋਗਾ ਭੀ ਚੁਗਦੀ ਹੈ ਤੇ ਬੱਚਿਆਂ ਦਾ ਚੇਤਾ ਭੀ ਕਰਦੀ ਹੈ ।ਜਿਵੇਂ ਕੂੰਜ ਦੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਹਰ ਵੇਲੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਬੱਚਿਆਂ ਵਿਚ ਰਹਿੰਦੀ ਹੈ, ਤਿਵੇਂ, ਹੇ ਭਾਈ! ਮਨੁੱਖ ਦਾ ਮਨ ਮਾਇਆ ਦੀ ਮਲਕੀਅਤ ਦੀ ਤਾਂਘ ਵਿਚ ਟਿਕਿਆ ਰਹਿੰਦਾ ਹੈ ।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5090,"next":5092}}
files.shabads/10/5092.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5092,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1371,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58290,"last_verse_id":58291,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58290,"page_no":1371,"line_no":2,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰ ਅੰਬਰ ਘਨਹਰੁ ਛਾਇਆ ਬਰਖਿ ਭਰੇ ਸਰ ਤਾਲ ॥","translit_en":"kabeer a(n)bar ghanahar chhaiaa barakh bhare sar taal ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer, the sky is overcast and cloudy; the ponds and lakes are overflowing with water.","ms":"Kabir, the sky is overcast with clouds and the lakes and tanks are filled with the rain-water."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਕਬੀਰ! (ਵਰਖਾ ਰੱੁਤੇ) ਬੱਦਲ ਆਕਾਸ਼ ਵਿਚ (ਚਾਰ ਚੁਫੇਰੇ) ਵਿਛ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ, ਵਰਖਾ ਕਰ ਕੇ (ਨਿੱਕੇ ਵੱਡੇ ਸਾਰੇ) ਸਰੋਵਰ ਤਾਲਾਬ ਭਰ ਦੇਂਦਾ ਹੈ "}}},{"verse_id":58291,"page_no":1371,"line_no":2,"gurmukhi":"ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਜਿਉ ਤਰਸਤ ਰਹੈ ਤਿਨ ਕੋ ਕਉਨੁ ਹਵਾਲੁ ॥੧੨੪॥","translit_en":"chaatirak jiau tarasat rahai tin ko kaun havaal ||124||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Like the rainbird, some remain thirsty - what is their condition? ||124||","ms":"They, who remain thirsty like the pied cuckoo; what would their condition be?"},"pu":{"ss":"ਮਾਇਆ ਦੀ ਮਮਤਾ ਵਿਚ ਫਸੇ ਹੋਏ ਜੀਵ ਪਪੀਹੇ ਵਾਂਗ ਤਰਲੇ ਲੈਂਦੇ ਹਨ, ਤੇ ਉਹਨਾਂ ਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਮੰਦਾ ਹਾਲ ਹੀ ਰਹਿੰਦਾ ਹੈ ।੧੨੪।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5091,"next":5093}}
files.shabads/10/5093.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5093,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1371,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58292,"last_verse_id":58293,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58292,"page_no":1371,"line_no":3,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰ ਚਕਈ ਜਉ ਨਿਸਿ ਬੀਛੁਰੈ ਆਇ ਮਿਲੈ ਪਰਭਾਤਿ ॥","translit_en":"kabeer chakiee jau nis beechhurai aai milai parabhaat ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer, the chakvi duck is separated from her love through the night, but in the morning, she meets him again.","ms":"Kabir, the sheldrake, which is separated for the night from her love, comes and meets him in the morning."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਕਬੀਰ! ਚਕਵੀ ਜਦੋਂ ਰਾਤ ਨੂੰ (ਆਪਣੇ ਚੁਕਵੇ ਤੋਂ) ਵਿਛੁੜਦੀ ਹੈ ਤਾਂ ਸਵੇਰ-ਸਾਰ ਮੁੜ ਆ ਮਿਲਦੀ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":58293,"page_no":1371,"line_no":3,"gurmukhi":"ਜੋ ਨਰ ਬਿਛੁਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਨਾ ਦਿਨ ਮਿਲੇ ਨ ਰਾਤਿ ॥੧੨੫॥","translit_en":"jo nar bichhure raam siau naa dhin mile na raat ||125||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Those who are separated from the Lord do not meet Him in the day, or in the night. ||125||","ms":"The men, who are separated from the Lord, meet Him neither in the day nor in the night."},"pu":{"ss":" ਜੋ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਤੋਂ ਵਿਛੁੜਦੇ ਹਨ, ਉਹ ਨਾਹ ਦਿਨੇ ਮਿਲ ਸਕਦੇ ਹਨ ਨਾਹ ਰਾਤ ਨੂੰ ।੧੨੫।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5092,"next":5094}}
files.shabads/10/5094.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5094,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1371,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58294,"last_verse_id":58295,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58294,"page_no":1371,"line_no":4,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰ ਰੈਨਾਇਰ ਬਿਛੋਰਿਆ ਰਹੁ ਰੇ ਸੰਖ ਮਝੂਰਿ ॥","translit_en":"kabeer rainair bichhoriaa rahu re sa(n)kh majhoor ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer: O conch shell, remain in the ocean.","ms":"Kabir, O conch, remain thou in the ocean; separating from it,"},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਕਬੀਰ! (ਆਖ—) ਸਮੁੰਦਰ ਤੋਂ ਵਿਛੁੜੇ ਹੋਏ ਹੇ ਸੰਖ! ਸਮੁੰਦਰ ਦੇ ਵਿਚ ਹੀ ਟਿਕਿਆ ਰਹੁ,"}}},{"verse_id":58295,"page_no":1371,"line_no":5,"gurmukhi":"ਦੇਵਲ ਦੇਵਲ ਧਾਹੜੀ ਦੇਸਹਿ ਉਗਵਤ ਸੂਰ ॥੧੨੬॥","translit_en":"dheval dheval dhaahaRee dheseh ugavat soor ||126||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If you are separated from it, you shall scream at sunrise from temple to temple. ||126||","ms":"otherwise, thou shall have to give out scream at sun rise at every temple."},"pu":{"ss":"ਨਹੀਂ ਤਾਂ ਹਰ ਰੋਜ਼ ਸੂਰਜ ਚੜ੍ਹਦੇ ਸਾਰ ਹਰੇਕ ਮੰਦਰ ਵਿਚ ਡਰਾਉਣੀ ਢਾਹ ਮਾਰੇਂਗਾ ।੧੨੬।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5093,"next":5095}}
files.shabads/10/5095.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5095,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1371,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58296,"last_verse_id":58297,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58296,"page_no":1371,"line_no":5,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰ ਸੂਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਜਾਗੁ ਰੋਇ ਭੈ ਦੁਖ ॥","translit_en":"kabeer sootaa kiaa kareh jaag roi bhai dhukh ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer, what are you doing sleeping? Wake up and cry in fear and pain.","ms":"Kabir what do you do by sleeping? Wakeup and weep over the fear and pain of death."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਕਬੀਰ! ਸੁੱਤਾ ਹੋਇਆ  ਕੀਹ ਕਰ ਰਿਹਾ ਹੈਂ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦੀ ਯਾਦ ਵਿਚ ਹੁਸ਼ਿਆਰ ਹੋ ਅਤੇ ਸਹਿਮਾਂ ਤੇ ਕਲੇਸ਼ਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਖ਼ਲਾਸੀ ਹਾਸਲ ਕਰ ,"}}},{"verse_id":58297,"page_no":1371,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਜਾ ਕਾ ਬਾਸਾ ਗੋਰ ਮਹਿ ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਸੋਵੈ ਸੁਖ ॥੧੨੭॥","translit_en":"jaa kaa baasaa gor meh so kiau sovai sukh ||127||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Those who live in the grave - how can they sleep in peace? ||127||","ms":"They, whose abode is in the grave, how can they sleep in peace?"},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਿਸ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਦਾ ਵਾਸ ਸਦਾ (ਅਜੇਹੀ ਕਬਰ ਵਿਚ ਰਹੇ, ਉਹ ਕਦੇ ਸੁਖੀ ਜੀਵਨ ਜਿਊਂਦਾ ਨਹੀਂ ਕਿਹਾ ਜਾ ਸਕਦਾ ।੧੨੮।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5094,"next":5096}}
files.shabads/10/5096.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5096,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1371,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58298,"last_verse_id":58299,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58298,"page_no":1371,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰ ਸੂਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਉਠਿ ਕਿ ਨ ਜਪਹਿ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥","translit_en":"kabeer sootaa kiaa kareh uTh k na japeh muraar ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer, what are you doing sleeping? Why not rise up and meditate on the Lord?","ms":"Kabir, what does thou do by sleeping. Why wakeup and contemplate on God, the enemy of ego?"},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਕਬੀਰ! ਮਾਇਆ ਦੇ ਮੋਹ ਵਿਚ ਮਸਤ ਹੋ ਕੇ ਕਿਉਂ ਉਮਰ ਅਜਾਈਂ ਗਵਾ ਰਿਹਾ ਹੈਂ? ਇਸ ਮੋਹ ਨੀਂਦ ਵਿਚੋਂ ਹੁਸ਼ਿਆਰ ਹੋ ਕੇ ਕਿਉਂ ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਦਾ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਨਹੀਂ ਕਰਦਾ?"}}},{"verse_id":58299,"page_no":1371,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਇਕ ਦਿਨ ਸੋਵਨੁ ਹੋਇਗੋ ਲਾਂਬੇ ਗੋਡ ਪਸਾਰਿ ॥੧੨੮॥","translit_en":"eik dhin sovan hoigo laa(n)be godd pasaar ||128||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"One day you shall sleep with your legs outstretched. ||128||","ms":"One day thou shall sleep, stretching out thine knees at full-length."},"pu":{"ss":" ਇਕ ਦਿਨ ਅਜੇਹਾ ਬੇ-ਬਸ ਹੋ ਕੇ ਸੌਣਾ ਪਏਗਾ ਕਿ ਮੁੜ ਉੱਠਿਆ ਹੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਜਾ ਸਕੇਗਾ (ਇਕ ਦਿਨ ਸਦਾ ਦੀ ਨੀਂਦਰੇ ਸੌਣਾ ਪਏਗਾ) ।੧੨੮।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5095,"next":5097}}
files.shabads/10/5097.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5097,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1371,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58300,"last_verse_id":58301,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58300,"page_no":1371,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰ ਸੂਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਬੈਠਾ ਰਹੁ ਅਰੁ ਜਾਗੁ ॥","translit_en":"kabeer sootaa kiaa kareh baiThaa rahu ar jaag ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer, what are you doing sleeping? Wake up, and sit up.","ms":"Kabir, what does thou do by sleeping? Thou wakeup and keep sitting."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਕਬੀਰ! ਮਾਇਆ ਦੇ ਮੋਹ ਵਿਚ ਮਸਤ ਹੋ ਕੇ ਕਿਉਂ ਉਮਰ ਅਜਾਈਂ ਗਵਾ ਰਿਹਾ ਹੈਂ? ਹੁਸ਼ਿਆਰ ਹੋ, ਮਮਤਾ ਦੀ ਨੀਂਦ ਦੇ ਹੁਲਾਰੇ ਵਲੋਂ ਸੁਚੇਤ ਰਹੁ ।"}}},{"verse_id":58301,"page_no":1371,"line_no":8,"gurmukhi":"ਜਾ ਕੇ ਸੰਗ ਤੇ ਬੀਛੁਰਾ ਤਾ ਹੀ ਕੇ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਾਗੁ ॥੧੨੯॥","translit_en":"jaa ke sa(n)g te beechhuraa taa hee ke sa(n)g laag ||129||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Attach yourself to the One, from whom you have been separated. ||129||","ms":"He from whose company thou are separated, to Him attach thou thyself."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਿਸ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦੀ ਯਾਦ ਤੋਂ ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਹੋਇਆ ਹੈਂ (ਅਤੇ ਇਹ ਸਹਿਮ ਤੇ ਕਲੇਸ਼ ਸਹਾਰ ਰਿਹਾ ਹੈਂ) ਉਸੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦੇ ਚਰਨਾਂ ਵਿਚ ਜੁੜਿਆ ਰਹੁ ।੧੨੯।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5096,"next":5098}}
files.shabads/10/5098.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5098,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1371,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58302,"last_verse_id":58303,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58302,"page_no":1371,"line_no":8,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰ ਸੰਤ ਕੀ ਗੈਲ ਨ ਛੋਡੀਐ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਜਾਉ ॥","translit_en":"kabeer sa(n)t kee gail na chhoddeeaai maarag laagaa jaau ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer, do not leave the Society of the Saints; walk upon this Path.","ms":"Kabir, leave thou not the association of the saint and walk thou on his path."},"pu":{"ss":" ਹੇ ਕਬੀਰ! ਉਹ ਰਸਤਾ ਨਾਹ ਛੱਡੀਏ ਜਿਸ ਉੱਤੇ ਸੰਤ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤੁਰਦੇ ਹਨ, ਉਹਨਾਂ ਦੇ ਰਸਤੇ ਉੱਤੇ ਤੁਰੇ ਚੱਲਣਾ ਚਾਹੀਦਾ ਹੈ । "}}},{"verse_id":58303,"page_no":1371,"line_no":9,"gurmukhi":"ਪੇਖਤ ਹੀ ਪੁੰਨੀਤ ਹੋਇ ਭੇਟਤ ਜਪੀਐ ਨਾਉ ॥੧੩੦॥","translit_en":"pekhat hee pu(n)neet hoi bheTat japeeaai naau ||130||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"See them, and be sanctified; meet them, and chant the Name. ||130||","ms":"Seeing him thou shall be purified and meeting with him, thou shall begin to recite the Lord's Name."},"pu":{"ss":"ਸੰਤਾਂ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾਂ ਦਾ ਦਰਸ਼ਨ ਕੀਤਿਆਂ ਮਨ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਹੋ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ, ਉਹਨਾਂ ਦੇ ਪਾਸ ਬੈਠਿਆਂ ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਦਾ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਮਰੀਦਾ ਹੈ (ਸਿਮਰਨ ਦਾ ਸ਼ੌਕ ਪੈ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ) ।੧੩੦।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5097,"next":5099}}
files.shabads/10/5099.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5099,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1371,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58304,"last_verse_id":58305,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58304,"page_no":1371,"line_no":9,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰ ਸਾਕਤ ਸੰਗੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੀਐ ਦੂਰਹਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਭਾਗਿ ॥","translit_en":"kabeer saakat sa(n)g na keejeeaai dhooreh jaieeaai bhaag ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer, do not associate with the faithless cynics; run far away from them.","ms":"Kabir, associate thou not with the infidel and flee far away from him."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਕਬੀਰ! ਰੱਬ ਨਾਲੋਂ ਟੁੱਟੇ ਹੋਏ ਬੰਦੇ ਦੀ ਸੁਹਬਤਿ ਨਹੀਂ ਕਰਨੀ ਚਾਹੀਦੀ, ਉਸ ਤੋਂ ਦੂਰ ਹੀ ਹਟ ਜਾਣਾ ਚਾਹੀਦਾ ਹੈ । "}}},{"verse_id":58305,"page_no":1371,"line_no":10,"gurmukhi":"ਬਾਸਨੁ ਕਾਰੋ ਪਰਸੀਐ ਤਉ ਕਛੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਦਾਗੁ ॥੧੩੧॥","translit_en":"baasan kaaro paraseeaai tau kachh laagai dhaag ||131||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If you touch a vessel stained with soot, some of the soot will stick to you. ||131||","ms":"If thou touch a black vessel, then, some blot must attach to thee."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜੇ ਕਿਸੇ ਕਾਲੇ ਭਾਂਡੇ ਨੂੰ ਛੋਹੀਏ, ਤਾਂ ਥੋੜਾ-ਬਹੁਤ ਦਾਗ਼ ਲੱਗ ਹੀ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ ।੧੩੨।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5098,"next":5100}}
files.shabads/10/5100.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5100,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1371,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58306,"last_verse_id":58307,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58306,"page_no":1371,"line_no":10,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਜਰਾ ਪਹੂੰਚਿਓ ਆਇ ॥","translit_en":"kabeeraa raam na chetio jaraa pahoo(n)chio aai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer, you have not contemplated the Lord, and now old age has overtaken you.","ms":"Kabir, thou have not contemplated thy Lord and the old age has come upon thee."},"pu":{"ss":" ਹੇ ਕਬੀਰ! ਪਰ ਜੇ ਜੁਆਨੀ ਵਿਚ ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਦਾ ਭਜਨ ਨਾਹ ਕੀਤਾ (ਉਤੋਂ) ਬੁਢੇਪਾ ਆ ਅੱਪੜਿਆ ।"}}},{"verse_id":58307,"page_no":1371,"line_no":11,"gurmukhi":"ਲਾਗੀ ਮੰਦਿਰ ਦੁਆਰ ਤੇ ਅਬ ਕਿਆ ਕਾਢਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥੧੩੨॥","translit_en":"laagee ma(n)dhir dhuaar te ab kiaa kaaddiaa jai ||132||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Now that the door of your mansion is on fire, what can you take out? ||132||","ms":"Now when the door of thy mansion is on fire; what can be taken out?"},"pu":{"ss":"ਜੇ ਕਿਸੇ ਘਰ ਨੂੰ ਬੂਹੇ ਵਲੋਂ ਹੀ ਅੱਗ ਲੱਗ ਜਾਏ, ਤਾਂ ਉਸ ਵੇਲੇ (ਘਰ ਵਿਚੋਂ) ਬਹੁਤਾ ਕੁਝ (ਸੜਨੋਂ) ਬਚਾਇਆ ਨਹੀਂ ਜਾ ਸਕਦਾ ।੧੩੨।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5099,"next":5101}}
files.shabads/10/5101.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5101,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1371,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58308,"last_verse_id":58309,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58308,"page_no":1371,"line_no":11,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰ ਕਾਰਨੁ ਸੋ ਭਇਓ ਜੋ ਕੀਨੋ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥","translit_en":"kabeer kaaran so bhio jo keeno karataar ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer, the Creator does whatever He pleases.","ms":"Kabir, the work, which the Creator does, that alone is accomplished."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਕਬੀਰ!ਸਬਬ ਉਹੀ ਬਣਦਾ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਕਰਤਾਰ ਆਪ ਬਣਾਏ; "}}},{"verse_id":58309,"page_no":1371,"line_no":12,"gurmukhi":"ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਸਰੁ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਏਕੈ ਸਿਰਜਨਹਾਰੁ ॥੧੩੩॥","translit_en":"tis bin dhoosar ko nahee ekai sirajanahaar ||133||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"There is none other than Him; He alone is the Creator of all. ||133||","ms":"Without Him there is not another. He alone is the Creator of all."},"pu":{"ss":"ਉਸ ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਤੋਂ ਬਿਨਾਂ ਹੋਰ ਕੋਈ ਨਹੀਂ, ਸਿਰਫ਼ ਸ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਟੀ ਦਾ ਰਚਨਹਾਰ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਇਹ ਸਬਬ ਬਣਾਣ-ਜੋਗਾ ਹੈ ।੧੩੩।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5100,"next":5102}}
files.shabads/10/5102.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5102,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1371,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58310,"last_verse_id":58311,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58310,"page_no":1371,"line_no":12,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰ ਫਲ ਲਾਗੇ ਫਲਨਿ ਪਾਕਨਿ ਲਾਗੇ ਆਂਬ ॥","translit_en":"kabeer fal laage falan paakan laage aa(n)b ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer, the fruit trees are bearing fruit, and the mangoes are becoming ripe.","ms":"Kabir, when the fruit trees being to bear fruit and the mangos begin to ripe."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਕਬੀਰ! ਅੰਬਾਂ ਦੇ ਬੂਟਿਆਂ ਨੂੰ (ਪਹਿਲਾਂ) ਫਲ ਲੱਗਦੇ ਹਨ, ਤੇ (ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜੇ ਫਿਰ ਉਹ) ਪੱਕਣੇ ਸ਼ੁਰੂ ਹੁੰਦੇ ਹਨ; "}}},{"verse_id":58311,"page_no":1371,"line_no":13,"gurmukhi":"ਜਾਇ ਪਹੂਚਹਿ ਖਸਮ ਕਉ ਜਉ ਬੀਚਿ ਨ ਖਾਹੀ ਕਾਂਬ ॥੧੩੪॥","translit_en":"jai pahoocheh khasam kau jau beech na khaahee kaa(n)b ||134||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"They will reach the owner, only if the crows do not eat them first. ||134||","ms":"They reach the owner, if the crows eat them not in the meantime."},"pu":{"ss":"ਪੱਕਣ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਜੇ ਇਹ ਅੰਬ (ਹਨੇਰੀ ਆਦਿਕ ਨਾਲ ਟਹਿਣੀ ਨਾਲੋਂ) ਹਿੱਲ ਨਾਹ ਜਾਣ ਤਾਂ ਹੀ ਮਾਲਕ ਤਕ ਅੱਪੜਦੇ ਹਨ ।੧੩੪।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5101,"next":5103}}
files.shabads/10/5103.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5103,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1371,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58312,"last_verse_id":58313,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58312,"page_no":1371,"line_no":13,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਪੂਜਹਿ ਮੋਲਿ ਲੇ ਮਨਹਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਜਾਹਿ ॥","translit_en":"kabeer Thaakur poojeh mol le manahaTh teerath jaeh ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer, some buy idols and worship them; in their stubborn-mindedness, they make pilgrimages to sacred shrines.","ms":"Kabir, men purchase and worship the god-idol and through their mind's obstinacy go on pilgrimage."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਕਬੀਰ! ਜੋ ਲੋਕ ਠਾਕੁਰ (ਦੀ ਮੂਰਤੀ) ਮੁੱਲ ਲੈ ਕੇ (ਉਸ ਦੀ) ਪੂਜਾ ਕਰਦੇ ਹਨ, ਅਤੇ ਮਨ ਦੇ ਹਠ ਨਾਲ ਤੀਰਥਾਂ ਤੇ ਜਾਂਦੇ ਹਨ, "}}},{"verse_id":58313,"page_no":1371,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਦੇਖਾ ਦੇਖੀ ਸ੍ਵਾਂਗੁ ਧਰਿ ਭੂਲੇ ਭਟਕਾ ਖਾਹਿ ॥੧੩੫॥","translit_en":"dhekhaa dhekhee savaiaa(n)g dhar bhoole bhaTakaa khaeh ||135||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"They look at one another, and wear religious robes, but they are deluded and lost. ||135||","ms":"Seeing one another, they wear religious robes, go astray and wander at large."},"pu":{"ss":" ਇਕ ਦੂਜੇ ਨੂੰ (ਇਹ ਕੰਮ ਕਰਦਿਆਂ) ਵੇਖ ਕੇ ਸਾਂਗ ਬਣਾਈ ਜਾਂਦੇ ਹਨ ਸਹੀ ਰਾਹ ਤੋਂ ਖੁੰਝੇ ਹੋਏ ਇਹ ਲੋਕ ਭਟਕਦੇ ਹਨ ।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5102,"next":5104}}
files.shabads/10/5104.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5104,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1371,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58314,"last_verse_id":58315,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58314,"page_no":1371,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰ ਪਾਹਨੁ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰੁ ਕੀਆ ਪੂਜੈ ਸਭੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥","translit_en":"kabeer paahan paramesur keeaa poojai sabh sa(n)saar ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer, someone sets up a stone idol and all the world worships it as the Lord.","ms":"Kabir, setting up stone as god, all the mortal worship it."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਕਬੀਰ! (ਪੰਡਿਤਾਂ ਦੇ ਪਿੱਛੇ ਲੱਗਾ ਹੋਇਆ ਇਹ) ਸਾਰਾ ਜਗਤ ਪੱਥਰ (ਦੀ ਮੂਰਤੀ) ਨੂੰ ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ਮਿਥ ਰਿਹਾ ਹੈ ਤੇ ਇਸ ਦੀ ਪੂਜਾ ਕਰ ਰਿਹਾ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":58315,"page_no":1371,"line_no":15,"gurmukhi":"ਇਸ ਭਰਵਾਸੇ ਜੋ ਰਹੇ ਬੂਡੇ ਕਾਲੀ ਧਾਰ ॥੧੩੬॥","translit_en":"eis bharavaase jo rahe boodde kaalee dhaar ||136||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Those who hold to this belief will be drowned in the river of darkness. ||136||","ms":"They, who abide in this belief, are drowned in the sable stream."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਮਨੁੱਖਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਇਹ ਖ਼ਿਆਲ ਬਣਿਆ ਹੋਇਆ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਪੱਥਰ ਨੂੰ ਪੂਜ ਕੇ ਉਹ ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਦੀ ਭਗਤੀ ਕਰ ਰਹੇ ਹਨ ਉਹ ਡੂੰਘੇ ਪਾਣੀਆਂ ਵਿਚ ਡੁੱਬੇ ਸਮਝੋ ।੧੩੬।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5103,"next":5105}}
files.shabads/10/5105.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5105,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1371,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58316,"last_verse_id":58317,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58316,"page_no":1371,"line_no":15,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰ ਕਾਗਦ ਕੀ ਓਬਰੀ ਮਸੁ ਕੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਪਾਟ ॥","translit_en":"kabeer kaagadh kee obaree mas ke karam kapaaT ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer, the paper is the prison, and the ink of rituals are the bars on the windows.","ms":"Kabir, the religious books form the prison and the ink of rituals its shutters."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਕਬੀਰ! (ਇਹਨਾਂ ਪੰਡਿਤਾਂ ਦੇ) ਸ਼ਾਸਤ੍ਰ, ਮਾਨੋ ਕੈਦਖ਼ਾਨਾ ਹਨ, (ਇਹਨਾਂ ਸ਼ਾਸਤ੍ਰਾਂ ਵਿਚ) ਸਿਆਹੀ ਨਾਲ ਲਿਖੀ ਹੋਈ ਕਰਮ-ਕਾਂਡ ਦੀ ਮਰਯਾਦਾ, ਮਾਨੋ, ਉਸ ਕੈਦਖ਼ਾਨੇ ਦੇ ਬੰਦ ਦਰਵਾਜ਼ੇ ਹਨ । "}}},{"verse_id":58317,"page_no":1371,"line_no":16,"gurmukhi":"ਪਾਹਨ ਬੋਰੀ ਪਿਰਥਮੀ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪਾੜੀ ਬਾਟ ॥੧੩੭॥","translit_en":"paahan boree pirathamee pa(n)ddit paaRee baaT ||137||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The stone idols have drowned the world, and the Pandits, the religious scholars, have plundered it on the way. ||137||","ms":"The stone-gods have drowned the world and the Pandits have plundered it on the way."},"pu":{"ss":"ਪੱਥਰ ਦੀਆਂ ਮੂਰਤੀਆਂ ਨੇ ਧਰਤੀ ਨੇ ਬੰਦਿਆਂ ਨੂੰ (ਸੰਸਾਰ-ਸਮੁੰਦਰ ਵਿਚ) ਡੋਬ ਦਿੱਤਾ ਹੈ, ਪੰਡਿਤ ਲੋਕ ਡਾਕੇ ਮਾਰ ਰਹੇ ਹਨ ।੧੩੭।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5104,"next":5106}}
files.shabads/10/5106.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5106,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1371,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58318,"last_verse_id":58319,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58318,"page_no":1371,"line_no":16,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰ ਕਾਲਿ ਕਰੰਤਾ ਅਬਹਿ ਕਰੁ ਅਬ ਕਰਤਾ ਸੁਇ ਤਾਲ ॥","translit_en":"kabeer kaal kara(n)taa abeh kar ab karataa sui taal ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer, that which you have to do tomorrow - do it today instead; and that which you have to do now - do it immediately!","ms":"Kabir, do now, what have thou to do tomorrow and do that forthwith, what thou have to do now."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਕਬੀਰ! ਭਲਕੇ (ਸਿਮਰਨ ਕਰਾਂਗਾ, ਇਹ ਸਲਾਹ) ਕਰਦਾ ਹੁਣੇ ਹੀ (ਸਿਮਰਨ) ਕਰ (ਭਲਕੇ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਸ਼ੁਰੂ ਕਰਨ ਦੇ ਥਾਂ ਹੁਣੇ ਹੀ ਸ਼ੁਰੂ ਕਰ ਦੇਹ ।"}}},{"verse_id":58319,"page_no":1371,"line_no":17,"gurmukhi":"ਪਾਛੈ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਇਗਾ ਜਉ ਸਿਰ ਪਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਕਾਲੁ ॥੧੩੮॥","translit_en":"paachhai kachhoo na hoigaa jau sir par aavai kaal ||138||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Later on, you will not be able to do anything, when death hangs over your head. ||138||","ms":"Nothing would be done hereinafter, when the death hangs over thy head."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਦੋਂ ਮੌਤ ਸਿਰ ਤੇ ਆ ਜਾਂਦੀ ਹੈ ਉਸ ਵੇਲੇ ਸਮਾਂ ਵਿਹਾ ਜਾਣ ਤੇ ਕੁਝ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੋ ਸਕਦਾ ।੧੩੮।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5105,"next":5107}}
files.shabads/10/5107.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5107,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1371,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58320,"last_verse_id":58321,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58320,"page_no":1371,"line_no":17,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰ ਐਸਾ ਜੰਤੁ ਇਕੁ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਜੈਸੀ ਧੋਈ ਲਾਖ ॥","translit_en":"kabeer aaisaa ja(n)t ik dhekhiaa jaisee dhoiee laakh ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer, I have seen a person, who is as shiny as washed wax.","ms":"Kabir, I have seen such a man, who is like the washed wax."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਕਬੀਰ! ਮੈਂ ਇਕ ਅਜੇਹਾ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਵੇਖਿਆ ਉਹ (ਬਾਹਰੋਂ ਵੇਖਣ ਨੂੰ) ਧੋਤੀ ਹੋਈ ਚਮਕਦੀ ਲਾਖ ਵਰਗਾ ਸੀ । "}}},{"verse_id":58321,"page_no":1371,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਦੀਸੈ ਚੰਚਲੁ ਬਹੁ ਗੁਨਾ ਮਤਿ ਹੀਨਾ ਨਾਪਾਕ ॥੧੩੯॥","translit_en":"dheesai cha(n)chal bahu gunaa mat heenaa naapaak ||139||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He seems very clever and very virtuous, but in reality, he is without understanding, and corrupt. ||139||","ms":"He appears to be clever and very virtuous, however, he is without understanding and unchaste."},"pu":{"ss":"ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦੀ ਯਾਦ ਤੋਂ ਖੁੰਝਿਆ ਹੋਇਆ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਭਾਵੇਂ ਬਹੁਤ ਹੀ ਚੁਸਤ-ਚਲਾਕ ਦਿੱਸਦਾ ਹੋਵੇ, ਪਰ ਉਹ ਅਸਲ ਵਿਚ ਅਕਲ ਤੋਂ ਸੱਖਣਾ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ ਕਿਉਂਕਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਤੋਂ ਵਿਛੁੜ ਕੇ ਉਸ ਦਾ ਜੀਵਨ ਗੰਦਾ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ ।੧੩੯।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5106,"next":5108}}
files.shabads/10/5108.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5108,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1371,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58322,"last_verse_id":58323,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58322,"page_no":1371,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰ ਮੇਰੀ ਬੁਧਿ ਕਉ ਜਮੁ ਨ ਕਰੈ ਤਿਸਕਾਰ ॥","translit_en":"kabeer meree budh kau jam na karai tisakaar ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer, the Messenger of Death shall not compromise my understanding.","ms":"Kabir, death's myrmidon shall disgrace not my understanding."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਕਬੀਰ! ਮੇਰੀ ਅਕਲ ਨੂੰ ਜਮਰਾਜ ਭੀ ਫਿਟਕਾਰ ਨਹੀਂ ਪਾ ਸਕਦਾ, "}}},{"verse_id":58323,"page_no":1371,"line_no":19,"gurmukhi":"ਜਿਨਿ ਇਹੁ ਜਮੂਆ ਸਿਰਜਿਆ ਸੁ ਜਪਿਆ ਪਰਵਿਦਗਾਰ ॥੧੪੦॥","translit_en":"jin ih jamooaa sirajiaa su japiaa paravidhagaar ||140||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"I have meditated on the Lord, the Cherisher, who created this Messenger of Death. ||140||","ms":"I have meditated on that Lord, the Cherisher who has created this myrmidon of death."},"pu":{"ss":"ਕਿਉਂਕਿ ਮੈਂ ਉਸ ਪਾਲਣਹਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਸਿਮਰਿਆ ਹੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੇ ਇਸ ਵਿਚਾਰੇ ਜਮ ਨੂੰ ਪੈਦਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਹੈ ।੧੪੦।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5107,"next":5109}}
files.shabads/10/5109.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5109,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1371,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58324,"last_verse_id":58325,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58324,"page_no":1371,"line_no":19,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰੁ ਕਸਤੂਰੀ ਭਇਆ ਭਵਰ ਭਏ ਸਭ ਦਾਸ ॥","translit_en":"kabeer kasatooree bhiaa bhavar bhe sabh dhaas ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer, the Lord is like musk; all His slaves are like bumble bees.","ms":"Kabir, God has become like musk and all his slaves have become bumble-bees."},"pu":{"ss":"ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ (ਇਉਂ ਪ੍ਰਤੀਤ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ ਜਿਵੇਂ) ਕਸਤੂਰੀ ਹੈ, ਸਾਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਉਸ ਦੇ ਭੌਰੇ ਬਣ ਜਾਂਦੇ ਹਨ "}}},{"verse_id":58325,"page_no":1372,"line_no":1,"gurmukhi":"ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਕੀ ਤਿਉ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਮ ਨਿਵਾਸ ॥੧੪੧॥","translit_en":"jiau jiau bhagat kabeer kee tiau tiau raam nivaas ||141||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The more Kabeer worships Him, the more the Lord abides within his mind. ||141||","ms":"The more Kabir contemplates his Lord, the more, the Lord abides within his mind."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਿਉਂ ਜਿਉਂ ਉਹ ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਦੀ ਭਗਤੀ ਕਰਦੇ ਹਨ, ਤਿਉਂ ਤਿਉਂ ਉਹਨਾਂ ਦੇ ਹਿਰਦੇ ਵਿਚ ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਦਾ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਹੋ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ ।੧੪੧।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5108,"next":5110}}
files.shabads/10/5110.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5110,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1372,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58326,"last_verse_id":58327,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58326,"page_no":1372,"line_no":1,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰ ਗਹਗਚਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਕੈ ਕਾਂਠੈ ਰਹਿ ਗਇਓ ਰਾਮੁ ॥","translit_en":"kabeer gahagach pario kuTa(n)b kai kaa(n)Thai reh gio raam ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer, the mortal has fallen into the grip of family life, and the Lord has been set aside.","ms":"Kabir, man has fallen into the grip of family and the Lord has been set aside."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਕਬੀਰ! ਜੋ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਟੱਬਰ ਦੇ ਗਾੜ੍ਹ ਵਿਚ ਹੀ ਫਸਿਆ ਰਹਿੰਦਾ ਹੈ, ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ (ਦਾ ਭਜਨ ਉਸ ਦੇ ਹਿਰਦੇ ਤੋਂ) ਲਾਂਭੇ ਹੀ ਰਹਿ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":58327,"page_no":1372,"line_no":2,"gurmukhi":"ਆਇ ਪਰੇ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕੇ ਬੀਚਹਿ ਧੂਮਾ ਧਾਮ ॥੧੪੨॥","translit_en":"aai pare dharam rai ke beecheh dhoomaa dhaam ||142||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The messengers of the Righteous Judge of Dharma descend upon the mortal, in the midst of all his pomp and ceremony. ||142||","ms":"The myrmidons of the Righteous Judge, descend on the mortal in the midst of his pomp."},"pu":{"ss":"ਇਸ ਰੌਲੇ-ਗੌਲੇ ਵਿਚ ਹੀ ਫਸੇ ਹੋਏ ਦੇ ਪਾਸ ਧਰਮਰਾਜ ਦੇ ਭੇਜੇ ਹੋਏ ਦੂਤ ਆ ਅੱਪੜਦੇ ਹਨ (‘ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਿਓ, ਜਰਾ ਪਹੂੰਚਿਓ ਆਇ’) ।੧੪੨।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5109,"next":5111}}
files.shabads/10/5111.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5111,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1372,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58328,"last_verse_id":58329,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58328,"page_no":1372,"line_no":2,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰ ਸਾਕਤ ਤੇ ਸੂਕਰ ਭਲਾ ਰਾਖੈ ਆਛਾ ਗਾਉ ॥","translit_en":"kabeer saakat te sookar bhalaa raakhai aachhaa gaau ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer, even a pig is better than the faithless cynic; at least the pig keeps the village clean.","ms":"Kabir, better than an infidel is a swine, which keeps the village clean."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਕਬੀਰ! ਸਾਕਤ ਨਾਲੋਂ ਤਾਂ ਸੂਰ ਹੀ ਚੰਗਾ ਜਾਣੋ (ਪਿੰਡ ਦੇ ਦੁਆਲੇ ਦਾ ਗੰਦ ਖਾ ਕੇ) ਪਿੰਡ ਨੂੰ ਸਾਫ਼-ਸੁਥਰਾ ਰੱਖਦਾ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":58329,"page_no":1372,"line_no":3,"gurmukhi":"ਉਹੁ ਸਾਕਤੁ ਬਪੁਰਾ ਮਰਿ ਗਇਆ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਲੈਹੈ ਨਾਉ ॥੧੪੩॥","translit_en":"auh saakat bapuraa mar giaa koi na laihai naau ||143||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"When the wretched, faithless cynic dies, no one even mentions his name. ||143||","ms":"When he, the wretched materialist dies, no one even mentions his name."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਦੋਂ ਉਹ ਮੰਦ-ਭਾਗੀ ਸਾਕਤ ਮਰ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ ਕਿਸੇ ਨੂੰ ਉਸ ਦਾ ਚੇਤਾ ਭੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਰਹਿ ਜਾਂਦਾ ।੧੪੩।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5110,"next":5112}}
files.shabads/10/5112.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5112,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1372,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58330,"last_verse_id":58331,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58330,"page_no":1372,"line_no":4,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰ ਕਉਡੀ ਕਉਡੀ ਜੋਰਿ ਕੈ ਜੋਰੇ ਲਾਖ ਕਰੋਰਿ ॥","translit_en":"kabeer kauddee kauddee jor kai jore laakh karor ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer, the mortal gathers wealth, shell by shell, accumulating thousands and millions.","ms":"Kabir, gathering shell by shell, man amasses lacs and millions."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਕਬੀਰ! ਜਿਸ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਨੇ ਤਰਲਿਆਂ ਨਾਲ ਜੋੜ ਕੇ ਲੱਖਾਂ ਕੋ੍ਰੜਾਂ ਰੁਪਏ ਭੀ ਇਕੱਠੇ ਕਰ ਲਏ ਹੋਣ ,"}}},{"verse_id":58331,"page_no":1372,"line_no":4,"gurmukhi":"ਚਲਤੀ ਬਾਰ ਨ ਕਛੁ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਲਈ ਲੰਗੋਟੀ ਤੋਰਿ ॥੧੪੪॥","translit_en":"chalatee baar na kachh milio liee la(n)goTee tor ||144||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"But when the time of his departure comes, he takes nothing at all with him. He is even stripped of his loin-cloth. ||144||","ms":"But at the time of departure, he gets nothing. Even his lion-piece is torn away from him."},"pu":{"ss":"ਮਰਨ ਵੇਲੇ ਕੁਝ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੁੰਦਾ, (ਉਸ ਦੇ ਸੰਬੰਧੀ) ਉਸ ਦੀ ਵਾਂਸਲੀ ਭੀ ਤੋੜ ਕੇ ਲਾਹ ਲੈਂਦੇ ਹਨ ।੧੪੪।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5111,"next":5113}}
files.shabads/10/5113.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5113,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1372,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58332,"last_verse_id":58333,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58332,"page_no":1372,"line_no":5,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰ ਬੈਸਨੋ ਹੂਆ ਤ ਕਿਆ ਭਇਆ ਮਾਲਾ ਮੇਲੀਂ ਚਾਰਿ ॥","translit_en":"kabeer baisano hooaa ta kiaa bhiaa maalaa melee(n) chaar ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer, what good is it to become a devotee of Vishnu, and wear four malas?","ms":"Kabir, what does it avail a man to become the follower of Vishnu and wear four rosaries?"},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਕਬੀਰ! ਜੇ ਕਿਸੇ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਨੇ ਤਿਲਕ ਚੱਕ੍ਰ ਲਾ ਕੇ ਅਤੇ ਚਾਰ ਮਾਲਾ ਪਾ ਕੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਆਪ ਨੂੰ ਵੈਸ਼ਨਵ ਭਗਤ ਅਖਵਾ ਲਿਆ, ਉਸ ਨੇ ਭੀ ਕੁਝ ਨਹੀਂ ਖੱਟਿਆ । "}}},{"verse_id":58333,"page_no":1372,"line_no":5,"gurmukhi":"ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਬਾਰਹਾ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਭਰੀ ਭੰਗਾਰ ॥੧੪੫॥","translit_en":"baahar ka(n)chan baarahaa bheetar bharee bha(n)gaar ||145||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"On the outside, he may look like pure gold, but on the inside, he is stuffed with dust. ||145||","ms":"Externally he is gold twelve times purified, however, from within, he is stuffed with dust."},"pu":{"ss":"ਬਾਹਰੋਂ ਵੇੇਖਣ ਨੂੰ ਭਾਵੇਂ ਸ਼ੁੱਧ ਸੋਨਾ ਦਿਸੇ, ਪਰ ਉਸ ਦੇ ਅੰਦਰ ਖੋਟ ਹੀ ਖੋਟ ਹੈ ।੧੪੫।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5112,"next":5114}}
files.shabads/10/5114.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5114,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1372,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58334,"last_verse_id":58335,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58334,"page_no":1372,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰ ਰੋੜਾ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੁ ਬਾਟ ਕਾ ਤਜਿ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥","translit_en":"kabeer roRaa hoi rahu baaT kaa taj man kaa abhimaan ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer, let yourself be a pebble on the path; abandon your egotistical pride.","ms":"Kabir, be thou the brick-piece of the way and lay aside thy mental ego."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਕਬੀਰ! ਅਹੰਕਾਰ ਛੱਡ ਕੇ ਰਾਹ ਵਿਚ ਪਏ ਹੋਏ ਰੋੜੇ ਵਰਗਾ ਹੋ ਜਾਹ ।"}}},{"verse_id":58335,"page_no":1372,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਐਸਾ ਕੋਈ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਤਾਹਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਭਗਵਾਨੁ ॥੧੪੬॥","translit_en":"aaisaa koiee dhaas hoi taeh milai bhagavaan ||146||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Such a humble slave shall meet the Lord God. ||146||","ms":"If there be such a slave; him meets the Illustrious Lord."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜੇਹੜਾ ਕੋਈ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਅਜੇਹਾ ਸੇਵਕ ਬਣ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ, ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਮਿਲ ਪੈਂਦਾ ਹੈ ।੧੪੬।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5113,"next":5115}}
files.shabads/10/5115.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5115,"source_id":"G","writer_id":12,"raag_id":40,"page_no":1372,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58336,"last_verse_id":58337,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Kabeer Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Kabeer Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58336,"page_no":1372,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬੀਰ ਰੋੜਾ ਹੂਆ ਤ ਕਿਆ ਭਇਆ ਪੰਥੀ ਕਉ ਦੁਖੁ ਦੇਇ ॥","translit_en":"kabeer roRaa hooaa ta kiaa bhiaa pa(n)thee kau dhukh dhei ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabeer, what good would it be, to be a pebble? It would only hurt the traveller on the path.","ms":"Kabir, to what avail is to be a gravel when it causes trouble to the way-farer."},"pu":{"ss":"ਪਰ ਹੇ ਕਬੀਰ! ਰੋੜਾ ਬਣਿਆਂ ਭੀ ਅਜੇ ਪੂਰੀ ਕਾਮਯਾਬੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੁੰਦੀ, ਕਿਉਂਕਿ ਰਾਹੀਆਂ ਦੇ ਪੈਰਾਂ ਵਿਚ ਚੁੱਭਦਾ ਭੀ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":58337,"page_no":1372,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਐਸਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਉ ਧਰਨੀ ਮਹਿ ਖੇਹ ॥੧੪੭॥","translit_en":"aaisaa teraa dhaas hai jiau dharanee meh kheh ||147||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Your slave, O Lord, is like the dust of the earth. ||147||","ms":"O Lord, such ought to be Thy servant, as the dust of the earth."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ! ਤੇਰਾ ਭਗਤ ਤਾਂ ਅਜੇਹਾ (ਨਰਮ-ਦਿਲ) ਬਣ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ ਜਿਵੇਂ ਰਾਹ ਦੀ ਬਾਰੀਕ ਧੂੜ ।੧੪੭।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5114,"next":5116}}
