files.shabads/10/5235.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5235,"source_id":"G","writer_id":21,"raag_id":41,"page_no":1379,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58596,"last_verse_id":58597,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Sheikh Fareed Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Fareed Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦ ਕ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58596,"page_no":1379,"line_no":4,"gurmukhi":"ਭਿਜਉ ਸਿਜਉ ਕੰਬਲੀ ਅਲਹ ਵਰਸਉ ਮੇਹੁ ॥","translit_en":"bhijau sijau ka(n)balee aleh varasau meh ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"My blanket is soaked, drenched with the downpour of the Lord's Rain.","ms":"However, let my blanket be wetted and drenched with the down pour of the Lord's rain."},"pu":{"ss":"ਕੰਬਲੀ ਬੇਸ਼ੱਕ ਚੰਗੀ ਤਰ੍ਹਾਂ ਭਿੱਜ ਜਾਏ, ਰੱਬ ਕਰੇ ਮੀਂਹ (ਭੀ) ਬੇਸ਼ੱਕ ਵਰ੍ਹਦਾ ਰਹੇ, "}}},{"verse_id":58597,"page_no":1379,"line_no":4,"gurmukhi":"ਜਾਇ ਮਿਲਾ ਤਿਨਾ ਸਜਣਾ ਤੁਟਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਨੇਹੁ ॥੨੫॥","translit_en":"jai milaa tinaa sajanaa tuTau naahee neh ||25||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"I am going out to meet my Friend, so that my heart will not be broken. ||25||","ms":"I will go and meet that friend, so that my love may be severed not."},"pu":{"ss":"ਮੈਂ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਸੱਜਣਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਜ਼ਰੂਰ ਮਿਲਾਂਗਾ, (ਤਾਕਿ ਕਿਤੇ) ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਆਰ ਨ ਟੁੱਟ ਜਾਏ ।੨੫।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5234,"next":5236}}
files.shabads/10/5236.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5236,"source_id":"G","writer_id":21,"raag_id":41,"page_no":1379,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58598,"last_verse_id":58599,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Sheikh Fareed Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Fareed Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦ ਕ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58598,"page_no":1379,"line_no":5,"gurmukhi":"ਫਰੀਦਾ ਮੈ ਭੋਲਾਵਾ ਪਗ ਦਾ ਮਤੁ ਮੈਲੀ ਹੋਇ ਜਾਇ ॥","translit_en":"fareedhaa mai bholaavaa pag dhaa mat mailee hoi jai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Fareed, I was worried that my turban might become dirty.","ms":"Farid! I am worried about my turban lest it should be soiled."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਫਰੀਦ! ਮੈਨੂੰ (ਆਪਣੀ) ਪੱਗ ਦਾ ਫ਼ਿਕਰ (ਰਹਿੰਦਾ) ਹੈ (ਕਿ ਮਿੱਟੀ ਨਾਲ ਮੇਰੀ ਪੱਗ) ਕਿਤੇ ਮੈਲੀ ਨਾ ਹੋ ਜਾਏ, "}}},{"verse_id":58599,"page_no":1379,"line_no":5,"gurmukhi":"ਗਹਿਲਾ ਰੂਹੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਸਿਰੁ ਭੀ ਮਿਟੀ ਖਾਇ ॥੨੬॥","translit_en":"gahilaa rooh na jaaniee sir bhee miTee khai ||26||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"My thoughtless self did not realize that one day, dust will consume my head as well. ||26||","ms":"However, my thoughtless soul is unaware that dust will eat my head too."},"pu":{"ss":"ਪਰ ਕਮਲੀ ਜਿੰਦ ਇਹ ਨਹੀਂ ਜਾਣਦੀ ਕਿ ਮਿੱਟੀ (ਤਾਂ) ਸਿਰ ਨੂੰ ਭੀ ਖਾ ਜਾਂਦੀ ਹੈ ।੨੬।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5235,"next":5237}}
files.shabads/10/5237.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5237,"source_id":"G","writer_id":21,"raag_id":41,"page_no":1379,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58600,"last_verse_id":58601,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Sheikh Fareed Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Fareed Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦ ਕ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58600,"page_no":1379,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਫਰੀਦਾ ਸਕਰ ਖੰਡੁ ਨਿਵਾਤ ਗੁੜੁ ਮਾਖਿਓੁ ਮਾਂਝਾ ਦੁਧੁ ॥","translit_en":"fareedhaa sakar kha(n)dd nivaat guR maakhio maa(n)jhaa dhudh ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Fareed: sugar cane, candy, sugar, molasses, honey and buffalo's milk","ms":"Farid! Unrefined sugar, loaf sugar, molasses, honey and buffalo's milk,"},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਫਰੀਦ! ਸ਼ੱਕਰ, ਖੰਡ, ਮਿਸਰੀ, ਗੁੜ, ਸ਼ਹਿਦ ਅਤੇ ਮਾਝਾ ਦੁੱਧ"}}},{"verse_id":58601,"page_no":1379,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਸਭੇ ਵਸਤੂ ਮਿਠੀਆਂ ਰਬ ਨ ਪੁਜਨਿ ਤੁਧੁ ॥੨੭॥","translit_en":"sabhe vasatoo miTheeaa(n) rab na pujan tudh ||27||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"- all these things are sweet, but they are not equal to You. ||27||","ms":"all these things are sweet, however, O Lord, they equal Thee not."},"pu":{"ss":"ਇਹ ਸਾਰੀਆਂ ਚੀਜ਼ਾਂ ਮਿੱਠੀਆਂ ਹਨ । ਪਰ, ਹੇ ਰੱਬ! (ਮਿਠਾਸ ਵਿਚ ਇਹ ਚੀਜ਼ਾਂ) ਤੇਰੇ (ਨਾਮ ਦੀ ਮਿਠਾਸ) ਤਕ ਨਹੀਂ ਅੱਪੜ ਸਕਦੀਆਂ ।੨੭।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5236,"next":5238}}
files.shabads/10/5238.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5238,"source_id":"G","writer_id":21,"raag_id":41,"page_no":1379,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58602,"last_verse_id":58603,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Sheikh Fareed Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Fareed Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦ ਕ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58602,"page_no":1379,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਫਰੀਦਾ ਰੋਟੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਾਠ ਕੀ ਲਾਵਣੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਭੁਖ ॥","translit_en":"fareedhaa roTee meree kaaTh kee laavan meree bhukh ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Fareed, my bread is made of wood, and hunger is my appetizer.","ms":"Farid! My bread is the wooden-pot and the hunger is my cooked vegetable."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਫਰੀਦ! (ਆਪਣੇ ਹੱਥਾਂ ਦੀ ਕਮਾਈ ਹੋਈ) ਮੇਰੀ ਰੁੱਖੀ-ਮਿੱਸੀ (ਭਾਵ, ਸਾਦਾ) ਰੋਟੀ ਹੈ, ਮੇਰੀ ਭੁੱਖ ਹੀ (ਇਸ ਰੋਟੀ ਦੇ ਨਾਲ) ਸਲੂਣਾ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":58603,"page_no":1379,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਜਿਨਾ ਖਾਧੀ ਚੋਪੜੀ ਘਣੇ ਸਹਨਿਗੇ ਦੁਖ ॥੨੮॥","translit_en":"jinaa khaadhee chopaRee ghane sahanige dhukh ||28||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Those who eat buttered bread, will suffer in terrible pain. ||28||","ms":"They, who eat buttered bread, shall suffer great pain."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜੋ ਲੋਕ ਚੰਗੀ-ਚੋਖੀ ਖਾਂਦੇ ਹਨ, ਉਹ ਬੜੇ ਕਸ਼ਟ ਸਹਿੰਦੇ ਹਨ  ।੨੮।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5237,"next":5239}}
files.shabads/10/5239.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5239,"source_id":"G","writer_id":21,"raag_id":41,"page_no":1379,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58604,"last_verse_id":58605,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Sheikh Fareed Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Fareed Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦ ਕ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58604,"page_no":1379,"line_no":8,"gurmukhi":"ਰੁਖੀ ਸੁਖੀ ਖਾਇ ਕੈ ਠੰਢਾ ਪਾਣੀ ਪੀਉ ॥","translit_en":"rukhee sukhee khai kai Tha(n)ddaa paanee peeau ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Eat dry bread, and drink cold water.","ms":"Eat thou the coarse dry bread and drink the cold water."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਫਰੀਦ! (ਆਪਣੀ ਕਮਾਈ ਦੀ) ਰੁੱਖੀ-ਸੁੱਖੀ ਹੀ ਖਾ ਕੇ ਠੰਢਾ ਪਾਣੀ ਪੀ ਲੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":58605,"page_no":1379,"line_no":8,"gurmukhi":"ਫਰੀਦਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਪਰਾਈ ਚੋਪੜੀ ਨਾ ਤਰਸਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੨੯॥","translit_en":"fareedhaa dhekh paraiee chopaRee naa tarasaae jeeau ||29||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Fareed, if you see someone else's buttered bread, do not envy him for it. ||29||","ms":"Farid! Seeing another's buttered bread let not thy mind long for it."},"pu":{"ss":"ਪਰ ਪਰਾਈ ਸੁਆਦਲੀ ਰੋਟੀ ਵੇਖ ਕੇ ਆਪਣਾ ਮਨ ਨਾਹ ਤਰਸਾਈਂ ।੨੯।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5238,"next":5240}}
files.shabads/10/5240.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5240,"source_id":"G","writer_id":21,"raag_id":41,"page_no":1379,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58606,"last_verse_id":58607,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Sheikh Fareed Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Fareed Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦ ਕ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58606,"page_no":1379,"line_no":9,"gurmukhi":"ਅਜੁ ਨ ਸੁਤੀ ਕੰਤ ਸਿਉ ਅੰਗੁ ਮੁੜੇ ਮੁੜਿ ਜਾਇ ॥","translit_en":"aj na sutee ka(n)t siau a(n)g muRe muR jai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"This night, I did not sleep with my Husband Lord, and now my body is suffering in pain.","ms":"I slept not with my spouse during the night and every part of my body is pining in pain."},"pu":{"ss":" ਮੈਂ (ਤਾਂ ਕੇਵਲ) ਅੱਜ (ਹੀ) ਪਿਆਰੇ ਨਾਲ ਨਹੀਂ ਸੁੱਤੀ ਹੁਣ ਇਉਂ ਹੈ ਜਿਵੇਂ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਰੀਰ ਟੁੱਟ ਰਿਹਾ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":58607,"page_no":1379,"line_no":9,"gurmukhi":"ਜਾਇ ਪੁਛਹੁ ਡੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਤੁਮ ਕਿਉ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥੩੦॥","translit_en":"jai puchhahu ddohaaganee tum kiau rain vihai ||30||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Go and ask the deserted bride, how she passes her night. ||30||","ms":"Go and ask thou the deserted one, as to how does she passes her night."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਾ ਕੇ ਛੁੱਟੜਾਂ (ਮੰਦ-ਭਾਗਣਾਂ) ਨੂੰ ਪੁੱਛੋ ਕਿ ਤੁਹਾਡੀ (ਸਦਾ ਹੀ) ਰਾਤ ਕਿਵੇਂ ਬੀਤਦੀ ਹੈ ।੩੦।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5239,"next":5241}}
files.shabads/10/5241.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5241,"source_id":"G","writer_id":21,"raag_id":41,"page_no":1379,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58608,"last_verse_id":58609,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Sheikh Fareed Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Fareed Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦ ਕ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58608,"page_no":1379,"line_no":10,"gurmukhi":"ਸਾਹੁਰੈ ਢੋਈ ਨਾ ਲਹੈ ਪੇਈਐ ਨਾਹੀ ਥਾਉ ॥","translit_en":"saahurai ddoiee naa lahai peieeaai naahee thaau ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"She finds no place of rest in her father-in-law's home, and no place in her parents' home either.","ms":"She finds no refuge in the house of her father-in-law and also no place in her parents."},"pu":{"ss":"ਪਰ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਨਾਹ ਸਹੁਰੇ ਘਰ ਤੇ ਨਾਹ ਹੀ ਪੇਕੇ ਘਰ ਕੋਈ ਥਾਂ ਕੋਈ ਆਸਰਾ ਮਿਲਦਾ ਹੈ "}}},{"verse_id":58609,"page_no":1379,"line_no":10,"gurmukhi":"ਪਿਰੁ ਵਾਤੜੀ ਨ ਪੁਛਈ ਧਨ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਨਾਉ ॥੩੧॥","translit_en":"pir vaataRee na puchhiee dhan sohaagan naau ||31||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Her Husband Lord does not care for her; what sort of a blessed, happy soul-bride is she? ||31||","ms":"Her Groom cares not for her, although she is known as a blessed and happily married wife."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਿਸ ਇਸਤ੍ਰੀ ਦੀ ਮਾੜੀ ਜਿਹੀ ਵਾਤ ਭੀ ਪਤੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਪੁੱਛਦਾ, ਉਹ ਆਪਣਾ ਨਾਮ ਬੇਸ਼ੱਕ ਸੁਹਾਗਣ ਰੱਖੀ ਰੱਖੇ।੩੧।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5240,"next":5242}}
files.shabads/10/5242.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5242,"source_id":"G","writer_id":21,"raag_id":41,"page_no":1379,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58610,"last_verse_id":58611,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Sheikh Fareed Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Fareed Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦ ਕ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58610,"page_no":1379,"line_no":11,"gurmukhi":"ਸਾਹੁਰੈ ਪੇਈਐ ਕੰਤ ਕੀ ਕੰਤੁ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਅਥਾਹੁ ॥","translit_en":"saahurai peieeaai ka(n)t kee ka(n)t aga(n)m athaahu ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"In her father-in-law's home hereafter, and in her parents' home in this world, she belongs to her Husband Lord. Her Husband is Inaccessible and Unfathomable.","ms":"Here and hereafter, the bride belongs to her Groom; the Groom who is Unapproachable and Unfathomable."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜੋ ਇਸ ਲੋਕ ਤੇ ਪਰਲੋਕ ਵਿਚ ਉਸ ਖਸਮ ਦੀ ਬਣ ਕੇ ਰਹਿੰਦੀ ਹੈ ,ਖਸਮ ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਜੀਵਾਂ ਦੀ ਪਹੁੰਚ ਤੋਂ ਪਰੇ ਹੈ, ਤੇ ਬਹੁਤ ਡੰੂਘਾ ਹੈ।"}}},{"verse_id":58611,"page_no":1379,"line_no":11,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਜੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਬੇਪਰਵਾਹ ॥੩੨॥","translit_en":"naanak so sohaaganee ju bhaavai beparavaeh ||32||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O Nanak, she is the happy soul-bride, who is pleasing to her Carefree Lord. ||32||","ms":"Nanak, she alone is the happy bride, who is pleasing to her care-free Lord."},"pu":{"ss":" ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! ਸੋਹਾਗਣ (ਜੀਵ-ਇਸਤ੍ਰੀ) ਉਹੀ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਉਸ ਬੇ-ਪਰਵਾਹ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਲੱਗਦੀ ਹੈ।੩੨।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5241,"next":5243}}
files.shabads/10/5243.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5243,"source_id":"G","writer_id":21,"raag_id":41,"page_no":1379,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58612,"last_verse_id":58613,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Sheikh Fareed Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Fareed Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦ ਕ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58612,"page_no":1379,"line_no":11,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਤੀ ਧੋਤੀ ਸੰਬਹੀ ਸੁਤੀ ਆਇ ਨਚਿੰਦੁ ॥","translit_en":"naatee dhotee sa(n)bahee sutee aai nachi(n)dh ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Bathing, washing and decorating herself, she comes and sleeps without anxiety.","ms":"Bathing, washing and bedecking herself, she comes and sleeps without care,"},"pu":{"ss":"(ਜੋ ਜੀਵ-ਇਸਤ੍ਰੀ) ਨ੍ਹਾ ਧੋ ਕੇ (ਪਤੀ ਮਿਲਣ ਦੀ ਆਸ ਵਿਚ) ਤਿਆਰ ਹੋ ਬੈਠੀ, (ਪਰ ਫਿਰ) ਬੇ-ਫ਼ਿਕਰ ਹੋ ਕੇ ਸਉਂ ਗਈ,"}}},{"verse_id":58613,"page_no":1379,"line_no":12,"gurmukhi":"ਫਰੀਦਾ ਰਹੀ ਸੁ ਬੇੜੀ ਹਿੰਙੁ ਦੀ ਗਈ ਕਥੂਰੀ ਗੰਧੁ ॥੩੩॥","translit_en":"fareedhaa rahee su beRee hi(n)n(g) dhee giee kathooree ga(n)dh ||33||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Fareed, she still smells like asafoetida; the fragrance of musk is gone. ||33||","ms":"and she remains smeared with asafoetida and loses the fragrance of musk. Farid!"},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਫਰੀਦ! ਉਸ ਦੀ ਕਸਤੂਰੀ ਵਾਲੀ ਸੁਗੰਧੀ ਤਾਂ ਉੱਡ ਗਈ, ਉਹ ਹਿੰਙ ਦੀ (ਬੋ ਨਾਲ) ਭਰੀ ਰਹਿ ਗਈ ।੩੩।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5242,"next":5244}}
files.shabads/10/5244.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5244,"source_id":"G","writer_id":21,"raag_id":41,"page_no":1379,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58614,"last_verse_id":58615,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Sheikh Fareed Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Fareed Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦ ਕ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58614,"page_no":1379,"line_no":12,"gurmukhi":"ਜੋਬਨ ਜਾਂਦੇ ਨਾ ਡਰਾਂ ਜੇ ਸਹ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥","translit_en":"joban jaa(n)dhe naa ddaraa(n) je seh preet na jai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"I am not afraid of losing my youth, as long as I do not lose the Love of my Husband Lord.","ms":"I fear not the departure of my youth, if my Bridegroom's love departs not."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜੇ ਖਸਮ (ਪ੍ਰਭੂ) ਨਾਲ ਮੇਰੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤ ਨਾਹ ਟੁੱਟੇ ਤਾਂ ਮੈਨੂੰ ਜੁਆਨੀ ਦੇ (ਗੁਜ਼ਰ) ਜਾਣ ਦਾ ਡਰ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ । "}}},{"verse_id":58615,"page_no":1379,"line_no":13,"gurmukhi":"ਫਰੀਦਾ ਕਿਤਂੀ ਜੋਬਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੁਕਿ ਗਏ ਕੁਮਲਾਇ ॥੩੪॥","translit_en":"fareedhaa kita(n)ee joban preet bin suk ge kumalai ||34||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Fareed, so many youths, without His Love, have dried up and withered away. ||34||","ms":"Farid! Myriad of youth have withered and dried up without the Lord's love."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਫਰੀਦ! (ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦੀ) ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਤੋਂ ਸੱਖਣੇ ਕਿਤਨੇ ਹੀ ਜੋਬਨ ਕੁਮਲਾ ਕੇ ਸੁੱਕ ਗਏ ।੩੪।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5243,"next":5245}}
files.shabads/10/5245.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5245,"source_id":"G","writer_id":21,"raag_id":41,"page_no":1379,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58616,"last_verse_id":58617,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Sheikh Fareed Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Fareed Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦ ਕ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58616,"page_no":1379,"line_no":13,"gurmukhi":"ਫਰੀਦਾ ਚਿੰਤ ਖਟੋਲਾ ਵਾਣੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਬਿਰਹਿ ਵਿਛਾਵਣ ਲੇਫੁ ॥","translit_en":"fareedhaa chi(n)t khaTolaa vaan dhukh bireh vichhaavan lef ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Fareed, anxiety is my bed, pain is my mattress, and the pain of separation is my blanket and quilt.","ms":"Farid! Anxiety is my cot, affliction is my bottom and pangs of separation from God my bedding and quilt."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਫਰੀਦ! (ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦੀ ਯਾਦ ਭੁਲਾ ਕੇ) ਚਿੰਤਾ (ਅਸਾਡੀ) ਨਿੱਕੀ ਜਿਹੀ ਮੰਜੀ (ਬਣੀ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ), ਦੁੱਖ (ਉਸ ਮੰਜੇ ਦਾ) ਵਾਣ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਵਿਛੋੜੇ ਦੇ ਕਾਰਣ (ਦੁੱਖ ਦੀ) ਤੁਲਾਈ ਤੇ ਲੇਫ਼ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":58617,"page_no":1379,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਏਹੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਜੀਵਣਾ ਤੂ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸਚੇ ਵੇਖੁ ॥੩੫॥","translit_en":"eh hamaaraa jeevanaa too saahib sache vekh ||35||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Behold, this is my life, O my True Lord and Master. ||35||","ms":"This is my life, see Thou, O my True Lord."},"pu":{"ss":" ਹੇ ਸੱਚੇ ਮਾਲਿਕ! ਵੇਖ, (ਤੈਥੋਂ ਵਿਛੁੜ ਕੇ) ਇਹ ਹੈ ਅਸਾਡਾ ਜੀਊਣ (ਦਾ ਹਾਲ) ।੩੫।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5244,"next":5246}}
files.shabads/10/5246.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5246,"source_id":"G","writer_id":21,"raag_id":41,"page_no":1379,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58618,"last_verse_id":58619,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Sheikh Fareed Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Fareed Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦ ਕ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58618,"page_no":1379,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਬਿਰਹਾ ਬਿਰਹਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਬਿਰਹਾ ਤੂ ਸੁਲਤਾਨੁ ॥","translit_en":"birahaa birahaa aakheeaai birahaa too sulataan ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Many talk of the pain and suffering of separation; O pain, you are the ruler of all.","ms":"Men, talk of the Lord's love and its pangs. O the Lord's pangs thou are the monarch of all."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹਰ ਕੋਈ ਆਖਦਾ ਹੈ (ਹਾਇ!) ਵਿਛੋੜਾ (ਬੁਰਾ) (ਹਾਇ!) ਵਿਛੋੜਾ (ਬੁਰਾ) । ਪਰ ਹੇ ਵਿਛੋੜੇ! ਤੂੰ ਪਾਤਸ਼ਾਹ ਹੈਂ ,"}}},{"verse_id":58619,"page_no":1379,"line_no":15,"gurmukhi":"ਫਰੀਦਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਤਨਿ ਬਿਰਹੁ ਨ ਊਪਜੈ ਸੋ ਤਨੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਮਸਾਨੁ ॥੩੬॥","translit_en":"fareedhaa jit tan birahu na uoopajai so tan jaan masaan ||36||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Fareed, that body, within which love of the Lord does not well up - look upon that body as a cremation ground. ||36||","ms":"Farid! The body, in which the Lord's love blossoms not, that body should be considered as the cremation ground."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਫਰੀਦ! ਜਿਸ ਸਰੀਰ ਵਿਚ ਵਿਛੋੜੇ ਦਾ ਸੱਲ ਨਹੀਂ ਪੈਦਾ ਹੁੰਦਾ ,ਉਸ ਸਰੀਰ ਨੂੰ ਮਸਾਣ ਸਮਝੋ ।੩੬।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5245,"next":5247}}
files.shabads/10/5247.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5247,"source_id":"G","writer_id":21,"raag_id":41,"page_no":1379,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58620,"last_verse_id":58621,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Sheikh Fareed Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Fareed Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦ ਕ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58620,"page_no":1379,"line_no":15,"gurmukhi":"ਫਰੀਦਾ ਏ ਵਿਸੁ ਗੰਦਲਾ ਧਰੀਆਂ ਖੰਡੁ ਲਿਵਾੜਿ ॥","translit_en":"fareedhaa e vis ga(n)dhalaa dhareeaa(n) kha(n)dd livaaR ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Fareed, these are poisonous sprouts coated with sugar.","ms":"Farid! These pleasures are the poisonous sprouts, coated with sugar."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਫਰੀਦ! ਇਹ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਦੇ ਪਦਾਰਥ (ਮਾਨੋ,) ਜ਼ਹਿਰ-ਭਰੀਆਂ ਗੰਦਲਾਂ ਹਨ, ਜੋ ਖੰਡ ਨਾਲ ਗਲੇਫ਼ ਰੱਖੀਆਂ ਹਨ । "}}},{"verse_id":58621,"page_no":1379,"line_no":16,"gurmukhi":"ਇਕਿ ਰਾਹੇਦੇ ਰਹਿ ਗਏ ਇਕਿ ਰਾਧੀ ਗਏ ਉਜਾੜਿ ॥੩੭॥","translit_en":"eik raahedhe reh ge ik raadhee ge ujaaR ||37||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Some die planting them, and some are ruined, harvesting and enjoying them. ||37||","ms":"Some die sowing sins and some are ruined, reaping and enjoying them."},"pu":{"ss":"ਇਹਨਾਂ ਗੰਦਲਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਕਈ ਬੀਜਦੇ ਹੀ ਮਰ ਗਏ ਤੇ, ਬੀਜੀਆਂ ਨੂੰ (ਵਿਚੇ ਹੀ) ਛੱਡ ਗਏ ।੩੭।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5246,"next":5248}}
files.shabads/10/5248.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5248,"source_id":"G","writer_id":21,"raag_id":41,"page_no":1379,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58622,"last_verse_id":58623,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Sheikh Fareed Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Fareed Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦ ਕ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58622,"page_no":1379,"line_no":16,"gurmukhi":"ਫਰੀਦਾ ਚਾਰਿ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਹੰਢਿ ਕੈ ਚਾਰਿ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਸੰਮਿ ॥","translit_en":"fareedhaa chaar gavaiaa ha(n)dd kai chaar gavaiaa sa(n)m ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Fareed, the hours of the day are lost wandering around, and the hours of the night are lost in sleep.","ms":"Farid! Men lose four watches of the day in wandering and the four of the night in sleep."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਫਰੀਦ!  ਚਾਰ (ਪਹਿਰ ਦਿਨ) ਤੂੰ ਦੌੜ-ਭੱਜ ਕੇ ਵਿਅਰਥ ਗੁਜ਼ਾਰ ਦਿੱਤਾ ਹੈ, ਤੇ ਚਾਰ (ਪਹਿਰ ਰਾਤਿ) ਸਉਂ ਕੇ ਗਵਾ ਦਿੱਤੀ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":58623,"page_no":1379,"line_no":17,"gurmukhi":"ਲੇਖਾ ਰਬੁ ਮੰਗੇਸੀਆ ਤੂ ਆਂਹੋ ਕੇਰ੍ਹੇ ਕੰਮਿ ॥੩੮॥","translit_en":"lekhaa rab ma(n)geseeaa too aa(n)ho kerhe ka(n)m ||38||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"God will call for your account, and ask you why you came into this world. ||38||","ms":"God will call for thine account and ask of thee the purpose for which thou come into the world?"},"pu":{"ss":"ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਹਿਸਾਬ ਮੰਗੇਗਾ ਕਿ (ਜਗਤ ਵਿਚ) ਤੂੰ ਕਿਸ ਕੰਮ ਆਇਆ ਸੈਂ ।੩੮।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5247,"next":5249}}
files.shabads/10/5249.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5249,"source_id":"G","writer_id":21,"raag_id":41,"page_no":1379,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58624,"last_verse_id":58625,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Sheikh Fareed Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Fareed Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦ ਕ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58624,"page_no":1379,"line_no":17,"gurmukhi":"ਫਰੀਦਾ ਦਰਿ ਦਰਵਾਜੈ ਜਾਇ ਕੈ ਕਿਉ ਡਿਠੋ ਘੜੀਆਲੁ ॥","translit_en":"fareedhaa dhar dharavaajai jai kai kiau ddiTho ghaReeaal ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Fareed, you have gone to the Lord's Door. Have you seen the gong there?","ms":"Farid! Going to the door of the court, why have thou not seen the gong?"},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਫਰੀਦ! ਕੀ (ਕਿਸੇ) ਬੂਹੇ ਤੇ (ਕਿਸੇ) ਦਰਵਾਜ਼ੇ ਤੇ ਜਾ ਕੇ (ਕਦੇ) ਘੜੀਆਲ (ਵੱਜਦਾ) ਵੇਖਿਆ ਈ? "}}},{"verse_id":58625,"page_no":1379,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਏਹੁ ਨਿਦੋਸਾਂ ਮਾਰੀਐ ਹਮ ਦੋਸਾਂ ਦਾ ਕਿਆ ਹਾਲੁ ॥੩੯॥","translit_en":"eh nidhosaa(n) maareeaai ham dhosaa(n) dhaa kiaa haal ||39||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"This blameless object is being beaten - imagine what is in store for us sinners! ||39||","ms":"The sinless in being beaten, what shall be the condition of us, the sinners?"},"pu":{"ss":"ਇਹ (ਘੜਿਆਲ) ਬੇ-ਦੋਸਾ (ਹੀ) ਮਾਰ ਖਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ, (ਭਲਾ) ਅਸਾਡਾ ਦੋਸੀਆਂ ਦਾ ਕੀਹ ਹਾਲ? ।੩੯।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5248,"next":5250}}
files.shabads/10/5250.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5250,"source_id":"G","writer_id":21,"raag_id":41,"page_no":1379,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58626,"last_verse_id":58627,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Sheikh Fareed Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Fareed Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦ ਕ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58626,"page_no":1379,"line_no":19,"gurmukhi":"ਘੜੀਏ ਘੜੀਏ ਮਾਰੀਐ ਪਹਰੀ ਲਹੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥","translit_en":"ghaRe'e ghaRe'e maareeaai paharee lahai sajai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Each and every hour, it is beaten; it is punished every day.","ms":"Every ghari, it is beaten and every watch, it receives punishment."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹਰੇਕ ਘੜੀ ਪਿਛੋਂ ਮਾਰ ਪੈਂਦੀ ਹੈ, ਹਰੇਕ ਪਹਿਰ ਮਗਰੋਂ (ਇਹ) ਕੁੱਟ ਖਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ । "}}},{"verse_id":58627,"page_no":1379,"line_no":19,"gurmukhi":"ਸੋ ਹੇੜਾ ਘੜੀਆਲ ਜਿਉ ਡੁਖੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥੪੦॥","translit_en":"so heRaa ghaReeaal jiau ddukhee rain vihai ||40||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"This beautiful body is like the gong; it passes the night in pain. ||40||","ms":"The beauteous body is like the bell and passes the night in pain."},"pu":{"ss":"ਘੜੀਆਲ ਵਾਂਗ ਹੀ ਹੈ ਉਹ ਸਰੀਰ , ਉਸ ਦੀ (ਜ਼ਿੰਦਗੀ-ਰੂਪ) ਰਾਤਿ ਦੁੱਖਾਂ ਵਿਚ ਹੀ ਬੀਤਦੀ ਹੈ ।੪੦।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5249,"next":5251}}
files.shabads/10/5251.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5251,"source_id":"G","writer_id":21,"raag_id":41,"page_no":1380,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58628,"last_verse_id":58629,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Sheikh Fareed Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Fareed Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦ ਕ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58628,"page_no":1380,"line_no":1,"gurmukhi":"ਬੁਢਾ ਹੋਆ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦੁ ਕੰਬਣਿ ਲਗੀ ਦੇਹ ॥","translit_en":"buddaa hoaa sekh fareedh ka(n)ban lagee dheh ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Shaykh Fareed has grown old, and his body has begun to tremble.","ms":"Shaikh Farid has grown old and his body has begun to tremble."},"pu":{"ss":"ਸ਼ੇਖ਼ ਫਰੀਦ (ਹੁਣ) ਬੁੱਢਾ ਹੋ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ, ਸਰੀਰ ਕੰਬਣ ਲੱਗ ਪਿਆ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":58629,"page_no":1380,"line_no":1,"gurmukhi":"ਜੇ ਸਉ ਵਰਿੑਆ ਜੀਵਣਾ ਭੀ ਤਨੁ ਹੋਸੀ ਖੇਹ ॥੪੧॥","translit_en":"je sau vari(h)aa jeevanaa bhee tan hosee kheh ||41||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Even if he could live for hundreds of years, his body will eventually turn to dust. ||41||","ms":"Even if he lives for hundreds of years, his body shall ultimately become dust."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜੇ ਸਉ ਵਰ੍ਹੇ ਭੀ ਜੀਊਣਾ ਮਿਲ ਜਾਏ, ਤਾਂ ਭੀ (ਅੰਤ ਨੂੰ) ਸਰੀਰ ਮਿੱਟੀ ਹੋ ਜਾਇਗਾ (ਤੇ ਇਹਨਾਂ ‘ਵਿਸੁ ਗੰਦਲਾਂ’ ਤੋਂ ਸਾਥ ਟੁੱਟ ਜਾਇਗਾ) ।੪੧।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5250,"next":5252}}
files.shabads/10/5252.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5252,"source_id":"G","writer_id":21,"raag_id":41,"page_no":1380,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58630,"last_verse_id":58631,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Sheikh Fareed Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Fareed Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦ ਕ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58630,"page_no":1380,"line_no":1,"gurmukhi":"ਫਰੀਦਾ ਬਾਰਿ ਪਰਾਇਐ ਬੈਸਣਾ ਸਾਂਈ ਮੁਝੈ ਨ ਦੇਹਿ ॥","translit_en":"fareedhaa baar paraiaai baisanaa saa(n)iee mujhai na dheh ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Fareed begs, O Lord, do not make me sit at another's door.","ms":"My Lord, make Thou me not sit at another's door, begs Farid."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਫਰੀਦ! (ਆਖ—) ਹੇ ਸਾਂਈਂ! (ਇਹਨਾਂ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਦੇ ਪਦਾਰਥਾਂ ਦੀ ਖ਼ਾਤਰ) ਮੈਨੂੰ ਪਰਾਏ ਬੂਹੇ ਤੇ ਬੈਠਣ ਨਾਹ ਦੇਈਂ ।"}}},{"verse_id":58631,"page_no":1380,"line_no":2,"gurmukhi":"ਜੇ ਤੂ ਏਵੈ ਰਖਸੀ ਜੀਉ ਸਰੀਰਹੁ ਲੇਹਿ ॥੪੨॥","translit_en":"je too evai rakhasee jeeau sareerahu leh ||42||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If this is the way you are going to keep me, then go ahead and take the life out of my body. ||42||","ms":"If Thou are to keep me thiswise then, take Thou out the life from my body."},"pu":{"ss":"ਪਰ ਜੇ ਤੂੰ ਇਸੇ ਤਰ੍ਹਾਂ ਰੱਖਣਾ ਹੈ (ਭਾਵ, ਜੇ ਤੂੰ ਮੈਨੂੰ ਦੂਜਿਆਂ ਦਾ ਮੁਥਾਜ ਬਣਾਣਾ ਹੈ) ਤਾਂ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਰੀਰ ਵਿਚੋਂ ਜਿੰਦ ਕੱਢ ਲੈ ।੪੨।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5251,"next":5253}}
files.shabads/10/5253.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5253,"source_id":"G","writer_id":21,"raag_id":41,"page_no":1380,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58632,"last_verse_id":58633,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Sheikh Fareed Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Fareed Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦ ਕ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58632,"page_no":1380,"line_no":2,"gurmukhi":"ਕੰਧਿ ਕੁਹਾੜਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਘੜਾ ਵਣਿ ਕੈ ਸਰੁ ਲੋਹਾਰੁ ॥","translit_en":"ka(n)dh kuhaaRaa sir ghaRaa van kai sar lohaar ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"With the axe on his shoulder, and a bucket on his head, the blacksmith is ready to cut down the tree.","ms":"With an axe on him shoulder and water-pot on his head, the blacksmith is ready to cut (standing on the head)."},"pu":{"ss":"ਮੋਢੇ ਉੱਤੇ ਕੁਹਾੜਾ ਤੇ ਸਿਰ ਉਤੇ ਘੜਾ (ਰੱਖੀ) ਲੋਹਾਰ ਜੰਗਲ ਵਿਚ ਬਾਦਸ਼ਾਹ (ਬਣਿਆ ਹੁੰਦਾ) ਹੈ "}}},{"verse_id":58633,"page_no":1380,"line_no":3,"gurmukhi":"ਫਰੀਦਾ ਹਉ ਲੋੜੀ ਸਹੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਤੂ ਲੋੜਹਿ ਅੰਗਿਆਰ ॥੪੩॥","translit_en":"fareedhaa hau loRee sahu aapanaa too loReh a(n)giaar ||43||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Fareed, I long for my Lord; you long only for the charcoal. ||43||","ms":"Farid! I long for my Spouse and thou long for charcoal."},"pu":{"ss":" ਹੇ ਫਰੀਦ! ਮੈਂ ਤਾਂ ਆਪਣੇ ਮਾਲਕ-ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਲੱਭ ਰਿਹਾ ਹਾਂ, ਤੇ, ਤੂੰ, (ਹੇ ਜੀਵ! ਲੋਹਾਰ ਵਾਂਗ) ਕੋਲੇ ਲੱਭ ਰਿਹਾ ਹੈਂ ।੪੩।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5252,"next":5254}}
files.shabads/10/5254.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5254,"source_id":"G","writer_id":21,"raag_id":41,"page_no":1380,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58634,"last_verse_id":58635,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Sheikh Fareed Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Fareed Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦ ਕ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58634,"page_no":1380,"line_no":3,"gurmukhi":"ਫਰੀਦਾ ਇਕਨਾ ਆਟਾ ਅਗਲਾ ਇਕਨਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਲੋਣੁ ॥","translit_en":"fareedhaa ikanaa aaTaa agalaa ikanaa naahee lon ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Fareed, some have lots of flour, while others do not even have salt.","ms":"Farid! Some have a good deal of flour and some do not have even the salt."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਫਰੀਦ! ਕਈ ਬੰਦਿਆਂ ਪਾਸ ਆਟਾ ਬਹੁਤ ਹੈ ਇਕਨਾਂ ਪਾਸ (ਇਤਨਾ ਭੀ) ਨਹੀਂ ਜਿਤਨਾ (ਆਟੇ ਵਿਚ) ਲੂਣ (ਪਾਈਦਾ) ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":58635,"page_no":1380,"line_no":4,"gurmukhi":"ਅਗੈ ਗਏ ਸਿੰਞਾਪਸਨਿ ਚੋਟਾਂ ਖਾਸੀ ਕਉਣੁ ॥੪੪॥","translit_en":"agai ge si(n)n(j)aapasan choTaa(n) khaasee kaun ||44||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"When they go beyond this world, it shall be seen, who will be punished. ||44||","ms":"When they both go into the yond, it shall then be known, who shall suffer the strokes?"},"pu":{"ss":"ਅੱਗੇ ਜਾ ਕੇ (ਅਮਲਾਂ ਉੱਤੇ) ਪਛਾਣ ਹੋਵੇਗੀ ਕਿ ਮਾਰ ਕਿਸ ਨੂੰ ਪੈਂਦੀ ਹੈ ।੪੪।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5253,"next":5255}}
files.shabads/10/5255.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5255,"source_id":"G","writer_id":21,"raag_id":41,"page_no":1380,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58636,"last_verse_id":58637,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Sheikh Fareed Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Fareed Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦ ਕ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58636,"page_no":1380,"line_no":4,"gurmukhi":"ਪਾਸਿ ਦਮਾਮੇ ਛਤੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਭੇਰੀ ਸਡੋ ਰਡ ॥","translit_en":"paas dhamaame chhat sir bheree saddo radd ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Drums were beaten in their honor, there were canopies above their heads, and bugles announced their coming.","ms":"They, who had drums and trumpets and umbrellas over their heads and whose praises the bards sang;"},"pu":{"ss":"(ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਲੋਕਾਂ ਦੇ) ਪਾਸ ਧੌਂਸੇ (ਵੱਜਦੇ ਸਨ), ਸਿਰ ਉੱਤੇ ਛਤਰ (ਝੁਲਦੇ ਸਨ), ਤੂਤੀਆਂ (ਵੱਜਦੀਆਂ ਸਨ) ਉਸਤਤੀ ਦੇ ਛੰਦ (ਗਾਂਵੇ ਜਾਂਦੇ ਸਨ),"}}},{"verse_id":58637,"page_no":1380,"line_no":5,"gurmukhi":"ਜਾਇ ਸੁਤੇ ਜੀਰਾਣ ਮਹਿ ਥੀਏ ਅਤੀਮਾ ਗਡ ॥੪੫॥","translit_en":"jai sute jeeraan meh the'ee ateemaa gadd ||45||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"They have gone to sleep in the cemetary, buried like poor orphans. ||45||","ms":"They have gone to sleep in the cemetery and are buried like orphans."},"pu":{"ss":"ਉਹ ਭੀ ਆਖ਼ਰ ਮਸਾਣਾਂ ਵਿਚ ਜਾ ਸੁੱਤੇ, ਤੇ ਯਤੀਮਾਂ ਨਾਲ ਜਾ ਰਲੇ (ਭਾਵ, ਯਤੀਮਾਂ ਵਰਗੇ ਹੀ ਹੋ ਗਏ) ।੪੫।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5254,"next":5256}}

Those who built houses, mansions and lofty buildings, they have also departed."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਫਰੀਦ!  ਘਰ ਮਹਲ ਮਾੜੀਆਂ ਉਸਾਰਨ ਵਾਲੇ ਭੀ (ਇਹਨਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਛੱਡ ਕੇ) ਚਲੇ ਗਏ । "}}},{"verse_id":58639,"page_no":1380,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਕੂੜਾ ਸਉਦਾ ਕਰਿ ਗਏ ਗੋਰੀ ਆਇ ਪਏ ॥੪੬॥","translit_en":"kooRaa saudhaa kar ge goree aai pe ||46||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"They made false deals, and were dropped into their graves. ||46||","ms":"They transacted false business and dropped into graves."},"pu":{"ss":"ਉਹੋ ਹੀ ਸਉਦਾ ਕੀਤੋ ਨੇ, ਜੋ ਨਾਲ ਨਾਹ ਨਿਭਿਆ ਤੇ (ਅੰਤ ਖ਼ਾਲੀ ਹੱਥ) ਕਬਰੀਂ ਜਾ ਪਏ ।੪੬।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5255,"next":5257}}

files.shabads/10/5272.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5272,"source_id":"G","writer_id":21,"raag_id":41,"page_no":1381,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58677,"last_verse_id":58678,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Sheikh Fareed Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Fareed Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦ ਕ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58677,"page_no":1381,"line_no":5,"gurmukhi":"ਜਾਂ ਕੁਆਰੀ ਤਾ ਚਾਉ ਵੀਵਾਹੀ ਤਾਂ ਮਾਮਲੇ ॥","translit_en":"jaa(n) kuaaree taa chaau veevaahee taa(n) maamale ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"When she is unmarried she is full of desire; but when she is married, then her troubles begin.","ms":"When the girl is a virgin, then she is full of desire and when she is married, then begin her troubles."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਦੋਂ (ਲੜਕੀ) ਕੁਆਰੀ ਹੁੰਦੀ ਹੈ ਤਦੋਂ (ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਵਿਆਹ ਦਾ) ਚਾਉ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ (ਪਰ ਜਦੋਂ) ਵਿਆਹੀ ਜਾਂਦੀ ਹੈ ਤਾਂ ਜੰਜਾਲ ਪੈ ਜਾਂਦੇ ਹਨ ।"}}},{"verse_id":58678,"page_no":1381,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਫਰੀਦਾ ਏਹੋ ਪਛੋਤਾਉ ਵਤਿ ਕੁਆਰੀ ਨ ਥੀਐ ॥੬੩॥","translit_en":"fareedhaa eho pachhotaau vat kuaaree na theeaai ||63||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Fareed, she has this one regret, that she cannot be a unmarried again. ||63||","ms":"Farid! She has this regret, that she cannot be a virgin again."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਫਰੀਦ! (ਉਸ ਵੇਲੇ) ਇਹੀ ਪਛੁਤਾਵਾ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਉਹ ਮੁੜ ਕੁਆਰੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੋ ਸਕਦੀ ।੬੩।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5271,"next":5273}}
files.shabads/10/5273.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5273,"source_id":"G","writer_id":21,"raag_id":41,"page_no":1381,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58679,"last_verse_id":58680,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Sheikh Fareed Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Fareed Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦ ਕ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58679,"page_no":1381,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਕਲਰ ਕੇਰੀ ਛਪੜੀ ਆਇ ਉਲਥੇ ਹੰਝ ॥","translit_en":"kalar keree chhapaRee aai ulathe ha(n)jh ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The swans have landed in a small pond of salt water.","ms":"The swans have alighted in a small pond of saline water."},"pu":{"ss":"ਕੱਲਰ ਦੀ ਛੱਪਰੀ ਵਿਚ ਹੰਸ ਆ ਉਤਰਦੇ ਹਨ, "}}},{"verse_id":58680,"page_no":1381,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਚਿੰਜੂ ਬੋੜਨਿੑ ਨਾ ਪੀਵਹਿ ਉਡਣ ਸੰਦੀ ਡੰਝ ॥੬੪॥","translit_en":"chi(n)joo boRani(h) naa peeveh uddan sa(n)dhee dda(n)jh ||64||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"They dip in their bills, but do not drink; they fly away, still thirsty. ||64||"},"pu":{"ss":"ਚੰੁਝ ਡੋਬਦੇ ਹਨ, (ਪਰ, ਉਹ ਮੈਲਾ ਪਾਣੀ) ਨਹੀਂ ਪੀਂਦੇ, ਉਹਨਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਉਥੋਂ ਉੱਡ ਜਾਣ ਦੀ ਤਾਂਘ ਲੱਗੀ ਰਹਿੰਦੀ ਹੈ ।੬੪।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5272,"next":5274}}
files.shabads/10/5274.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5274,"source_id":"G","writer_id":21,"raag_id":41,"page_no":1381,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58681,"last_verse_id":58682,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Sheikh Fareed Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Fareed Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦ ਕ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58681,"page_no":1381,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਹੰਸੁ ਉਡਰਿ ਕੋਧ੍ਰੈ ਪਇਆ ਲੋਕੁ ਵਿਡਾਰਣਿ ਜਾਇ ॥","translit_en":"ha(n)s uddar kodhrai piaa lok viddaaran jai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The swans fly away, and land in the fields of grain. The people go to chase them away.","ms":"Flying away, the swans alight on the barley-farm and men go to drive them away."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੰਸ ਉੱਡ ਕੇ ਕੋਧਰੇ ਦੀ ਪੈਲੀ ਵਿਚ ਜਾ ਬੈਠਾ ਤਾਂ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਦੇ ਬੰਦੇ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਉਡਾਣ ਜਾਂਦੇ ਹਨ ।"}}},{"verse_id":58682,"page_no":1381,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਗਹਿਲਾ ਲੋਕੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਦਾ ਹੰਸੁ ਨ ਕੋਧ੍ਰਾ ਖਾਇ ॥੬੫॥","translit_en":"gahilaa lok na jaanadhaa ha(n)s na kodhraa khai ||65||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The thoughtless people do not know, that the swans do not eat the grain. ||65||","ms":"The headless mortals know not, that the swans eat not the coarse grain."},"pu":{"ss":" ਕਮਲੀ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਇਹ ਨਹੀਂ ਜਾਣਦੀ ਕਿ ਹੰਸ ਕੋਧਰਾ ਨਹੀਂ ਖਾਂਦਾ ।੬੫।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5273,"next":5275}}
files.shabads/10/5275.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5275,"source_id":"G","writer_id":21,"raag_id":41,"page_no":1381,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58683,"last_verse_id":58684,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Sheikh Fareed Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Fareed Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦ ਕ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58683,"page_no":1381,"line_no":8,"gurmukhi":"ਚਲਿ ਚਲਿ ਗਈਆਂ ਪੰਖੀਆਂ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਵਸਾਏ ਤਲ ॥","translit_en":"chal chal gieeaa(n) pa(n)kheeaa(n) jin(h)ee vasaae tal ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The birds which lived in the pools have flown away and left.","ms":"The birds, which peopled the pools, have flown away."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਫਰੀਦ! ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ (ਜੀਵ-) ਪੰਛੀਆਂ ਦੀਆਂ ਡਾਰਾਂ ਨੇ ਇਸ (ਸੰਸਾਰ-) ਤਲਾਬ ਨੂੰ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਾ ਬਣਾਇਆ ਹੋਇਆ ਹੈ, ਉਹ ਆਪੋ ਆਪਣੀ ਵਾਰੀ (ਇਸ ਨੂੰ ਛੱਡ ਕੇ) ਟੁਰੀਆਂ ਜਾ ਰਹੀਆਂ ਹਨ ।"}}},{"verse_id":58684,"page_no":1381,"line_no":8,"gurmukhi":"ਫਰੀਦਾ ਸਰੁ ਭਰਿਆ ਭੀ ਚਲਸੀ ਥਕੇ ਕਵਲ ਇਕਲ ॥੬੬॥","translit_en":"fareedhaa sar bhariaa bhee chalasee thake kaval ikal ||66||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Fareed, the overflowing pool shall also pass away, and only the lotus flowers shall remain. ||66||","ms":"Farid! files.shabads/10/5276.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5276,"source_id":"G","writer_id":21,"raag_id":41,"page_no":1381,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58685,"last_verse_id":58686,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Sheikh Fareed Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Fareed Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦ ਕ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58685,"page_no":1381,"line_no":9,"gurmukhi":"ਫਰੀਦਾ ਇਟ ਸਿਰਾਣੇ ਭੁਇ ਸਵਣੁ ਕੀੜਾ ਲੜਿਓ ਮਾਸਿ ॥","translit_en":"fareedhaa iT siraane bhui savan keeRaa laRio maas ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Fareed, a stone will be your pillow, and the earth will be your bed. Brick shall be thy pillow, the earth thy bed to sleep and the worms shall eat thy flesh."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਫਰੀਦ! ਸਿਰ ਹੇਠ ਇੱਟ ਹੋਵੇਗੀ, ਧਰਤੀ ਵਿਚ (ਭਾਵ, ਤੂੰ ਕਬਰ ਵਿਚ) ਸੁੱਤਾ ਪਿਆ ਹੋਵੇਂਗਾ,  ਪਿੰਡੇ ਵਿਚ ਕੀੜੇ ਤੁਰਦੇ ਹੋਣਗੇ । "}}},{"verse_id":58686,"page_no":1381,"line_no":9,"gurmukhi":"ਕੇਤੜਿਆ ਜੁਗ ਵਾਪਰੇ ਇਕਤੁ ਪਇਆ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੬੭॥","translit_en":"ketaRiaa jug vaapare ikat piaa paas ||67||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Countless ages will pass, and you will still be lying on one side. ||67||","ms":"Good many ages shall pass away and thou shall continue to lye on one side."},"pu":{"ss":"ਇੱਕੋ ਪਾਸੇ ਪਿਆਂ ਢੇਰ ਲੰਮਾ ਸਮਾਂ ਲੰਘ ਜਾਇਗਾ (ਤਦੋਂ ਤੈਨੂੰ ਕਿਸੇ ਜਗਾਣਾ ਨਹੀਂ, ਹੁਣ ਤਾਂ ਗ਼ਾਫ਼ਿਲ ਹੋ ਕੇ ਨਾ ਸਉਂ) ।੬੭।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5275,"next":5277}}
files.shabads/10/5277.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5277,"source_id":"G","writer_id":21,"raag_id":41,"page_no":1381,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58687,"last_verse_id":58688,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Sheikh Fareed Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Fareed Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦ ਕ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58687,"page_no":1381,"line_no":10,"gurmukhi":"ਫਰੀਦਾ ਭੰਨੀ ਘੜੀ ਸਵੰਨਵੀ ਟੁਟੀ ਨਾਗਰ ਲਜੁ ॥","translit_en":"fareedhaa bha(n)nee ghaRee sava(n)navee TuTee naagar laj ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Fareed, your beautiful body shall break apart, and the subtle thread of the breath shall be snapped.","ms":"Farid the beauteous body pitcher, shall break and the sublime rope of breath shall be snapped."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਫਰੀਦ! ਸੰੁਦਰ ਰੰਗ ਵਾਲਾ ਭਾਂਡਾ ਭੱਜ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ (ਅਤੇ ਸੁਆਸਾਂ ਦੀ) ਸੋਹਣੀ ਲੱਜ ਟੁੱਟ ਗਈ ਹੈ? "}}},{"verse_id":58688,"page_no":1381,"line_no":10,"gurmukhi":"ਅਜਰਾਈਲੁ ਫਰੇਸਤਾ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਨਾਠੀ ਅਜੁ ॥੬੮॥","translit_en":"ajaraieel faresataa kai ghar naaThee aj ||68||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"In which house will the Messenger of Death be a guest today? ||68||","ms":"In whose house shall Azaril, the death's courier, be the guest today?"},"pu":{"ss":"ਅੱਜ ਕਿਸ ਦੇ ਘਰ (ਮੌਤ ਦਾ) ਫ਼ਰਿਸਤਾ ਅਜ਼ਰਾਈਲ ਪ੍ਰਾਹੁਣਾ ਹੈ? ਤਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਕਿਉਂ ਗ਼ਾਫ਼ਿਲ ਹੋ ਕੇ ਸੁੱਤਾ ਪਿਆ ਹੈਂ? ।੬੮।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5276,"next":5278}}

files.shabads/10/5289.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5289,"source_id":"G","writer_id":21,"raag_id":41,"page_no":1382,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58714,"last_verse_id":58715,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Sheikh Fareed Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Fareed Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦ ਕ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58714,"page_no":1382,"line_no":3,"gurmukhi":"ਫਰੀਦਾ ਮੈ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਮੁਝ ਕੂ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਬਾਇਐ ਜਗਿ ॥","translit_en":"fareedhaa mai jaaniaa dhukh mujh koo dhukh sabaiaai jag ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Fareed, I thought that I was in trouble; the whole world is in trouble!","ms":"Farid! My day passes in trouble and my night in anguish."},"pu":{"ss":" ਹੇ ਫਰੀਦ!  ਦਿਨ ਦੁੱਖਾਂ ਵਿਚ ਲੰਘਦਾ ਹੈ, ਰਾਤ ਭੀ (ਚਿੰਤਾ ਦੀਆਂ) ਚੋਭਾਂ ਵਿਚ ਬੀਤਦੀ ਹੈ । "}}},{"verse_id":58725,"page_no":1382,"line_no":8,"gurmukhi":"ਖੜਾ ਪੁਕਾਰੇ ਪਾਤਣੀ ਬੇੜਾ ਕਪਰ ਵਾਤਿ ॥੮੫॥","translit_en":"khaRaa pukaare paatanee beRaa kapar vaat ||85||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The boatman stands up and shouts, \"\"The boat is caught in the whirlpool!\"\"||85||","ms":"The boatman stands up and shouts, \"The ship is in the midst of the whirl-pool\"."},"pu":{"ss":"(ਕੰਢੇ ਤੇ) ਖਲੋਤਾ ਹੋਇਆ (ਗੁਰੂ-) ਮਲਾਹ ਇਹਨਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਉੱਚੀ ਉੱਚੀ ਕਹਿ ਰਿਹਾ ਹੈ (ਕਿ ਤੁਹਾਡਾ ਜ਼ਿੰਦਗੀ ਦਾ) ਬੇੜਾ (ਦੁੱਖਾਂ ਦੀਆਂ) ਠਾਠਾਂ ਦੇ ਮੂੰਹ ਵਿਚ (ਆ ਡਿੱਗਣ ਲੱਗਾ) ਹੈ ।੮੫।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5292,"next":5294}}
files.shabads/10/5294.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5294,"source_id":"G","writer_id":21,"raag_id":41,"page_no":1382,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58726,"last_verse_id":58727,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Sheikh Fareed Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Fareed Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦ ਕ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58726,"page_no":1382,"line_no":8,"gurmukhi":"ਲੰਮੀ ਲੰਮੀ ਨਦੀ ਵਹੈ ਕੰਧੀ ਕੇਰੈ ਹੇਤਿ ॥","translit_en":"la(n)mee la(n)mee nadhee vahai ka(n)dhee kerai het ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The river flows on and on; it loves to eat into its banks.","ms":"Long, the long river of life flows and if loves to eat into its banks."},"pu":{"ss":"ਕੰਧੀ (ਰੁੱਖੜਿਆਂ) ਨੂੰ ਢਾਹੁਣ ਲਈ (ਭਾਵ, ਦੁੱਖੀ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ) (ਇਹ ਰੁੱਖਾਂ ਦੀ) ਬੇਅੰਤ ਲੰਮੀ ਨਦੀ ਵਗ ਰਹੀ ਹੈ, "}}},{"verse_id":58727,"page_no":1382,"line_no":9,"gurmukhi":"ਬੇੜੇ ਨੋ ਕਪਰੁ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇ ਜੇ ਪਾਤਣ ਰਹੈ ਸੁਚੇਤਿ ॥੮੬॥","translit_en":"beRe no kapar kiaa kare je paatan rahai suchet ||86||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"What can the whirlpool do to the boat, if the boatman remains alert? ||86||","ms":"What can the whirl-pool do unto the boat, if the boatman remains alert?"},"pu":{"ss":"(ਪਰ ਇਸ ਨਦੀ ਦਾ) ਘੰੁਮਣ-ਘੇਰ (ਉਸ ਜ਼ਿੰਦਗੀ-ਰੂਪ) ਬੇੜੇ ਦਾ ਕੋਈ ਨੁਕਸਾਨ ਨਹੀਂ ਕਰ ਸਕਦਾ, ਜੋ (ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ) ਮਲਾਹ ਦੇ ਚੇਤੇ ਵਿਚ ਰਹੇ ।੮੬।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5293,"next":5295}}
files.shabads/10/5295.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5295,"source_id":"G","writer_id":21,"raag_id":41,"page_no":1382,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58728,"last_verse_id":58729,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Sheikh Fareed Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Fareed Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦ ਕ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58728,"page_no":1382,"line_no":9,"gurmukhi":"ਫਰੀਦਾ ਗਲਂੀ ਸੁ ਸਜਣ ਵੀਹ ਇਕੁ ਢੂੰਢੇਦੀ ਨ ਲਹਾਂ ॥","translit_en":"fareedhaa gala(n)ee su sajan veeh ik ddoo(n)ddedhee na lahaa(n) ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Fareed, there are dozens who say they are friends; I search, but I cannot find even one.","ms":"Farid! There are twenty friends who provide lip service, however, if I search for the true friend, I find not even one."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਫਰੀਦ! ਗੱਲਾਂ ਨਾਲ ਪਤਿਆਉਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਤਾਂ ਵੀਹ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ (ਮਿਲ ਪੈਂਦੇ) ਹਨ; ਪਰ ਖੋਜ ਕਰਨ ਲੱਗਿਆਂ ਅਸਲ ਸੱਚਾ ਮਿੱਤਰ ਨਹੀਂ ਲੱਭਦਾ ,"}}},{"verse_id":58729,"page_no":1382,"line_no":10,"gurmukhi":"ਧੁਖਾਂ ਜਿਉ ਮਾਂਲੀਹ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਤਿੰਨੑਾ ਮਾ ਪਿਰੀ ॥੮੭॥","translit_en":"dhukhaa(n) jiau maa(n)leeh kaaran ti(n)n(h)aa maa piree ||87||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"I yearn for my beloved like a smouldering fire. ||87||","ms":"I smoulder like cow-dung for that beloved of mine."},"pu":{"ss":"ਮੈਂ ਤਾਂ ਇਹੋ ਜਿਹੇ (ਸਤ-ਸੰਗੀ) ਸੱਜਣਾਂ ਦੇ (ਨਾਹ ਮਿਲਣ) ਕਰਕੇ ਧੁਖਦੀ ਮਿਲੀ ਵਾਂਗ ਅੰਦਰੇ ਅੰਦਰ ਦੁਖੀ ਹੋ ਰਿਹਾ ਹਾਂ ।੮੭।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5294,"next":5296}}

"}}},{"verse_id":58731,"page_no":1382,"line_no":11,"gurmukhi":"ਕੰਨੀ ਬੁਜੇ ਦੇ ਰਹਾਂ ਕਿਤੀ ਵਗੈ ਪਉਣੁ ॥੮੮॥","translit_en":"ka(n)nee buje dhe rahaa(n) kitee vagai paun ||88||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"I have put plugs in my ears; I don't care how much the wind is blowing. ||88||","ms":"I have put stoppers in mine ears. God's dates have ripened and streams of honey flow."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਫਰੀਦ! ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਦੀਆਂ ਪੱਕੀਆਂ ਹੋਈਆਂ ਖਜੂਰਾਂ (ਦਿੱਸ ਰਹੀਆਂ ਹਨ), ਅਤੇ ਸ਼ਹਿਦ ਦੀਆਂ ਨਦੀਆਂ ਵਗ ਰਹੀਆਂ ਹਨ ,"}}},{"verse_id":58733,"page_no":1382,"line_no":12,"gurmukhi":"ਜੋ ਜੋ ਵੰਞੈਂ ਡੀਹੜਾ ਸੋ ਉਮਰ ਹਥ ਪਵੰਨਿ ॥੮੯॥","translit_en":"jo jo va(n)n(j)ai(n) ddeehaRaa so umar hath pava(n)n ||89||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"With each passing day, your life is being stolen away. ||89||","ms":"Each day that passes steals away mortal's age."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜੋ ਜੋ ਦਿਹਾੜਾ ਬੀਤਦਾ ਹੈ, ਉਹ ਇਸ ਦੀ ਉਮਰ ਨੂੰ ਹੀ ਹੱਥ ਪੈ ਰਹੇ ਹਨ (ਭਾਵ, ਅਜ਼ਾਈਂ ਜਾ ਰਹੇ ਹਨ) ।੮੯।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5296,"next":5298}}
files.shabads/10/5298.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5298,"source_id":"G","writer_id":21,"raag_id":41,"page_no":1382,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58734,"last_verse_id":58735,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Sheikh Fareed Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Fareed Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦ ਕ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58734,"page_no":1382,"line_no":12,"gurmukhi":"ਫਰੀਦਾ ਤਨੁ ਸੁਕਾ ਪਿੰਜਰੁ ਥੀਆ ਤਲੀਆਂ ਖੂੰਡਹਿ ਕਾਗ ॥","translit_en":"fareedhaa tan sukaa pi(n)jar theeaa taleeaa(n) khoo(n)ddeh kaag ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Fareed, my withered body has become a skeleton; the crows are pecking at my palms.","ms":"Farid! My aged frail body has become a skeleton and the crows peck at my palms."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਫਰੀਦ! ਇਹ ਭੌਂਕਾ) ਸਰੀਰ (ਵਿਸ਼ੇ-ਵਿਕਾਰਾਂ ਵਿਚ ਪੈ ਪੈ ਕੇ) ਡਾਢਾ ਮਾੜਾ ਹੋ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ, ਹੱਡੀਆਂ ਦੀ ਮੁੱਠ ਰਹਿ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ ,ਕਾਂ ਇਸ ਦੀਆਂ ਤਲੀਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਠੂੰਗੇ ਮਾਰੀ ਜਾ ਰਹੇ ਹਨ ,"}}},{"verse_id":58735,"page_no":1382,"line_no":13,"gurmukhi":"ਅਜੈ ਸੁ ਰਬੁ ਨ ਬਾਹੁੜਿਓ ਦੇਖੁ ਬੰਦੇ ਕੇ ਭਾਗ ॥੯੦॥","translit_en":"ajai su rab na baahuRio dhekh ba(n)dhe ke bhaag ||90||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Even now, God has not come to help me; behold, this is the fate of all mortal beings. ||90||","ms":"Even till now, God has not come to my aid, see thou, that such is the fate of the man."},"pu":{"ss":" ਵੇਖੋ,ਮਨੁੱਖ ਦੀ ਕਿਸਮਤ ਭੀ ਅਜੀਬ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਅਜੇ ਭੀ ਰੱਬ ਇਸ ਉਤੇ ਤ੍ਰੁੱਠਾ ਨਹੀਂ (ਭਾਵ, ਇਸ ਦੀ ਝਾਕ ਮਿਟੀ ਨਹੀਂ) ।੯੦।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5297,"next":5299}}
files.shabads/10/5299.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5299,"source_id":"G","writer_id":21,"raag_id":41,"page_no":1382,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58736,"last_verse_id":58737,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Sheikh Fareed Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Fareed Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦ ਕ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58736,"page_no":1382,"line_no":13,"gurmukhi":"ਕਾਗਾ ਕਰੰਗ ਢੰਢੋਲਿਆ ਸਗਲਾ ਖਾਇਆ ਮਾਸੁ ॥","translit_en":"kaagaa kara(n)g dda(n)ddoliaa sagalaa khaiaa maas ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The crows have searched my skeleton, and eaten all my flesh.","ms":"The crows have searched my skeleton and eaten up all flesh."},"pu":{"ss":" ਕਾਵਾਂ ਨੇ ਪਿੰਜਰ ਭੀ ਫੋਲ ਮਾਰਿਆ ਹੈ, ਅਤੇ ਸਾਰਾ ਮਾਸ ਖਾ ਲਿਆ ਹੈ ,"}}},{"verse_id":58737,"page_no":1382,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਏ ਦੁਇ ਨੈਨਾ ਮਤਿ ਛੁਹਉ ਪਿਰ ਦੇਖਨ ਕੀ ਆਸ ॥੯੧॥","translit_en":"e dhui nainaa mat chhuhau pir dhekhan kee aas ||91||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"But please do not touch these eyes; I hope to see my Lord. ||91||"},"pu":{"ss":" ਰੱਬ ਕਰ ਕੇ ਕੋਈ ਵਿਕਾਰ (ਮੇਰੀਆਂ) ਅੱਖਾਂ ਅੱਖਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਨਾਹ ਛੇੜੇ, ਇਹਨਾਂ ਵਿਚ ਤਾਂ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਵੇਖਣ ਦੀ ਤਾਂਘ ਟਿਕੀ ਰਹੇ ।੯੧।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5298,"next":5300}}
files.shabads/10/5300.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5300,"source_id":"G","writer_id":21,"raag_id":41,"page_no":1382,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58738,"last_verse_id":58739,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Sheikh Fareed Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Fareed Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦ ਕ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58738,"page_no":1382,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਕਾਗਾ ਚੂੰਡਿ ਨ ਪਿੰਜਰਾ ਬਸੈ ਤ ਉਡਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥","translit_en":"kaagaa choo(n)dd na pi(n)jaraa basai ta uddar jaeh ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O crow, do not peck at my skeleton; if you have landed on it, fly away.","ms":"O Crow, corrode thou not my skeleton. If thou have perched upon it, then fly thou away."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਕਾਂ! ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿੰਜਰ ਨਾਹ ਠੰੂਗ, ਜੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਵੱਸ ਵਿਚ (ਇਹ ਗੱਲ) ਹੈ ਤਾਂ (ਇਥੋਂ) ਉੱਡ ਜਾਹ, "}}},{"verse_id":58739,"page_no":1382,"line_no":15,"gurmukhi":"ਜਿਤੁ ਪਿੰਜਰੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਹੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਾਸੁ ਨ ਤਿਦੂ ਖਾਹਿ ॥੯੨॥","translit_en":"jit pi(n)jarai meraa sahu vasai maas na tidhoo khaeh ||92||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Do not eat the flesh from that skeleton, within which my Husband Lord abides. ||92||","ms":"The skeleton, wherein dwells my spouse, eat thou not flesh therefrom."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਿਸ ਸਰੀਰ ਵਿਚ ਮੇਰਾ ਖਸਮ-ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਵੱਸ ਰਿਹਾ ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਵਿਚੋਂ ਮਾਸ ਨਾਹ ਖਾਹ।੯੨।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5299,"next":5301}}

files.shabads/10/5303.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5303,"source_id":"G","writer_id":21,"raag_id":41,"page_no":1382,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58744,"last_verse_id":58745,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Sheikh Fareed Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Fareed Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦ ਕ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58744,"page_no":1382,"line_no":17,"gurmukhi":"ਆਪੁ ਸਵਾਰਹਿ ਮੈ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਮੈ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥","translit_en":"aap savaareh mai mileh mai miliaa sukh hoi ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"God says, \"\"If you reform yourself, you shall meet me, and meeting me, you shall be at peace.","ms":"Says the Lord, \"If O man, thou reform thyself, thou shall meet me."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਫਰੀਦ! ਜੇ ਤੂੰ ਆਪਣੇ ਆਪ ਨੂੰ ਸਵਾਰ ਲਏਂ, ਤਾਂ ਤੂੰ ਮੈਨੂੰ ਮਿਲ ਪਏਂਗਾ, ਤੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਵਿਚ ਜੁੜਿਆਂ ਹੀ ਤੈਨੂੰ ਸੁਖ ਹੋਵੇਗਾ ,"}}},{"verse_id":58745,"page_no":1382,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਫਰੀਦਾ ਜੇ ਤੂ ਮੇਰਾ ਹੋਇ ਰਹਹਿ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੯੫॥","translit_en":"fareedhaa je too meraa hoi raheh sabh jag teraa hoi ||95||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O Fareed, if you will be mine, the whole world will be yours.\"\"||95||","ms":"and if you belong to me, the whole world shall belong to thee\", says Farid."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜੇ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਬਣ ਜਾਏਂ, (ਭਾਵ, ਦੁਨੀਆ ਵਾਲਾ ਪਿਆਰ ਛੱਡ ਕੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਨਾਲ ਪਿਆਰ ਕਰਨ ਲੱਗ ਪਏਂ, ਤਾਂ) ਸਾਰਾ ਜਗਤ ਤੇਰਾ ਬਣ ਜਾਏਗਾ ।੯੫।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5302,"next":5304}}

Sitting on the river-bank, the crane joyfully sports."},"pu":{"ss":" ਹੇ ਫਰੀਦ! ਦਰਿਆ ਦੇ ਕੰਢੇ ਤੇ ਬੈਠਾ ਹੋਇਆ ਬਗੁਲਾ ਕਲੋਲ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ ,"}}},{"verse_id":58756,"page_no":1383,"line_no":4,"gurmukhi":"ਕੇਲ ਕਰੇਦੇ ਹੰਝ ਨੋ ਅਚਿੰਤੇ ਬਾਜ ਪਏ ॥","translit_en":"kel karedhe ha(n)jh no achi(n)te baaj pe ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"While it is playing, a hawk suddenly pounces on it.","ms":"While the crane is engaged in sport, the hawk pounces upon it unexpectedly."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੰਸ (ਵਰਗੇ ਚਿੱਟੇ ਬਗੁਲੇ) ਨੂੰ ਕਲੋਲ ਕਰਦੇ ਨੂੰ ਅਚਨ-ਚੇਤ ਬਾਜ਼ ਆ ਪੈਂਦੇ ਹਨ, "}}},{"verse_id":58757,"page_no":1383,"line_no":4,"gurmukhi":"ਬਾਜ ਪਏ ਤਿਸੁ ਰਬ ਦੇ ਕੇਲਾਂ ਵਿਸਰੀਆਂ ॥","translit_en":"baaj pe tis rab dhe kelaa(n) visareeaa(n) ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"When the Hawk of God attacks, playful sport is forgotten.","ms":"Yea, when the hawk of that God strikes, it forgets the sports."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਦੋਂ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਬਾਜ਼ ਆ ਕੇ ਪੈਂਦੇ ਹਨ, ਤਾਂ ਸਾਰੇ ਕਲੋਲ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਭੁੱਲ ਜਾਂਦੇ ਹਨ "}}},{"verse_id":58758,"page_no":1383,"line_no":5,"gurmukhi":"ਜੋ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਚੇਤੇ ਸਨਿ ਸੋ ਗਾਲੀ ਰਬ ਕੀਆਂ ॥੯੯॥","translit_en":"jo man chit na chete san so gaalee rab keeaa(n) ||99||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"God does what is not expected or even considered. ||99||","ms":"What was not even remotely contemplated in his mind even those things, the Lord has manifest."},"pu":{"ss":" ਜੋ ਗੱਲਾਂ (ਮਨੁੱਖ ਦੇ ਕਦੇ) ਮਨ ਵਿਚ ਚਿੱਤ-ਚੇਤੇ ਵਿਚ ਨਹੀਂ ਸਨ, ਰੱਬ ਨੇ ਉਹ ਕਰ ਦਿੱਤੀਆਂ ।੯੯।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5306,"next":5308}}

files.shabads/10/5316.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5316,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":41,"page_no":1383,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":3,"first_verse_id":58787,"last_verse_id":58789,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Fareed Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦ ਕ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58787,"page_no":1383,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਮਃ ੫ ॥","translit_en":"mahalaa panjavaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Fifth Mehla:","ms":"5th Guru."}}},{"verse_id":58788,"page_no":1383,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਫਰੀਦਾ ਦੁਨੀ ਵਜਾਈ ਵਜਦੀ ਤੂੰ ਭੀ ਵਜਹਿ ਨਾਲਿ ॥","translit_en":"fareedhaa dhunee vajaiee vajadhee too(n) bhee vajeh naal ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Fareed, the world dances as it dances, and you dance with it as well.","ms":"Farid! files.shabads/10/5318.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5318,"source_id":"G","writer_id":21,"raag_id":41,"page_no":1384,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58793,"last_verse_id":58794,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Sheikh Fareed Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Fareed Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦ ਕ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58793,"page_no":1384,"line_no":1,"gurmukhi":"ਪਹਿਲੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਫੁਲੜਾ ਫਲੁ ਭੀ ਪਛਾ ਰਾਤਿ ॥","translit_en":"pahilai paharai fulaRaa fal bhee pachhaa raat ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The first watch of the night brings flowers, and the later watches of the night bring fruit.","ms":"The Lord's meditation in its first watch yields flowers, while the latter watches of the night, yield the fruits as well."},"pu":{"ss":" (ਰਾਤ ਦੇ) ਪਹਿਲੇ ਪਹਿਰ ਦੀ ਬੰਦਗੀ (ਮਾਨੋ) ਇਕ ਸੋਹਣਾ ਜਿਹਾ ਫੁੱਲ ਹੈ, ਫਲ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਵੇਲੇ ਦੀ ਬੰਦਗੀ ਹੀ ਹੋ ਸਕਦੀ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":58794,"page_no":1384,"line_no":2,"gurmukhi":"ਜੋ ਜਾਗੰਨਿੑ ਲਹੰਨਿ ਸੇ ਸਾਈ ਕੰਨੋ ਦਾਤਿ ॥੧੧੨॥","translit_en":"jo jaaga(n)ni(h) laha(n)n se saiee ka(n)no dhaat ||112||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Those who remain awake and aware, receive the gifts from the Lord. ||112||","ms":"They, who remain awake, obtain gifts from the Lord."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜੋ ਬੰਦੇ (ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਵੇਲੇ) ਜਾਗਦੇ ਹਨ ਉਹ ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਪਾਸੋਂ ਬਖ਼ਸ਼ਸ਼ ਹਾਸਲ ਕਰਦੇ ਹਨ ।੧੧੨।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5317,"next":5319}}
files.shabads/10/5319.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5319,"source_id":"G","writer_id":21,"raag_id":41,"page_no":1384,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58795,"last_verse_id":58796,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Sheikh Fareed Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Fareed Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦ ਕ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58795,"page_no":1384,"line_no":2,"gurmukhi":"ਦਾਤੀ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸੰਦੀਆ ਕਿਆ ਚਲੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਲਿ ॥","translit_en":"dhaatee saahib sa(n)dheeaa kiaa chalai tis naal ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The gifts are from our Lord and Master; who can force Him to bestow them?","ms":"All bounties are of the Lord; however, who can force Him to grant them?"},"pu":{"ss":"ਬਖ਼ਸ਼ਸ਼ਾਂ ਮਾਲਕ ਦੀਆਂ (ਆਪਣੀਆਂ) ਹਨ । ਉਸ ਮਾਲਕ ਨਾਲ (ਕਿਸੇ ਦਾ) ਕੀਹ ਜ਼ੋਰ ਚੱਲ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ? "}}},{"verse_id":58796,"page_no":1384,"line_no":2,"gurmukhi":"ਇਕਿ ਜਾਗੰਦੇ ਨਾ ਲਹਨਿੑ ਇਕਨੑਾ ਸੁਤਿਆ ਦੇਇ ਉਠਾਲਿ ॥੧੧੩॥","translit_en":"eik jaaga(n)dhe naa lahani(h) ikan(h)aa sutiaa dhei uThaal ||113||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Some are awake, and do not receive them, while He awakens others from sleep to bless them. ||113||","ms":"Some, who are awake, receive them not, while, some He Himself wakes from sleep and blesses them with gifts."},"pu":{"ss":"ਕਈ (ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਵੇੇਲੇ) ਜਾਗਦੇ ਭੀ (ਇਹ ਬਖ਼ਸ਼ਸ਼ਾਂ) ਨਹੀਂ ਲੈ ਸਕਦੇ, ਕਈ (ਭਾਗਾਂ ਵਾਲਿਆਂ ਨੂੰ) ਸੁੱਤੇ ਪਿਆਂ ਨੂੰ (ਉਹ ਆਪ) ਜਗਾ ਦੇਂਦਾ ਹੈ ।੧੧੩।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5318,"next":5320}}
files.shabads/10/5320.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5320,"source_id":"G","writer_id":21,"raag_id":41,"page_no":1384,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58797,"last_verse_id":58798,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Sheikh Fareed Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Fareed Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦ ਕ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58797,"page_no":1384,"line_no":3,"gurmukhi":"ਢੂਢੇਦੀਏ ਸੁਹਾਗ ਕੂ ਤਉ ਤਨਿ ਕਾਈ ਕੋਰ ॥","translit_en":"ddooddedhe'ee suhaag koo tau tan kaiee kor ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"You search for your Husband Lord; you must have some fault in your body.","ms":"Thou, who is searching for thy Groom, must have some fault in the body."},"pu":{"ss":"ਸੁਹਾਗ (-ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ) ਨੂੰ ਭਾਲਣ ਵਾਲੀਏ , ਤੇਰੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਅੰਦਰ ਹੀ ਕੋਈ ਕਸਰ ਹੈ । "}}},{"verse_id":58798,"page_no":1384,"line_no":4,"gurmukhi":"ਜਿਨੑਾ ਨਾਉ ਸੁਹਾਗਣੀ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਝਾਕ ਨ ਹੋਰ ॥੧੧੪॥","translit_en":"jin(h)aa naau suhaaganee tin(h)aa jhaak na hor ||114||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Those who are known as happy soul-brides, do not look to others. ||114||","ms":"They, who are called chaste brides, cherish not hope of another."},"pu":{"ss":" ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦਾ ਨਾਮ ‘ਸੋਹਾਗਣਾਂ’ ਹੈ ਉਹਨਾਂ ਦੇ ਅੰਦਰ ਕੋਈ ਹੋਰ ਟੇਕ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੁੰਦੀ ।੧੧੪।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5319,"next":5321}}
files.shabads/10/5321.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5321,"source_id":"G","writer_id":21,"raag_id":41,"page_no":1384,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58799,"last_verse_id":58800,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Sheikh Fareed Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Fareed Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦ ਕ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58799,"page_no":1384,"line_no":4,"gurmukhi":"ਸਬਰ ਮੰਝ ਕਮਾਣ ਏ ਸਬਰੁ ਕਾ ਨੀਹਣੋ ॥","translit_en":"sabar ma(n)jh kamaan e sabar kaa neehano ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Within yourself, make patience the bow, and make patience the bowstring.","ms":"In thy mind, make patience a bow, and patience a bow string,"},"pu":{"ss":"ਜੇ ਮਨ ਵਿਚ ਇਸ ਸਬਰ ਦੀ ਕਮਾਨ ਹੋਵੇ, ਜੇ ਸਬਰ ਹੀ ਕਮਾਣ ਦਾ ਚਿੱਲਾ ਹੋਵੇ, "}}},{"verse_id":58800,"page_no":1384,"line_no":4,"gurmukhi":"ਸਬਰ ਸੰਦਾ ਬਾਣੁ ਖਾਲਕੁ ਖਤਾ ਨ ਕਰੀ ॥੧੧੫॥","translit_en":"sabar sa(n)dhaa baan khaalak khataa na karee ||115||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Make patience the arrow, the Creator will not let you miss the target. ||115||","ms":"and patience thine arrows; thus, the Creator will not allow thee to miss the mark."},"pu":{"ss":"ਸਬਰ ਦਾ ਹੀ ਤੀਰ ਹੋਵੇ, ਤਾਂ ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ (ਇਸ ਦਾ ਨਿਸ਼ਾਨਾ) ਖੁੰਝਣ ਨਹੀਂ ਦੇਂਦਾ ।੧੧੫।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5320,"next":5322}}
files.shabads/10/5322.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5322,"source_id":"G","writer_id":21,"raag_id":41,"page_no":1384,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58801,"last_verse_id":58802,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Sheikh Fareed Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Fareed Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦ ਕ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58801,"page_no":1384,"line_no":5,"gurmukhi":"ਸਬਰ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਾਬਰੀ ਤਨੁ ਏਵੈ ਜਾਲੇਨਿੑ ॥","translit_en":"sabar a(n)dhar saabaree tan evai jaaleni(h) ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Those who are patient abide in patience; in this way, they burn their bodies.","ms":"The men of patience abide in patience. Thiswise, burn they their body's ego."},"pu":{"ss":" ਸਬਰ ਵਾਲੇ ਬੰਦੇ ਸਬਰ ਵਿਚ ਰਹਿ ਕੇ ਇਸੇ ਤਰ੍ਹਾਂ (ਸਦਾ ਸਬਰ ਵਿਚ ਹੀ) ਬੰਦਗੀ ਦੀ ਘਾਲ ਘਾਲਦੇ ਹਨ ,"}}},{"verse_id":58802,"page_no":1384,"line_no":5,"gurmukhi":"ਹੋਨਿ ਨਜੀਕਿ ਖੁਦਾਇ ਦੈ ਭੇਤੁ ਨ ਕਿਸੈ ਦੇਨਿ ॥੧੧੬॥","translit_en":"hon najeek khudhai dhai bhet na kisai dhen ||116||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"They are close to the Lord, but they do not reveal their secret to anyone. ||116||","ms":"They come near the Lord, however, disclose not their secret to any one."},"pu":{"ss":" ਰੱਬ ਦੇ ਨੇੜੇ ਹੁੰਦੇ ਜਾਂਦੇ ਹਨ, ਤੇ ਕਿਸੇ ਨੂੰ ਆਪਣੇ ਦਿਲ ਦਾ ਭੇਤ ਨਹੀਂ ਦੇਂਦੇ ।੧੧੬।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5321,"next":5323}}
files.shabads/10/5323.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5323,"source_id":"G","writer_id":21,"raag_id":41,"page_no":1384,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58803,"last_verse_id":58804,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Sheikh Fareed Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Fareed Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦ ਕ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58803,"page_no":1384,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਸਬਰੁ ਏਹੁ ਸੁਆਉ ਜੇ ਤੂੰ ਬੰਦਾ ਦਿੜੁ ਕਰਹਿ ॥","translit_en":"sabar eh suaau je too(n) ba(n)dhaa dhiR kareh ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Let patience be your purpose in life; implant this within your being.","ms":"This patience is the aim of life, if somehow thou implant it in thy mind, O man."},"pu":{"ss":" ਹੇ ਬੰਦੇ! ਇਹ ਸਬਰ ਹੀ ਜ਼ਿੰਦਗੀ ਦਾ ਅਸਲ ਨਿਸ਼ਾਨਾ ਹੈ । ਜੇ ਤੂੰ (ਸਬਰ ਨੂੰ ਹਿਰਦੇ ਵਿਚ) ਪੱਕਾ ਕਰ ਲਏਂ, "}}},{"verse_id":58804,"page_no":1384,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਵਧਿ ਥੀਵਹਿ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਟੁਟਿ ਨ ਥੀਵਹਿ ਵਾਹੜਾ ॥੧੧੭॥","translit_en":"vadh theeveh dhareeaau TuT na theeveh vaahaRaa ||117||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"In this way, you will grow into a great river; you will not break off into a tiny stream. ||117||","ms":"Thiswise, thou grow into a big river however, breaking off, thou not even become a mere brooklet."},"pu":{"ss":"ਤਾਂ ਤੂੰ ਵਧ ਕੇ ਦਰੀਆ ਹੋ ਜਾਹਿਂਗਾ, (ਪਰ) ਘਟ ਕੇ ਨਿੱਕਾ ਜਿਹਾ ਵਹਣ ਨਹੀਂ ਬਣੇਂਗਾ ।੧੧੭।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5322,"next":5324}}
files.shabads/10/5324.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5324,"source_id":"G","writer_id":21,"raag_id":41,"page_no":1384,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58805,"last_verse_id":58806,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Sheikh Fareed Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Fareed Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦ ਕ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58805,"page_no":1384,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਫਰੀਦਾ ਦਰਵੇਸੀ ਗਾਖੜੀ ਚੋਪੜੀ ਪਰੀਤਿ ॥","translit_en":"fareedhaa dharavesee gaakhaRee chopaRee pareet ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Fareed, it is difficult to be a dervish - a Holy Saint; it is easier to love bread when it is buttered.","ms":"Farid! Difficult it is to practise sainthood, I love God only if it is buttered (fruitful)."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਫਰੀਦ! (ਇਹ ਸਬਰ ਵਾਲਾ ਜੀਵਨ ਅਸਲ) ਫ਼ਕੀਰੀ (ਹੈ, ਤੇ ਇਹ) ਔਖੀ (ਕਾਰ) ਹੈ, ਪਰ (ਹੇ ਫਰੀਦ! ਰੱਬ ਨਾਲ ਤੇਰੀ) ਪ੍ਰੀਤ ਤਾਂ ਉਪਰੋਂ ਉਪਰੋਂ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":58806,"page_no":1384,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਇਕਨਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਚਾਲੀਐ ਦਰਵੇਸਾਵੀ ਰੀਤਿ ॥੧੧੮॥","translit_en":"eikan kinai chaaleeaai dharavesaavee reet ||118||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Only a rare few follow the way of the Saints. ||118||","ms":"Some rare one alone walks in the way of the saints."},"pu":{"ss":" ਫ਼ਕੀਰਾਂ ਦੀ (ਇਹ ਸਬਰ ਵਾਲੀ) ਕਾਰ ਕਿਸੇ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਬੰਦੇ ਨੇ ਕਮਾਈ ਹੈ ।੧੧੮।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5323,"next":5325}}
files.shabads/10/5325.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5325,"source_id":"G","writer_id":21,"raag_id":41,"page_no":1384,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58807,"last_verse_id":58808,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Sheikh Fareed Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Fareed Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦ ਕ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58807,"page_no":1384,"line_no":8,"gurmukhi":"ਤਨੁ ਤਪੈ ਤਨੂਰ ਜਿਉ ਬਾਲਣੁ ਹਡ ਬਲੰਨਿੑ ॥","translit_en":"tan tapai tanoor jiau baalan hadd bala(n)ni(h) ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"My body is cooking like an oven; my bones are burning like firewood.","ms":"My body is heated like an oven and my bones burn like fire-wood."},"pu":{"ss":"ਮੇਰਾ ਸਰੀਰ (ਬੇਸ਼ੱਕ) ਤਨੂਰ ਵਾਂਗ ਤਪੇ, ਮੇਰੇ ਹੱਡ (ਬੇਸ਼ੱਕ ਇਉਂ) ਬਲਣ ਜਿਵੇਂ ਬਾਲਣ (ਬਲਦਾ) ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":58808,"page_no":1384,"line_no":8,"gurmukhi":"ਪੈਰੀ ਥਕਾਂ ਸਿਰਿ ਜੁਲਾਂ ਜੇ ਮੂੰ ਪਿਰੀ ਮਿਲੰਨਿੑ ॥੧੧੯॥","translit_en":"pairee thakaa(n) sir julaa(n) je moo(n) piree mila(n)ni(h) ||119||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If my feet become tired, I will walk on my head, if I can meet my Beloved. ||119||","ms":"Were my feet to tire, I would walk on my head, if I can meet with my Beloved."},"pu":{"ss":"ਪੈਰਾਂ ਨਾਲ (ਤੁਰਦਾ ਤੁਰਦਾ) ਥੱਕ ਜਾਵਾਂ, ਤਾਂ ਮੈਂ ਸਿਰ ਭਾਰ ਤੁਰਨ ਲੱਗ ਪਵਾਂ । (ਮੈਂ ਇਹ ਸਾਰੇ ਔਖ ਸਹਾਰਨ ਨੂੰ ਤਿਆਰ ਹਾਂ) ਜੇ ਮੈਨੂੰ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਰੱਬ ਜੀ ਮਿਲ ਪੈਣ ।੧੧੯।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5324,"next":5326}}
files.shabads/10/5326.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5326,"source_id":"G","writer_id":21,"raag_id":41,"page_no":1384,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58809,"last_verse_id":58810,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Sheikh Fareed Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Fareed Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦ ਕ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58809,"page_no":1384,"line_no":9,"gurmukhi":"ਤਨੁ ਨ ਤਪਾਇ ਤਨੂਰ ਜਿਉ ਬਾਲਣੁ ਹਡ ਨ ਬਾਲਿ ॥","translit_en":"tan na tapai tanoor jiau baalan hadd na baal ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Do not heat up your body like an oven, and do not burn your bones like firewood.","ms":"Heat thou not thy body like an oven and burn not thy bones like fire-wood."},"pu":{"ss":"ਸਰੀਰ ਨੂੰ (ਧੂਣੀਆਂ ਨਾਲ) ਤਨੂਰ ਵਾਂਗ ਨਾਹ ਸਾੜ; ਤੇ ਹੱਡਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਇਉਂ ਨਾਹ ਬਾਲ ਜਿਵੇਂ ਇਹ ਬਾਲਣ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":58810,"page_no":1384,"line_no":9,"gurmukhi":"ਸਿਰਿ ਪੈਰੀ ਕਿਆ ਫੇੜਿਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪਿਰੀ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥੧੨੦॥","translit_en":"sir pairee kiaa feRiaa a(n)dhar piree nihaal ||120||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"What harm have your feet and head done to you? Behold your Beloved within yourself. ||120||","ms":"What harm have thine head and feet done thee? See thy Love within thee."},"pu":{"ss":"ਸਿਰ ਨੇ ਤੇ ਪੈਰਾਂ ਨੇ ਕੁਝ ਨਹੀਂ ਵਿਗਾੜਿਆ ਹੈ, (ਇਸ ਵਾਸਤੇ ਇਹਨਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਦੁਖੀ ਨਾਹ ਕਰ) ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਨੂੰ ਆਪਣੇ ਅੰਦਰ ਵੇਖ ।੧੨੦।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5325,"next":5327}}
files.shabads/10/5327.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5327,"source_id":"G","writer_id":21,"raag_id":41,"page_no":1384,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58811,"last_verse_id":58812,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Sheikh Fareed Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Fareed Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦ ਕ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58811,"page_no":1384,"line_no":10,"gurmukhi":"ਹਉ ਢੂਢੇਦੀ ਸਜਣਾ ਸਜਣੁ ਮੈਡੇ ਨਾਲਿ ॥","translit_en":"hau ddooddedhee sajanaa sajan maidde naal ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"I search for my Friend, but my Friend is already with me.","ms":"I go searching for my Friend, however, my Friend is ever with me."},"pu":{"ss":"ਮੈਂ (ਜੀਵ-ਇਸਤ੍ਰੀ) ਸੱਜਣ (-ਪ੍ਰਭੂ) ਨੂੰ (ਬਾਹਰ) ਭਾਲ ਰਹੀ ਹਾਂ, (ਪਰ ਉਹ) ਸੱਜਣ (ਤਾਂ) ਮੇਰੇ ਹਿਰਦੇ ਵਿਚ ਵੱਸ ਰਿਹਾ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":58812,"page_no":1384,"line_no":10,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਨਕ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਲਖੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇਇ ਦਿਖਾਲਿ ॥੧੨੧॥","translit_en":"naanak alakh na lakheeaai gurmukh dhei dhikhaal ||121||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O Nanak, the Unseen Lord cannot be seen; He is revealed only to the Gurmukh. ||121||","ms":"Nanak, the Unseen Lord is seen not; the Exalted Guru shows Him to the mortal."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! ਉਸ (ਸੱਜਣ) ਦਾ ਕੋਈ ਲੱਛਣ ਨਹੀਂ, (ਆਪਣੇ ਉੱਦਮ ਨਾਲ ਜੀਵ ਪਾਸੋਂ) ਉਹ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਨਹੀਂ ਜਾ ਸਕਦਾ, ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਵਿਖਾਲ ਦੇਂਦਾ ਹੈ ।੧੨੧।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5326,"next":5328}}
files.shabads/10/5328.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5328,"source_id":"G","writer_id":21,"raag_id":41,"page_no":1384,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58813,"last_verse_id":58814,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Sheikh Fareed Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Fareed Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦ ਕ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58813,"page_no":1384,"line_no":11,"gurmukhi":"ਹੰਸਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਤਰੰਦਿਆ ਬਗਾ ਆਇਆ ਚਾਉ ॥","translit_en":"ha(n)saa dhekh tara(n)dhiaa bagaa aaiaa chaau ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Seeing the swans swimming, the cranes became excited.","ms":"Seeing the swans swimming, the cranes too were enthused."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੰਸਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਤਰਦਿਆਂ ਵੇਖ ਕੇ ਬਗਲਿਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਭੀ ਚਾਉ ਆ ਗਿਆ, "}}},{"verse_id":58814,"page_no":1384,"line_no":11,"gurmukhi":"ਡੁਬਿ ਮੁਏ ਬਗ ਬਪੁੜੇ ਸਿਰੁ ਤਲਿ ਉਪਰਿ ਪਾਉ ॥੧੨੨॥","translit_en":"ddub mue bag bapuRe sir tal upar paau ||122||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The poor cranes were drowned to death, with their heads below the water and their feet sticking out above. ||122||","ms":"The poor cranes were drowned to death with their heads below and their feet above."},"pu":{"ss":"ਪਰ ਵਿਚਾਰੇ ਬਗਲੇ (ਇਹ ਉੱਦਮ ਕਰਦੇ) ਸਿਰ ਹੇਠਾਂ ਤੇ ਪੈਰ ਉੱਪਰ (ਹੋ ਕੇ) ਡੁੱਬ ਕੇ ਮਰ ਗਏ ।੧੨੨।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5327,"next":5329}}
files.shabads/10/5329.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5329,"source_id":"G","writer_id":21,"raag_id":41,"page_no":1384,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58815,"last_verse_id":58816,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Sheikh Fareed Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Fareed Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦ ਕ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58815,"page_no":1384,"line_no":12,"gurmukhi":"ਮੈ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਵਡ ਹੰਸੁ ਹੈ ਤਾਂ ਮੈ ਕੀਤਾ ਸੰਗੁ ॥","translit_en":"mai jaaniaa vadd ha(n)s hai taa(n) mai keetaa sa(n)g ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"I knew him as a great swan, so I associated with him.","ms":"I deemed him to be a great Swan, therefore, I associated with him,"},"pu":{"ss":"ਮੈਂ ਸਮਝਿਆ ਕਿ ਇਹ ਕੋਈ ਵੱਡਾ ਹੰਸ ਹੈ, ਇਸੇ ਕਰ ਕੇ ਮੈਂ ਉਸ ਦੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੀਤੀ । "}}},{"verse_id":58816,"page_no":1384,"line_no":12,"gurmukhi":"ਜੇ ਜਾਣਾ ਬਗੁ ਬਪੁੜਾ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਭੇੜੀ ਅੰਗੁ ॥੧੨੩॥","translit_en":"je jaanaa bag bapuRaa janam na bheRee a(n)g ||123||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If I had known that he was a only wretched crane, I would never in my life have crossed paths with him. ||123||","ms":"If I had known, that this was only a wretched crane, I would not have touched him with my limb from the beginning."},"pu":{"ss":" ਪਰ ਜੇ ਮੈਨੂੰ ਪਤਾ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਕਿ ਇਹ ਤਾਂ ਨਕਾਰਾ ਬਗਲਾ ਹੈ, ਤਾਂ ਮੈਂ ਕਦੇ ਉਸ ਦੇ ਨੇੜੇ ਨਾਹ ਢੁਕਦੀ ।੧੨੩।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5328,"next":5330}}
files.shabads/10/5330.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5330,"source_id":"G","writer_id":21,"raag_id":41,"page_no":1384,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58817,"last_verse_id":58818,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Sheikh Fareed Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Fareed Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦ ਕ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58817,"page_no":1384,"line_no":13,"gurmukhi":"ਕਿਆ ਹੰਸੁ ਕਿਆ ਬਗੁਲਾ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਧਰੇ ॥","translit_en":"kiaa ha(n)s kiaa bagulaa jaa kau nadhar dhare ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Who is a swan, and who is a crane, if God blesses him with His Glance of Grace?","ms":"What does it matter, whether, he, on whom God casts His merciful glance, is a swan or a crane?"},"pu":{"ss":" ਭਾਵੇਂ ਹੋਵੇ ਹੰਸ ਤੇ ਭਾਵੇਂ ਬਗਲਾ, ਜਿਸ ਉਤੇ (ਪ੍ਰਭੂ) ਕਿਰਪਾ ਦੀ ਨਜ਼ਰ ਕਰੇ ,ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਆਪਣਾ ਬਣਾ ਲੈਂਦਾ ਹੈ;"}}},{"verse_id":58818,"page_no":1384,"line_no":13,"gurmukhi":"ਜੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਕਾਗਹੁ ਹੰਸੁ ਕਰੇ ॥੧੨੪॥","translit_en":"je tis bhaavai naanakaa kaagahu ha(n)s kare ||124||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If it pleases Him, O Nanak, He changes a crow into a swan. ||124||","ms":"If it pleases Him, O Nanak, He changes a crow into a swan."},"pu":{"ss":" ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! ਜੇ ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਨੂੰ ਚੰਗਾ ਲੱਗੇ ਤਾਂਕਾਂ ਤੋਂ (ਭੀ) ਹੰਸ ਬਣਾ ਦੇਂਦਾ ਹੈ ।੧੨੪।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5329,"next":5331}}
files.shabads/10/5331.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5331,"source_id":"G","writer_id":21,"raag_id":41,"page_no":1384,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58819,"last_verse_id":58820,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Sheikh Fareed Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Fareed Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦ ਕ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58819,"page_no":1384,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਸਰਵਰ ਪੰਖੀ ਹੇਕੜੋ ਫਾਹੀਵਾਲ ਪਚਾਸ ॥","translit_en":"saravar pa(n)khee hekaRo faaheevaal pachaas ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"There is only one bird in the lake, but there are fifty trappers.","ms":"In the lake there is but one bird, however, there are fifty snarers."},"pu":{"ss":"ਤਲਾਬ ਦਾ (ਇਹ ਜੀਵ-ਰੂਪ) ਪੰਛੀ ਇਕੱਲਾ ਹੀ ਹੈ, ਫਸਾਉਣ ਵਾਲੇ (ਕਾਮਾਦਿਕ) ਪੰਜਾਹ ਹਨ । "}}},{"verse_id":58820,"page_no":1384,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਲਹਰੀ ਗਡੁ ਥਿਆ ਸਚੇ ਤੇਰੀ ਆਸ ॥੧੨੫॥","translit_en":"eih tan laharee gadd thiaa sache teree aas ||125||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"This body is caught in the waves of desire. O my True Lord, You are my only hope! ||125||","ms":"This body is caught in the waves of desires. O True Lord, my hope is in Thee alone."},"pu":{"ss":"(ਮੇਰਾ) ਇਹ ਸਰੀਰ (ਸੰਸਾਰ-ਰੂਪ ਤਲਾਬ ਦੀਆਂ ਵਿਕਾਰਾਂ ਰੂਪ) ਲਹਿਰਾਂ ਵਿਚ ਫਸ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ । ਹੇ ਸੱਚੇ (ਪ੍ਰਭੂ)! (ਇਹਨਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਬਚਣ ਲਈ) ਇਕ ਤੇਰੀ (ਸਹੈਤਾ ਦੀ ਹੀ) ਆਸ ਹੈ ।੧੨੫।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5330,"next":5332}}
files.shabads/10/5332.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5332,"source_id":"G","writer_id":21,"raag_id":41,"page_no":1384,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":58821,"last_verse_id":58824,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Sheikh Fareed Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Fareed Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦ ਕ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58821,"page_no":1384,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਕਵਣੁ ਸੁ ਅਖਰੁ ਕਵਣੁ ਗੁਣੁ ਕਵਣੁ ਸੁ ਮਣੀਆ ਮੰਤੁ ॥","translit_en":"kavanu su akhar kavan gun kavanu su maneeaa ma(n)t ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"What is that word, what is that virtue, and what is that magic mantra?","ms":"What is that word, what is that virtue and what is that jewel-like spell?"},"pu":{"ss":" (ਹੇ ਭੈਣ!) ਉਹ ਕੇਹੜਾ ਅੱਖਰ ਹੈ? ਉਹ ਕੇਹੜਾ ਗੁਣ ਹੈ? ਉਹ ਕੇਹੜਾ ਸ਼ਿਰੋਮਣੀ ਮੰਤਰ ਹੈ? "}}},{"verse_id":58822,"page_no":1384,"line_no":15,"gurmukhi":"ਕਵਣੁ ਸੁ ਵੇਸੋ ਹਉ ਕਰੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਵਸਿ ਆਵੈ ਕੰਤੁ ॥੧੨੬॥","translit_en":"kavanu su veso hau karee jit vas aavai ka(n)t ||126||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"What are those clothes, which I can wear to captivate my Husband Lord? ||126||","ms":"What is the dress, which I may wear, by which I may captivate my spouse?"},"pu":{"ss":"ਉਹ ਕੇਹੜਾ ਵੇਸ ਮੈਂ ਕਰਾਂ ਜਿਸ ਨਾਲ (ਮੇਰਾ) ਖਸਮ (ਮੇਰੇ) ਵੱਸ ਵਿਚ ਆ ਜਾਏ? ।੧੨੬।"}}},{"verse_id":58823,"page_no":1384,"line_no":15,"gurmukhi":"ਨਿਵਣੁ ਸੁ ਅਖਰੁ ਖਵਣੁ ਗੁਣੁ ਜਿਹਬਾ ਮਣੀਆ ਮੰਤੁ ॥","translit_en":"nivanu su akhar khavan gun jihabaa maneeaa ma(n)t ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Humility is the word, forgiveness is the virtue, and sweet speech is the magic mantra.","ms":"Humility is the world, forgiveness the virtue and sweetness of tongue the jewel-like spell."},"pu":{"ss":" ਹੇ ਭੈਣ! ਨਿਊਣਾ ਅੱਖਰ ਹੈ, ਸਹਾਰਨਾ ਗੁਣ ਹੈ, ਮਿੱਠਾ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਸ਼ਿਰੋਮਣੀ ਮੰਤਰ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":58824,"page_no":1384,"line_no":16,"gurmukhi":"ਏ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਭੈਣੇ ਵੇਸ ਕਰਿ ਤਾਂ ਵਸਿ ਆਵੀ ਕੰਤੁ ॥੧੨੭॥","translit_en":"e trai bhaine ves kar taa(n) vas aavee ka(n)t ||127||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Wear these three robes, O sister, and you will captivate your Husband Lord. ||127||","ms":"Wear thou these three robes, O my sister, then alone thy Spouse would come under thy hold."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜੇ ਇਹ ਤਿੰਨ ਵੇਸ ਕਰ ਲਏਂ ਤਾਂ (ਮੇਰਾ) ਖਸਮ (ਤੇਰੇ) ਵੱਸ ਵਿਚ ਆ ਜਾਇਗਾ ।੧੨੭।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5331,"next":5333}}
files.shabads/10/5333.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5333,"source_id":"G","writer_id":21,"raag_id":41,"page_no":1384,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":58825,"last_verse_id":58828,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Sheikh Fareed Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Fareed Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦ ਕ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58825,"page_no":1384,"line_no":16,"gurmukhi":"ਮਤਿ ਹੋਦੀ ਹੋਇ ਇਆਣਾ ॥","translit_en":"mat hodhee hoi iaanaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If you are wise, be simple;","ms":"If one be simple, even when wise,"},"pu":{"ss":" (ਜੋ ਮਨੁੱਖ) ਅਕਲ ਹੁੰਦਿਆਂ ਭੀ ਅੰਞਾਣਾ ਬਣੇ ,"}}},{"verse_id":58826,"page_no":1384,"line_no":17,"gurmukhi":"ਤਾਣ ਹੋਦੇ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਤਾਣਾ ॥","translit_en":"taan hodhe hoi nitaanaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"if you are powerful, be weak;","ms":"be powerless, even when blessed with power,"},"pu":{"ss":"ਜ਼ੋਰ ਹੁੰਦਿਆਂ ਕਮਜ਼ੋਰਾਂ ਵਾਂਗ ਜੀਵੇ ,"}}},{"verse_id":58827,"page_no":1384,"line_no":17,"gurmukhi":"ਅਣਹੋਦੇ ਆਪੁ ਵੰਡਾਏ ॥","translit_en":"anahodhe aap va(n)ddaae ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"and when there is nothing to share, then share with others.","ms":"and shares with others, even when there is almost naught to share;"},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਦੋਂ ਕੁਝ ਭੀ ਦੇਣ-ਜੋਗਾ ਨਾਹ ਹੋਵੇ, ਤਦੋਂ ਆਪਣਾ ਆਪ (ਭਾਵ, ਆਪਣਾ ਹਿੱਸਾ) ਵੰਡ ਦੇਵੇ, "}}},{"verse_id":58828,"page_no":1384,"line_no":17,"gurmukhi":"ਕੋ ਐਸਾ ਭਗਤੁ ਸਦਾਏ ॥੧੨੮॥","translit_en":"ko aaisaa bhagat sadhaae ||128||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"How rare is one who is known as such a devotee. ||128||","ms":"only some such a rare one is called a saint."},"pu":{"ss":"ਕਿਸੇ ਅਜੇਹੇ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਨੂੰ (ਹੀ) ਭਗਤ ਆਖਣਾ ਚਾਹੀਦਾ ਹੈ ।੧੨੮।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5332,"next":5334}}
files.shabads/10/5334.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5334,"source_id":"G","writer_id":21,"raag_id":41,"page_no":1384,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":58829,"last_verse_id":58830,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhagat Sheikh Fareed Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Fareed Jee","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦ ਕ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58829,"page_no":1384,"line_no":17,"gurmukhi":"ਇਕੁ ਫਿਕਾ ਨ ਗਾਲਾਇ ਸਭਨਾ ਮੈ ਸਚਾ ਧਣੀ ॥","translit_en":"eik fikaa na gaalai sabhanaa mai sachaa dhanee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Do not utter even a single harsh word; your True Lord and Master abides in all.","ms":"Recite thou not even a single harsh word, since thy True Master abides amongst all,"},"pu":{"ss":" ਇੱਕ ਭੀ ਫਿੱਕਾ ਬਚਨ ਨਾਹ ਬੋਲ (ਕਿਉਂਕਿ) ਸਭ ਵਿਚ ਸੱਚਾ ਮਾਲਕ (ਵੱਸ ਰਿਹਾ ਹੈ), "}}},{"verse_id":58830,"page_no":1384,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਹਿਆਉ ਨ ਕੈਹੀ ਠਾਹਿ ਮਾਣਕ ਸਭ ਅਮੋਲਵੇ ॥੧੨੯॥","translit_en":"hiaau na kaihee Thaeh maanak sabh amolave ||129||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Do not break anyone's heart; these are all priceless jewels. ||129||","ms":"Break thou not any one's heart as invaluable are all these jewels."},"pu":{"ss":"ਕਿਸੇ ਦਾ ਭੀ ਦਿਲ ਨਾਹ ਦੁਖਾ (ਕਿਉਂਕਿ) ਇਹ ਸਾਰੇ (ਜੀਵ) ਅਮੋਲਕ ਮੋਤੀ ਹਨ ।੧੨੯।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5333,"next":5335}}

He is Infallible, and does not make mistakes.","ms":"The True Lord, of Himself, has created the world. He is infallible and errs not."},"pu":{"ss":"ਸਦਾ-ਥਿਰ ਸੱਚੇ (ਅਕਾਲ ਪੁਰਖ) ਨੇ ਜਗਤ ਨੂੰ ਰਚਿਆ ਹੈ, ਉਹ ਆਪ ਕਦੇ ਭੁੱਲਣਹਾਰ ਨਹੀਂ, ਕਦੇ ਭੁੱਲ ਨਹੀਂ ਕਰਦਾ ।"}}},{"verse_id":58873,"page_no":1386,"line_no":13,"gurmukhi":"ਰਤਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਕੀਮ ਨਹੁ ਪਵੈ ਅਮੁਲਉ ॥","translit_en":"ratan naam apaar keem nahu pavai amulau ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Naam, the Name of the Infinite Lord, is the jewel. Its value cannot be appraised - it is priceless.","ms":"Priceless like the jewel is the Name of the Infinite Lord. The worth of the invaluable Name can be prized not."},"pu":{"ss":"(ਅਕਾਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਦਾ) ਸ੍ਰੇਸ਼ਟ ਨਾਮ (ਭੀ) ਬੇਅੰਤ ਹੈ, ਅਮੋਲਕ ਹੈ, (ਉਸ ਦੇ ਨਾਮ ਦਾ) ਮੁੱਲ ਨਹੀਂ ਪੈ ਸਕਦਾ ।"}}},{"verse_id":58874,"page_no":1386,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਜਿਹ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਹੋਯਉ ਗੋੁਬਿੰਦੁ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਤਿਨਹੂ ਪਾਏ ॥","translit_en":"jeh kirapaal hoyau guobi(n)dh sarab sukh tinahoo paae ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"That person, upon whom the Lord of the Universe showers His Mercy obtains all comforts.","ms":"On whomsoever the world-Lord becomes merciful, he alone obtains all the comfort."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਮਨੁੱਖਾਂ ਉੱਤੇ ਅਕਾਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਦਇਆਵਾਨ ਹੋਇਆ ਹੈ, ਉਹਨਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਹੀ ਸਾਰੇ ਸੁਖ ਮਿਲੇ ਹਨ । "}}},{"verse_id":58875,"page_no":1386,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਿਨੑ ਪਰਸਿਓ ਤੇ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਆਏ ॥੭॥","translit_en":"har gur naanak jin(h) parasio te bahuR fir jon na aae ||7||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Those who touch the Feet of the Lord through Guru Nanak, do not have to enter the cycle of reincarnation ever again. ||7||","ms":"They who touch the feet of Divine Guru Nanak, they are cast not into existences afterwards again."},"pu":{"ss":"ਅਕਾਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਦੇ ਰੂਪ ਗੁਰੂ ਨਾਨਕ (ਦੇ ਚਰਨਾਂ) ਨੂੰ ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਪਰਸਿਆ ਹੈ, ਉਹ ਫਿਰ ਪਰਤ ਕੇ ਜਨਮ (ਮਰਣ) ਵਿਚ ਨਹੀਂ ਆਉਂਦੇ ।੭।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5340,"next":5342}}
files.shabads/10/5342.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5342,"source_id":"G","writer_id":5,"raag_id":42,"page_no":1386,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":6,"first_verse_id":58876,"last_verse_id":58881,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Guru Arjan Dev Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Svaiyay Mehl 5","raag_unicode":"ਸਵਯੇ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਮੁਖ ਬਾਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੫"},"verses":[{"verse_id":58876,"page_no":1386,"line_no":15,"gurmukhi":"ਕਵਨੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਕਉਨੁ ਗੵਾਨੁ ਧੵਾਨੁ ਕਵਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਉਸ੍ਤਤਿ ਕਰੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"kavan jog kaun gayeaan dhayeaan kavan bidh ustat kareeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"What is the Yoga, what is the spiritual wisdom and meditation, and what is the way, to praise the Lord?","ms":"What is the 'yoga, ' what the knowledge and contemplation and what the way, by which we can praise our Lord?"},"pu":{"ss":" ਕਿਹੜਾ ਜੋਗ (ਦਾ ਸਾਧਨ) ਕਰੀਏ? ਕਿਹੜਾ ਗਿਆਨ (ਵਿਚਾਰੀਏ)? ਕਿਹੜਾ ਧਿਆਨ (ਧਰੀਏ)? ਉਹ ਕਿਹੜੀ ਜੁਗਤੀ ਵਰਤੀਏ ਜਿਸ ਕਰਕੇ ਅਕਾਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਦੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾ ਸਕੀਏ? "}}},{"verse_id":58877,"page_no":1386,"line_no":16,"gurmukhi":"ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਤੇਤੀਸ ਕੋਰਿ ਤਿਰੁ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਪਰੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"sidh saadhik tetees kor tir keem na pareeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Siddhas and seekers and the three hundred thirty million gods cannot find even a tiny bit of the Lord's Value.","ms":"The adepts, the strivers and the thirty-three millions of gods, can find not even an iota of the Lord's worth."},"pu":{"ss":"ਸਿੱਧ, ਸਾਧਿਕ ਅਤੇ ਤੇਤੀ ਕਰੋੜ ਦੇਵਤਿਆਂ ਪਾਸੋਂ (ਭੀ) ਅਕਾਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਦਾ ਮੁੱਲ ਰਤਾ ਭੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਪੈ ਸਕਿਆ ।"}}},{"verse_id":58878,"page_no":1386,"line_no":16,"gurmukhi":"ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਦਿਕ ਸਨਕਾਦਿ ਸੇਖ ਗੁਣ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥","translit_en":"brahamaadhik sanakaadh sekh gun a(n)t na paae ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Neither Brahma, nor Sanak, nor the thousand-headed serpent king can find the limits of His Glorious Virtues.","ms":"Neither Brahma, nor Sanak nor the serpent-king, know the limit of His praises."},"pu":{"ss":"ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਅਤੇ ਹੋਰ ਦੇਵਤੇ (ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਦੇ ਪੁੱਤ੍ਰ) ਸਨਕ ਆਦਿਕ ਅਤੇ ਸ਼ੇਸ਼ਨਾਗ ਅਕਾਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਦੇ ਗੁਣਾਂ ਦਾ ਅੰਤ ਨਹੀਂ ਲੱਭ ਸਕੇ ।"}}},{"verse_id":58879,"page_no":1386,"line_no":17,"gurmukhi":"ਅਗਹੁ ਗਹਿਓ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਇ ਪੂਰਿ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਮਾਏ ॥","translit_en":"agahu gahio nahee jai poor srab rahio samaae ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Inapprehensible Lord cannot be apprehended. He is pervading and permeating amongst all.","ms":"The Unseizable Lord can be seized not although, He is fully contained amongst all."},"pu":{"ss":"ਸਮਝ ਤੋਂ ਉੱਚਾ ਹੈ, ਉਸ ਦੀ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਨਹੀਂ ਜਾ ਸਕਦੀ, ਸਾਰੇ ਥਾਈਂ ਵਿਆਪਕ ਹੈ ਤੇ ਸਭ ਵਿਚ ਰਮਿਆ ਹੋਇਆ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":58880,"page_no":1386,"line_no":17,"gurmukhi":"ਜਿਹ ਕਾਟੀ ਸਿਲਕ ਦਯਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਸੇਇ ਜਨ ਲਗੇ ਭਗਤੇ ॥","translit_en":"jeh kaaTee silak dhayaal prabh sei jan lage bhagate ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Those whom God has mercifully freed from their nooses - those humble beings are attached to His devotional worship.","ms":"They, whose noose the merciful Master has cut off, those persons are attached to His meditation."},"pu":{"ss":"ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੇ ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਮਨੁੱਖਾਂ ਦੀ (ਮਾਇਆ ਦੇ ਮੋਹ ਦੀ) ਫਾਹੀ ਕੱਟ ਦਿੱਤੀ ਹੈ, ਉਹ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਉਸ ਦੀ ਭਗਤੀ ਵਿਚ ਜੁੜ ਗਏ ਹਨ । "}}},{"verse_id":58881,"page_no":1386,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਿਨੑ ਪਰਸਿਓ ਤੇ ਇਤ ਉਤ ਸਦਾ ਮੁਕਤੇ ॥੮॥","translit_en":"har gur naanak jin(h) parasio te it ut sadhaa mukate ||8||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Those who meet with the Lord through Guru Nanak are liberated forever, here and hereafter. ||8||","ms":"They, who meet with God and Guru Nanak, are ever emancipated here and hereafter."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹਰੀ ਦੇ ਰੂਪ ਗੁਰੂ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਪਰਸਿਆ ਹੈ, ਉਹ ਜੀਵ ਲੋਕ ਪਰਲੋਕ ਵਿਚ ਮਾਇਆ ਦੇ ਬੰਧਨਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਬਚੇ ਹੋਏ ਹਨ ।੮।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5341,"next":5343}}
