files.shabads/10/5458.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5458,"source_id":"G","writer_id":41,"raag_id":42,"page_no":1407,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":6,"first_verse_id":59534,"last_verse_id":59539,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhatt Kal","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Svaiyay Mehl 5","raag_unicode":"ਸਵਯੇ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਮੁਖ ਬਾਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੫"},"verses":[{"verse_id":59534,"page_no":1407,"line_no":11,"gurmukhi":"ਸਦ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਅਰਜੁਨੁ ਅਮੋਲੁ ਆਜੋਨੀ ਸੰਭਉ ॥","translit_en":"sadh jeevan arajun amol aajonee sa(n)bhau ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O Guru Arjun, You are Eternal, Invaluable, Unborn, Self-existent,","ms":"Thou, O Guru Arjan, are ever-alive, invaluable, unborn, self-existent,"},"pu":{"ss":" (ਗੁਰੂ) ਅਰਜਨ (ਸਾਹਿਬ) ਸਦ-ਜੀਵੀ ਹੈ, (ਆਪ ਦਾ) ਮੁੱਲ ਨਹੀਂ ਪੈ ਸਕਦਾ, (ਆਪ) ਜੂਨਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਰਹਤ ਤੇ ਸੁਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸ਼ ਹਰੀ ਦਾ ਰੂਪ ਹਨ;"}}},{"verse_id":59535,"page_no":1407,"line_no":11,"gurmukhi":"ਭਯ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਪਰ ਦੁਖ ਨਿਵਾਰੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਅਨੰਭਉ ॥","translit_en":"bhay bha(n)jan par dhukh nivaar apaar ana(n)bhau ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"the Destroyer of fear, the Dispeller of pain, Infinite and Fearless.","ms":"the destroyer of dread, the dispeller of other's pain, infinite and fearless."},"pu":{"ss":"(ਗੁਰੂ ਅਰਜਨ) ਭੈ ਦੂਰ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲਾ, ਪਰਾਏ ਦੁੱਖ ਹਰਨ ਵਾਲਾ, ਬੇਅੰਤ ਤੇ ਗਿਆਨ-ਸਰੂਪ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":59536,"page_no":1407,"line_no":12,"gurmukhi":"ਅਗਹ ਗਹਣੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭ੍ਰਾਂਤਿ ਦਹਣੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਸੁਖ ਦਾਤਉ ॥","translit_en":"ageh gahan bhram bhraa(n)t dhahan seetal sukh dhaatau ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"You have grasped the Ungraspable, and burnt away doubt and skepticism. You bestow cooling and soothing peace.","ms":"Thou have seized the Unseizable Lord, has burnt off doubt and misgiving and thou bless the mortals with cool comfort."},"pu":{"ss":"(ਗੁਰੂ ਅਰਜਨ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ ਦੀ) ਉਸ ਹਰੀ ਤਕ ਪਹੁੰਚ ਹੈ ਜੋ (ਜੀਵਾਂ ਦੀ) ਪਹੁੰਚ ਤੋਂ ਪਰੇ ਹੈ, (ਗੁਰੂ ਅਰਜਨ) ਭਰਮ ਤੇ ਭਟਕਣਾ ਨੂੰ ਦੂਰ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲਾ ਹੈ, ਸੀਤਲ ਹੈ ਤੇ ਸੁਖਾਂ ਦੇ ਦੇਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਹੈ;"}}},{"verse_id":59537,"page_no":1407,"line_no":12,"gurmukhi":"ਆਸੰਭਉ ਉਦਵਿਅਉ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਬਿਧਾਤਉ ॥","translit_en":"aasa(n)bhau udhaviaau purakh pooran bidhaatau ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Self-existent, Perfect Primal Lord God Creator has taken birth.","ms":"In thy form, the self-illumined Creator and the Perfect Lord has come into being."},"pu":{"ss":"(ਮਾਨੋ) ਅਜਨਮਾ, ਪੂਰਨ ਪੁਰਖ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਹੋ ਪਿਆ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":59538,"page_no":1407,"line_no":13,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਨਕ ਆਦਿ ਅੰਗਦ ਅਮਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਇਅਉ ॥","translit_en":"naanak aadh a(n)gadh amar satigur sabadh samaiaau ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"First, Guru Nanak, then Guru Angad and Guru Amar Daas, the True Guru, have been absorbed into the Word of the Shabad.","ms":"Nanak, the primal Guru, Angad Dev, Amar Dass and the True Guru, have all merged in the Lord."},"pu":{"ss":" ਗੁਰੂ ਨਾਨਕ, ਗੁਰੂ ਅੰਗਦ ਤੇ ਗੁਰੂ ਅਮਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਦੀ ਬਰਕਤਿ ਨਾਲ, (ਗੁਰੂ ਅਰਜਨ ਦੇਵ) ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਦੇ ਸ਼ਬਦ ਵਿਚ ਲੀਨ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":59539,"page_no":1407,"line_no":13,"gurmukhi":"ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਗੁਰੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਪਰਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਅਉ ॥੫॥","translit_en":"dhan dha(n)n guroo raamadhaas gur jin paaras paras milaiaau ||5||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Blessed, blessed is Guru Raam Daas, the Philosopher's Stone, who transformed Guru Arjun unto Himself. ||5||","ms":"Blest, blest indeed is Ram Dass, the Great Guru, who, like the philosopher's stone, touched Arjan Dev, and make him like himself."},"pu":{"ss":"ਗੁਰੂ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਧੰਨ ਹੈ, ਜਿਸ ਨੇ ਗੁਰੂ (ਅਰਜਨ ਜੀ ਨੂੰ) ਪਰਸ ਕੇ ਪਾਰਸ ਬਣਾ ਕੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਵਰਗਾ ਕਰ ਲਿਆ ਹੈ ।੫।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5457,"next":5459}}
files.shabads/10/5459.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5459,"source_id":"G","writer_id":41,"raag_id":42,"page_no":1407,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":59540,"last_verse_id":59543,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhatt Kal","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Svaiyay Mehl 5","raag_unicode":"ਸਵਯੇ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਮੁਖ ਬਾਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੫"},"verses":[{"verse_id":59540,"page_no":1407,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਜਾਸੁ ਜਗ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਭਾਗੁ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਸਿਵ ਰਹਤਾ ॥","translit_en":"jai jai kaar jaas jag a(n)dhar ma(n)dhar bhaag jugat siv rahataa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"His victory is proclaimed all over the world; His Home is blessed with good fortune; He remains united with the Lord.","ms":"He, whose victory resounds in the world, high is the fortune in his home and he remains united with his Lord."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਿਸ ਗੁਰੂ ਦੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਜਗਤ ਵਿਚ ਹੋ ਰਹੀ ਹੈ, ਜਿਸ ਦੇ ਹਿਰਦੇ ਵਿਚ ਭਾਗ ਜਾਗ ਪਿਆ ਹੈ, ਜੋ ਹਰੀ ਨਾਲ ਜੁੜਿਆ ਰਹਿੰਦਾ ਹੈ, "}}},{"verse_id":59541,"page_no":1407,"line_no":15,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਯਉ ਬਡ ਭਾਗੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਮੇਦਨਿ ਭਰੁ ਸਹਤਾ ॥","translit_en":"gur pooraa paayau badd bhaagee liv laagee medhan bhar sahataa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By great good fortune, He has found the Perfect Guru; He remains lovingly attuned to Him, and endures the load of the earth.","ms":"Through great good fortune, I have attained to that perfect Guru, who is attuned to the Lord and who bears the load of earth."},"pu":{"ss":"(ਜਿਸ ਨੇ) ਵੱਡੇ ਭਾਗਾਂ ਨਾਲ ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਲੱਭ ਲਿਆ ਹੈ, (ਜਿਸ ਦੀ) ਬ੍ਰਿਤੀ (ਹਰੀ ਵਿਚ) ਜੁੜੀ ਰਹਿੰਦੀ ਹੈ, ਤੇ ਜੋ ਧਰਤੀ ਦਾ ਭਾਰ ਸਹਿ ਰਿਹਾ ਹੈ;"}}},{"verse_id":59542,"page_no":1407,"line_no":15,"gurmukhi":"ਭਯ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਪਰ ਪੀਰ ਨਿਵਾਰਨੁ ਕਲੵ ਸਹਾਰੁ ਤੋਹਿ ਜਸੁ ਬਕਤਾ ॥","translit_en":"bhay bha(n)jan par peer nivaaran kalaye sahaar toh jas bakataa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He is the Destroyer of fear, the Eradicator of the pains of others. Kall Sahaar the poet utters Your Praise, O Guru.","ms":"The Guru is the destroyer of fear and the remover of the pain of others. Kalsahar, the bard, recites thy praise, O Guru."},"pu":{"ss":"(ਹੇ ਗੁਰੂ ਅਰਜੁਨ ਜੀ!) ਤੂੰ ਭੈ ਦੂਰ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲਾ, ਪਰਾਈ ਪੀੜ ਹਰਨ ਵਾਲਾ ਹੈਂ, ਕਵੀ ਕਲੵਸਹਾਰ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਸ ਆਖਦਾ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":59543,"page_no":1407,"line_no":16,"gurmukhi":"ਕੁਲਿ ਸੋਢੀ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਤਨੁ ਧਰਮ ਧੁਜਾ ਅਰਜੁਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਾ ॥੬॥","translit_en":"kul soddee gur raamadhaas tan dharam dhujaa arajun har bhagataa ||6||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"In the Sodhi family, is born Arjun, the son of Guru Raam Daas, the holder of the banner of Dharma and the devotee of God. ||6||","ms":"In the lineage of Sodhis, Arjan the son of Guru Ram Dass, is born as the saint of God and he is the standard of piety."},"pu":{"ss":"ਗੁਰੂ ਅਰਜਨ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਗੁਰੂ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਦਾ ਪੁੱਤਰ, ਸੋਢੀ ਕੁਲ ਵਿਚ ਧਰਮ ਦੇ ਝੰਡੇ ਵਾਲਾ, ਹਰੀ ਦਾ ਭਗਤ ਹੈ ।੬।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5458,"next":5460}}
files.shabads/10/5460.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5460,"source_id":"G","writer_id":41,"raag_id":42,"page_no":1407,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":6,"first_verse_id":59544,"last_verse_id":59549,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhatt Kal","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Svaiyay Mehl 5","raag_unicode":"ਸਵਯੇ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਮੁਖ ਬਾਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੫"},"verses":[{"verse_id":59544,"page_no":1407,"line_no":17,"gurmukhi":"ਧ੍ਰੰਮ ਧੀਰੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਗਭੀਰੁ ਪਰ ਦੁਖ ਬਿਸਾਰਣੁ ॥","translit_en":"dhra(n)m dheer gurmat gabheer par dhukh bisaaran ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Support of the Dharma, immersed in the deep and profound Teachings of the Guru, the Remover of the pains of others.","ms":"He is the support of Divine faith, profound in the Guru's wisdom and the remover of the sorrow of others."},"pu":{"ss":" (ਗੁਰੂ ਅਰਜਨ ਦੇਵ ਜੀ ਨੇ) ਧੀਰਜ ਨੂੰ ਆਪਣਾ ਧਰਮ ਬਣਾਇਆ ਹੋਇਆ ਹੈ, (ਗੁਰੂ ਅਰਜਨ) ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਵਿਚ ਡੂੰਘਾ ਹੈ, ਪਰਾਏ ਦੁੱਖ ਦੂਰ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲਾ ਹੈ,"}}},{"verse_id":59545,"page_no":1407,"line_no":17,"gurmukhi":"ਸਬਦ ਸਾਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਮ ਉਦਾਰੁ ਅਹੰਮੇਵ ਨਿਵਾਰਣੁ ॥","translit_en":"sabadh saar har sam udhaar aha(n)mev nivaaran ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Shabad is excellent and sublime, kind and generous like the Lord, the Destroyer of egotism.","ms":"Sublime is his word, generous is he like God and is also the destroyer of ego."},"pu":{"ss":"ਸ੍ਰੇਸ਼ਟ ਸ਼ਬਦ ਵਾਲਾ ਹੈ, ਹਰੀ ਵਰਗਾ ਉਦਾਰ-ਚਿੱਤ ਹੈ, ਅਤੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਨੂੰ ਦੂਰ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":59546,"page_no":1407,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਮਹਾ ਦਾਨਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨਿ ਮਨਿ ਚਾਉ ਨ ਹੁਟੈ ॥","translit_en":"mahaa dhaan satigur giaan man chaau na huTai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Great Giver, the spiritual wisdom of the True Guru, His mind does not grow weary of its yearning for the Lord.","ms":"He is the great giver and the possessor of the True Guru's gnosis. His mind's desire to contemplate his Lord wearies not."},"pu":{"ss":"(ਆਪ) ਬੜੇ ਦਾਨੀ ਹਨ, ਗੁਰੂ ਦੇ ਗਿਆਨ ਵਾਲੇ ਹਨ, (ਆਪ ਦੇ) ਮਨ ਵਿਚੋਂ ਉਤਸ਼ਾਹ ਕਦੇ ਘੱਟ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੁੰਦਾ ।"}}},{"verse_id":59547,"page_no":1407,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਸਤਿਵੰਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਨ ਨਿਖੁਟੈ ॥","translit_en":"sativa(n)t har naam ma(n)tr nav nidh na nikhuTai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Embodiment of Truth, the Mantra of the Lord's Name, the nine treasures are never exhausted.","ms":"The immaculate nine treasures of the Lord's Name and Gurbani are with him and those exhaust not ever."},"pu":{"ss":"(ਆਪ) ਸਤਿਵੰਤ ਹਨ, ਹਰੀ ਦਾ ਨਾਮ-ਰੂਪ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ (ਜੋ, ਮਾਨੋ,) ਨੌ ਨਿਧੀਆਂ (ਹੈ ਆਪ ਦੇ ਖ਼ਜ਼ਾਨੇ ਵਿਚੋਂ) ਕਦੇ ਮੁੱਕਦਾ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":59548,"page_no":1407,"line_no":19,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਤਨੁ ਸਰਬ ਮੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਚੰਦੋਆ ਤਾਣਿਅਉ ॥","translit_en":"gur raamadhaas tan sarab mai sahaj cha(n)dhoaa taaniaau ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O Son of Guru Raam Daas, You are contained amidst all; the canopy of intuitive wisdom is spread above You.","ms":"O Son of Guru Ram Dass, thou are contained amidst all and the canopy of Divine knowledge spreads over you."},"pu":{"ss":"ਗੁਰੂ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਦਾ ਸਪੁਤ੍ਰ (ਗੁਰੂ ਅਰਜਨ ਜੀ) ਸਰਬ-ਵਿਆਪਕ (ਦਾ ਰੂਪ) ਹੈ; (ਆਪ ਨੇ) ਆਤਮਕ ਅਡੋਲਤਾ ਵਿਚ (ਆਪਣਾ) ਚੰਦੋਆ ਤਾਣਿਆ ਹੋਇਆ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":59549,"page_no":1407,"line_no":19,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰ ਅਰਜੁਨ ਕਲੵੁਚਰੈ ਤੈ ਰਾਜ ਜੋਗ ਰਸੁ ਜਾਣਿਅਉ ॥੭॥","translit_en":"gur arajun kalayeucharai tai raaj jog ras jaaniaau ||7||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"So speaks KALL the poet: O Guru Arjun, You know the sublime essence of Raja Yoga, the Yoga of meditation and success. ||7||","ms":"Says Kall, the bard, thou, O Guru Arjan Dev, know the relish of both the secular and spiritual sovereignties."},"pu":{"ss":"ਕਲੵ ਕਵੀ ਆਖਦਾ ਹੈ, “ਹੇ ਗੁਰੂ ਅਰਜਨ ਦੇਵ! ਤੂੰ ਰਾਜ ਅਤੇ ਜੋਗ ਦਾ ਆਨੰਦ ਸਮਝ ਲਿਆ ਹੈ” (ਮਾਣ ਰਿਹਾ ਹੈਂ) ।੭।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5459,"next":5461}}
files.shabads/10/5461.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5461,"source_id":"G","writer_id":41,"raag_id":42,"page_no":1408,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":6,"first_verse_id":59550,"last_verse_id":59555,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhatt Kal","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Svaiyay Mehl 5","raag_unicode":"ਸਵਯੇ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਮੁਖ ਬਾਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੫"},"verses":[{"verse_id":59550,"page_no":1408,"line_no":1,"gurmukhi":"ਭੈ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਮਾਣਿਅਉ ਲਾਖ ਮਹਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਯਉ ॥","translit_en":"bhai nirabhau maaniaau laakh meh alakh lakhaayau ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"In the Fear of God, You enjoy the Fearless Lord; among the thousands of beings, You see the Unseen Lord.","ms":"Abiding in His fear, thou enjoy the fearless Lord and see the Unseeable God amongst lacs of beings."},"pu":{"ss":"(ਗੁਰੂ ਅਰਜੁਨ ਦੇਵ ਜੀ ਨੇ) ਉਸ ਹਰੀ ਨੂੰ ਮਾਣਿਆ ਹੈ, ਜਿਸ ਨੂੰ ਕੋਈ ਡਰ ਪੋਹ ਨਹੀਂ ਸਕਦਾ, ਤੇ ਜੋ ਲੱਖਾਂ ਵਿਚ ਰਮਿਆ ਹੋਇਆ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":59551,"page_no":1408,"line_no":1,"gurmukhi":"ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਗਤਿ ਗਭੀਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਪਰਚਾਯਉ ॥","translit_en":"agam agochar gat gabheer satigur parachaayau ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Through the True Guru, You have realized the state of the Inaccessible, Unfathomable, Profound Lord.","ms":"Through the True Guru, thou have known the state of thy unfathomable, incomprehensible and Profound Lord."},"pu":{"ss":"ਗੁਰੂ (ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਜੀ) ਨੇ ਆਪ ਨੂੰ ਉਸ ਹਰੀ ਦਾ ਉਪਦੇਸ਼ ਦਿੱਤਾ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਅਗੰਮ ਹੈ, ਗੰਭੀਰ ਹੈ ਤੇ ਜਿਸ ਦੀ ਹਸਤੀ ਇੰਦ੍ਰਿਆਂ ਦੀ ਪਹੁੰਚ ਤੋਂ ਪਰੇ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":59552,"page_no":1408,"line_no":2,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰ ਪਰਚੈ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਰਾਜ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਗੁ ਕਮਾਯਉ ॥","translit_en":"gur parachai paravaan raaj meh jog kamaayau ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Meeting with the Guru, You are certified and approved; You are immersed in the pool of contentment.","ms":"Reaching up to the approved Guru, thou endure the Unendurable and are merged in the sea of contentment."},"pu":{"ss":" ਗੁਰੂ ਵਾਲੀ ਪਦਵੀ ਪਰਾਪਤ ਕਰ ਲੈਣ ਦੇ ਕਾਰਨ ਆਪ ਨੇ ਅਜਰ ਅਵਸਥਾ ਨੂੰ ਜਰਿਆ ਹੈ, ਤੇ ਆਪ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਦੇ ਸਰੋਵਰ ਵਿਚ ਲੀਨ ਹੋ ਗਏ ਹਨ ।"}}},{"verse_id":59555,"page_no":1408,"line_no":3,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰ ਅਰਜੁਨ ਕਲੵੁਚਰੈ ਤੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਜੋਗੁ ਨਿਜੁ ਪਾਇਯਉ ॥੮॥","translit_en":"gur arajun kalayeucharai tai sahaj jog nij paiyau ||8||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"So speaks KALL: O Guru Arjun, You have intuitively attained the state of Yoga within Yourself. ||8||","ms":"Says Kall, O Guru Arjan, thou have easily obtained union with thy own Lord."},"pu":{"ss":"ਕਵੀ ‘ਕਲੵ’ ਆਖਦਾ ਹੈ—‘ਹੇ ਗੁਰੂ ਅਰਜੁਨ (ਦੇਵ ਜੀ)! ਤੂੰ ਆਤਮਕ ਅਡੋਲਤਾ ਵਿਚ ਟਿਕ ਕੇ (ਅਕਾਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਨਾਲ) ਅਸਲੀ ਮਿਲਾਪ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤ ਕਰ ਲਿਆ ਹੈ’ ।੮।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5460,"next":5462}}

Arjan, the Lord has make manifest, as His own incarnate."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਗਤ ਦੇ ਇਸ ਘੋਰ ਹਨੇਰੇ ਵਿਚ (ਗੁਰੂ ਅਰਜੁਨ ਤੋਂ ਬਿਨਾ) ਕੋਈ ਹੋਰ (ਰਾਖਾ) ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ, ਉਸੇ ਨੂੰ (ਹਰੀ ਨੇ) ਲਿਆ ਕੇ ਉਜਾਗਰ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਬਣਾਇਆ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":59588,"page_no":1409,"line_no":4,"gurmukhi":"ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਦੁਖ ਕੋਟਿਕ ਦੂਰਿ ਗਏ ਮਥੁਰਾ ਜਿਨੑ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੀਅਉ ॥","translit_en":"tin ke dhukh koTik dhoor ge mathuraa jin(h) a(n)mirat naam peeaau ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Millions of pains are taken away, from those who drink in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam, says Mat'huraa.","ms":"Of those, millions of sorrows are dispelled, who through him in-drink the Name-Nectar, says Mathura."},"pu":{"ss":" ਹੇ ਮਥੁਰਾ! ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ (ਉਸ ਪਾਸੋਂ) ਨਾਮ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਪੀਤਾ ਹੈ ਉਹਨਾਂ ਦੇ ਕ੍ਰੋੜਾਂ ਦੁੱਖ ਦੂਰ ਹੋ ਗਏ ਹਨ ।"}}},{"verse_id":59589,"page_no":1409,"line_no":5,"gurmukhi":"ਇਹ ਪਧਤਿ ਤੇ ਮਤ ਚੂਕਹਿ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਭੇਦੁ ਬਿਭੇਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਨ ਬੀਅਉ ॥","translit_en":"eeh padhat te mat chookeh re man bhedh bibhedh na jaan beeaau ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O mortal being, do not leave this path; do not think that there is any difference between God and Guru.","ms":"O man, thou miss not this path of the Guru and thou destroy the very idea of distinction between the Guru and God and deem not the Guru as another."},"pu":{"ss":" ਹੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ! ਕਿਤੇ ਇਸ ਰਾਹ ਤੋਂ ਖੁੰਝ ਨਾਹ ਜਾਈਂ, ਕਿਤੇ ਇਹ ਵਿੱਥ ਨ ਸਮਝੀਂ, ਕਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਅਰਜੁਨ (ਹਰੀ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਖਰਾ) ਦੂਜਾ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":59590,"page_no":1409,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਪਰਤਛਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਗੁਰ ਅਰਜੁਨ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ਲੀਅਉ ॥੫॥","translit_en":"paratachh ridhai gur arajun kai har pooran braham nivaas leeaau ||5||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Perfect Lord God has manifested Himself; He dwells in the heart of Guru Arjun. ||5||","ms":"God, the Omnipresent Lord, has manifestly taken His abode in the mind of Guru Arjan."},"pu":{"ss":"ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਹਰੀ ਨੇ ਗੁਰੂ ਅਰਜੁਨ ਦੇ ਹਿਰਦੇ ਵਿਚ ਪ੍ਰਤੱਖ ਤੌਰ ਤੇ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਕੀਤਾ ਹੈ ।੫।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5469,"next":5471}}
files.shabads/10/5471.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5471,"source_id":"G","writer_id":42,"raag_id":42,"page_no":1409,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":59591,"last_verse_id":59594,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhatt Mathuraa","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Svaiyay Mehl 5","raag_unicode":"ਸਵਯੇ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਮੁਖ ਬਾਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੫"},"verses":[{"verse_id":59591,"page_no":1409,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਜਬ ਲਉ ਨਹੀ ਭਾਗ ਲਿਲਾਰ ਉਦੈ ਤਬ ਲਉ ਭ੍ਰਮਤੇ ਫਿਰਤੇ ਬਹੁ ਧਾਯਉ ॥","translit_en":"jab lau nahee bhaag lilaar udhai tab lau bhramate firate bahu dhaayau ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As long as the destiny written upon my forehead was not activated, I wandered around lost, running in all directions.","ms":"So long as destiny on my forehead appeared not, till then I wandered and ran about in various directions."},"pu":{"ss":" ਹੇ ਭਾਈ! ਜਦ ਤਾਈਂ ਮੱਥੇ ਦੇ ਭਾਗ ਨਹੀਂ ਸਨ ਜਾਗੇ, ਤਦ ਤਾਈਂ ਬਹੁਤ ਭਟਕਦੇ ਤੇ ਭੱਜਦੇ ਫਿਰਦੇ ਸਾਂ, "}}},{"verse_id":59592,"page_no":1409,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਕਲਿ ਘੋਰ ਸਮੁਦ੍ਰ ਮੈ ਬੂਡਤ ਥੇ ਕਬਹੂ ਮਿਟਿ ਹੈ ਨਹੀ ਰੇ ਪਛੁਤਾਯਉ ॥","translit_en":"kal ghor samudhr mai booddat the kabahoo miT hai nahee re pachhutaayau ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"I was drowning in the horrible world-ocean of this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, and my remorse would never have ended.","ms":"I was drowning in the terrible ocean of this Darkage and my sorrowing would have ended not ever."},"pu":{"ss":"ਕਲਜੁਗ ਦੇ ਡਰਾਉਣੇ ਸਮੁੰਦਰ ਵਿਚ ਡੁੱਬ ਰਹੇ ਸਾਂ, ਪੱਛੋਤਾਵਾ ਕਿਸੇ ਵੇਲੇ ਮਿਟਦਾ ਨਹੀਂ ਸੀ ।"}}},{"verse_id":59593,"page_no":1409,"line_no":8,"gurmukhi":"ਤਤੁ ਬਿਚਾਰੁ ਯਹੈ ਮਥੁਰਾ ਜਗ ਤਾਰਨ ਕਉ ਅਵਤਾਰੁ ਬਨਾਯਉ ॥","translit_en":"tat bichaar yahai mathuraa jag taaran kau avataar banaayau ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O Mat'huraa, consider this essential truth: to save the world, the Lord incarnated Himself.","ms":"O Mathura, think thou as the quintessence, that to emancipate the World, Lord has incarnated Himself."},"pu":{"ss":"ਪਰ, ਹੇ ਮਥੁਰਾ! ਹੁਣ ਸੱਚੀ ਵਿਚਾਰ ਇਹ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਜਗਤ ਨੂੰ ਤਾਰਨ ਲਈ (ਹਰੀ ਨੇ ਗੁਰੂ ਅਰਜੁਨ) ਅਵਤਾਰ ਬਣਾਇਆ ਹੈ, "}}},{"verse_id":59594,"page_no":1409,"line_no":8,"gurmukhi":"ਜਪੵਉ ਜਿਨੑ ਅਰਜੁਨ ਦੇਵ ਗੁਰੂ ਫਿਰਿ ਸੰਕਟ ਜੋਨਿ ਗਰਭ ਨ ਆਯਉ ॥੬॥","translit_en":"japayeau jin(h) arajun dhev guroo fir sa(n)kaT jon garabh na aayau ||6||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Whoever meditates on Guru Arjun Dayv, shall not have to pass through the painful womb of reincarnation ever again. ||6||","ms":"Whosoever meditates on Guru Arjan Dev, he passes not again through the pain of births and womb."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਗੁਰੂ ਅਰਜੁਨ ਦੇਵ (ਜੀ) ਨੂੰ ਜਪਿਆ ਹੈ, ਉਹ ਪਰਤ ਕੇ ਗਰਭ ਜੂਨ ਤੇ ਦੁੱਖਾਂ ਵਿਚ ਨਹੀਂ ਆਏ ।੬।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5470,"next":5472}}
files.shabads/10/5472.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5472,"source_id":"G","writer_id":42,"raag_id":42,"page_no":1409,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":6,"first_verse_id":59595,"last_verse_id":59600,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhatt Mathuraa","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Svaiyay Mehl 5","raag_unicode":"ਸਵਯੇ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਮੁਖ ਬਾਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੫"},"verses":[{"verse_id":59595,"page_no":1409,"line_no":9,"gurmukhi":"ਕਲਿ ਸਮੁਦ੍ਰ ਭਏ ਰੂਪ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਉਧਾਰਨੁ ॥","translit_en":"kal samudhr bhe roop pragaT har naam udhaaran ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"In the ocean of this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Lord's Name has been revealed in the Form of Guru Arjun, to save the world.","ms":"In the ocean of the Ironage, the Lord's Name has become manifest in the embodiment of the Guru, to ferry across the world."},"pu":{"ss":"ਕਲਜੁਗ ਦੇ ਸਮੁੰਦਰ ਤੋਂ ਤਾਰਨ ਲਈ ਗੁਰੂ ਅਰਜੁਨ ਦੇਵ ਜੀ ਹਰੀ ਦਾ ਨਾਮ-ਰੂਪ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਹੋਏ ਹਨ,"}}},{"verse_id":59596,"page_no":1409,"line_no":10,"gurmukhi":"ਬਸਹਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਿਸੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਦੁਖ ਦਾਰਿਦ੍ਰ ਨਿਵਾਰਨੁ ॥","translit_en":"baseh sa(n)t jis ridhai dhukh dhaaridhr nivaaran ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Pain and poverty are taken away from that person, within whose heart the Saint abides.","ms":"He, within whose mind the Saint abides, his pain and poverty are wiped off,"},"pu":{"ss":"ਆਪ ਦੇ ਹਿਰਦੇ ਵਿਚ ਸੰਤ (ਸ਼ਾਂਤੀ ਦਾ ਸੋਮਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਜੀ) ਵੱਸਦੇ ਹਨ, ਆਪ ਦੁੱਖਾਂ ਦਰਿਦ੍ਰਾਂ ਦੇ ਦੂਰ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲੇ ਹਨ ।"}}},{"verse_id":59597,"page_no":1409,"line_no":10,"gurmukhi":"ਨਿਰਮਲ ਭੇਖ ਅਪਾਰ ਤਾਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥","translit_en":"niramal bhekh apaar taas bin avar na koiee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He is the Pure, Immaculate Form of the Infinite Lord; except for Him, there is no other at all.","ms":"The Guru is the Immaculate form of the Infinite Lord. Without him there is not any other."},"pu":{"ss":"ਉਸ (ਗੁਰੂ ਅਰਜੁਨ) ਤੋਂ ਬਿਨਾ ਕੋਈ ਹੋਰ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ, ਆਪ ਅਪਾਰ ਹਰੀ ਦਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਰੂਪ ਹਨ ।"}}},{"verse_id":59598,"page_no":1409,"line_no":10,"gurmukhi":"ਮਨ ਬਚ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਾਣਿਅਉ ਭਯਉ ਤਿਹ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਸੋਈ ॥","translit_en":"man bach jin jaaniaau bhayau teh samasar soiee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Whoever knows Him in thought, word and deed, becomes just like Him.","ms":"Whosoever through the thought and word knows the Guru, he becomes like him."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਿਸ (ਮਨੁੱਖ) ਨੇ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਬਚਨਾਂ ਕਰਕੇ ਹਰੀ ਨੂੰ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੈ, ਉਹ ਹਰੀ ਵਰਗਾ ਹੀ ਹੋ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":59599,"page_no":1409,"line_no":11,"gurmukhi":"ਧਰਨਿ ਗਗਨ ਨਵ ਖੰਡ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਸ੍ਵਰੂਪੀ ਰਹਿਓ ਭਰਿ ॥","translit_en":"dharan gagan nav kha(n)dd meh jot savairoopee rahio bhar ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He is totally pervading the earth, the sky and the nine regions of the planet. He is the Embodiment of the Light of God.","ms":"He is fully contained in the earth, the sky and the nine regions as the embodiment of the Lord's Light."},"pu":{"ss":"(ਗੁਰੂ ਅਰਜੁਨ ਹੀ) ਜੋਤਿ-ਰੂਪ ਹੋ ਕੇ ਧਰਤੀ ਅਕਾਸ਼ ਤੇ ਨੌ ਖੰਡਾਂ ਵਿਚ ਵਿਆਪ ਰਿਹਾ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":59600,"page_no":1409,"line_no":12,"gurmukhi":"ਭਨਿ ਮਥੁਰਾ ਕਛੁ ਭੇਦੁ ਨਹੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਅਰਜੁਨੁ ਪਰਤਖੵ ਹਰਿ ॥੭॥੧੯॥","translit_en":"bhan mathuraa kachh bhedh nahee gur arajun paratakhaye har ||7||19||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"So speaks Mat'huraa: there is no difference between God and Guru; Guru Arjun is the Personification of the Lord Himself. ||7||19||","ms":"Says Mathura, there is no distinction between the Guru and God. Guru Arjan is manifestly the Lord himself."},"pu":{"ss":" ਹੇ ਮਥੁਰਾ! ਆਖਿ—ਗੁਰੂ ਅਰਜੁਨ ਸਾਖਿਆਤ ਅਕਾਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਹੈ । ਕੋਈ ਫ਼ਰਕ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ ।੭।੧੯।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5471,"next":5473}}
files.shabads/10/5473.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5473,"source_id":"G","writer_id":34,"raag_id":42,"page_no":1409,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":6,"first_verse_id":59601,"last_verse_id":59606,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Bhatt Harbans","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Svaiyay Mehl 5","raag_unicode":"ਸਵਯੇ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਮੁਖ ਬਾਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੫"},"verses":[{"verse_id":59601,"page_no":1409,"line_no":12,"gurmukhi":"ਅਜੈ ਗੰਗ ਜਲੁ ਅਟਲੁ ਸਿਖ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਭ ਨਾਵੈ ॥","translit_en":"ajai ga(n)g jal aTal sikh sa(n)gat sabh naavai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The stream of the Lord's Name flows like the Ganges, invincible and unstoppable. files.shabads/10/5483.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5483,"source_id":"G","writer_id":6,"raag_id":44,"page_no":1426,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":60220,"last_verse_id":60221,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Guru Tegh Bahaadur Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Mehl 9","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੯"},"verses":[{"verse_id":60220,"page_no":1426,"line_no":12,"gurmukhi":"ਤਰਨਾਪੋ ਇਉ ਹੀ ਗਇਓ ਲੀਓ ਜਰਾ ਤਨੁ ਜੀਤਿ ॥","translit_en":"taranaapo iau hee gio leeo jaraa tan jeet ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Your youth has passed away like this, and old age has overtaken your body.","ms":"They youth has passed away in vain and old age has overcome thy body."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਭਾਈ! (ਤੇਰੀ) ਜੁਆਨੀ ਬੇ-ਪਰਵਾਹੀ ਵਿਚ ਹੀ ਲੰਘ ਗਈ, (ਹੁਣ) ਬੁਢੇਪੇ ਨੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਸਰੀਰ ਨੂੰ ਜਿੱਤ ਲਿਆ ਹੈ । "}}},{"verse_id":60221,"page_no":1426,"line_no":12,"gurmukhi":"ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਜੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਾ ਅਉਧ ਜਾਤੁ ਹੈ ਬੀਤਿ ॥੩॥","translit_en":"kahu naanak bhaj har manaa aaudh jaat hai beet ||3||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Says Nanak, meditate, vibrate upon the Lord; your life is fleeting away! ||3||","ms":"Says Nanak, dwell thou on thy God, O man, thy life is fleeting away."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! ਆਖ—ਹੇ ਮਨ! ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਦਾ ਭਜਨ ਕਰਿਆ ਕਰ । ਉਮਰ ਲੰਘਦੀ ਜਾ ਰਹੀ ਹੈ ।੩।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5482,"next":5484}}

files.shabads/10/5485.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5485,"source_id":"G","writer_id":6,"raag_id":44,"page_no":1426,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":60224,"last_verse_id":60225,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Guru Tegh Bahaadur Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Mehl 9","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੯"},"verses":[{"verse_id":60224,"page_no":1426,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਧਨੁ ਦਾਰਾ ਸੰਪਤਿ ਸਗਲ ਜਿਨਿ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਿ ॥","translit_en":"dhan dhaaraa sa(n)pat sagal jin apunee kar maan ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Your wealth, spouse, and all the possessions which you claim as your own","ms":"Wealth, wife and all other property, which thou deem thy own;"},"pu":{"ss":"(ਆਖ—ਹੇ ਭਾਈ!) ਧਨ, ਇਸਤ੍ਰੀ, ਸਾਰੀ ਜਾਇਦਾਦ—(ਇਸ ਨੂੰ) ਆਪਣੀ ਕਰ ਕੇ ਨਾਹ ਮੰਨ ।"}}},{"verse_id":60225,"page_no":1426,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਇਨ ਮੈ ਕਛੁ ਸੰਗੀ ਨਹੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚੀ ਜਾਨਿ ॥੫॥","translit_en":"ein mai kachh sa(n)gee nahee naanak saachee jaan ||5||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"- none of these shall go along with you in the end. files.shabads/10/5486.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5486,"source_id":"G","writer_id":6,"raag_id":44,"page_no":1426,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":60226,"last_verse_id":60227,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Guru Tegh Bahaadur Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Mehl 9","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੯"},"verses":[{"verse_id":60226,"page_no":1426,"line_no":15,"gurmukhi":"ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਨ ਭੈ ਹਰਨ ਹਰਿ ਅਨਾਥ ਕੇ ਨਾਥ ॥","translit_en":"patit udhaaran bhai haran har anaath ke naath ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He is the Saving Grace of sinners, the Destroyer of fear, the Master of the masterless.","ms":"God is the Saviour of sinners, the Destroyer of fear and the Master of the masterless."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਭਾਈ! ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਜੀ ਵਿਕਾਰੀਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਵਿਕਾਰਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਬਚਾਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਹਨ, ਸਾਰੇ ਡਰ ਦੂਰ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲੇ ਹਨ, ਅਤੇ ਨਿਖਸਮਿਆਂ ਦੇ ਖਸਮ ਹਨ ।"}}},{"verse_id":60227,"page_no":1426,"line_no":15,"gurmukhi":"ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਹ ਜਾਨੀਐ ਸਦਾ ਬਸਤੁ ਤੁਮ ਸਾਥਿ ॥੬॥","translit_en":"kahu naanak teh jaaneeaai sadhaa basat tum saath ||6||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Says Nanak, realize and know Him, who is always with you. ||6||","ms":"Says Nanak, realise thou Him, who abides ever with thee."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! ਆਖ—(ਹੇ ਭਾਈ!) ਉਸ (ਪ੍ਰਭੂ) ਨੂੰ (ਇਉਂ) ਸਮਝਣਾ ਚਾਹੀਦਾ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਉਹ ਸਦਾ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਲ ਵੱਸਦਾ ਹੈ ।੬।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5485,"next":5487}}
files.shabads/10/5487.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5487,"source_id":"G","writer_id":6,"raag_id":44,"page_no":1426,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":60228,"last_verse_id":60229,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Guru Tegh Bahaadur Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Mehl 9","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੯"},"verses":[{"verse_id":60228,"page_no":1426,"line_no":16,"gurmukhi":"ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਜਿਹ ਤੋ ਕਉ ਦੀਓ ਤਾਂ ਸਿਉ ਨੇਹੁ ਨ ਕੀਨ ॥","translit_en":"tan dhan jeh to kau dheeo taa(n) siau neh na keen ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He has given you your body and wealth, but you are not in love with Him.","ms":"Thou enshrine not affection for Him, for has given thee human body and riches."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਝੱਲੇ ਮਨੁੱਖ! ਜਿਸ (ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ) ਨੇ ਤੈਨੂੰ ਸਰੀਰ ਦਿੱਤਾ, ਧਨ ਦਿੱਤਾ, ਤੂੰ ਉਸ ਨਾਲ ਪਿਆਰ ਨਾਹ ਪਾਇਆ । "}}},{"verse_id":60229,"page_no":1426,"line_no":16,"gurmukhi":"ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਰ ਬਾਵਰੇ ਅਬ ਕਿਉ ਡੋਲਤ ਦੀਨ ॥੭॥","translit_en":"kahu naanak nar baavare ab kiau ddolat dheen ||7||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Says Nanak, you are insane! files.shabads/10/5488.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5488,"source_id":"G","writer_id":6,"raag_id":44,"page_no":1426,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":60230,"last_verse_id":60231,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Guru Tegh Bahaadur Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Mehl 9","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੯"},"verses":[{"verse_id":60230,"page_no":1426,"line_no":17,"gurmukhi":"ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਪੈ ਸੁਖ ਦੀਓ ਅਰੁ ਜਿਹ ਨੀਕੇ ਧਾਮ ॥","translit_en":"tan dhan sa(n)pai sukh dheeo ar jeh neeke dhaam ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He has given you your body, wealth, property, peace and beautiful mansions.","ms":"He, who has blessed thee with body, wealth, property happiness and beauteous mansions."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਿਸ (ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ) ਨੇ ਸਰੀਰ ਦਿੱਤਾ, ਧਨ ਦਿੱਤਾ, ਜਾਇਦਾਦ ਦਿੱਤੀ, ਸੁਖ ਦਿੱਤੇ ਅਤੇ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਘਰ ਦਿੱਤੇ,"}}},{"verse_id":60231,"page_no":1426,"line_no":17,"gurmukhi":"ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਨੁ ਰੇ ਮਨਾ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਕਾਹਿ ਨ ਰਾਮੁ ॥੮॥","translit_en":"kahu naanak sun re manaa simarat kaeh na raam ||8||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Says Nanak, listen, mind: why don't you remember the Lord in meditation? ||8||","ms":"Says Nanak, hear thou, O my soul, why contemplate not thou thy Lord?"},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! ਆਖ—ਹੇ ਮਨ! ਸੁਣ, ਉਸ ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਦਾ ਤੂੰ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਕਿਉਂ ਨਹੀਂ ਕਰਦਾ? ।੮।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5487,"next":5489}}
files.shabads/10/5489.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5489,"source_id":"G","writer_id":6,"raag_id":44,"page_no":1426,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":60232,"last_verse_id":60233,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Guru Tegh Bahaadur Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Mehl 9","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੯"},"verses":[{"verse_id":60232,"page_no":1426,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਸਭ ਸੁਖ ਦਾਤਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਸਰ ਨਾਹਿਨ ਕੋਇ ॥","translit_en":"sabh sukh dhaataa raam hai dhoosar naahin koi ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Lord is the Giver of all peace and comfort. Without there is not another."},"pu":{"ss":"ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ (ਹੀ) ਸਾਰੇ ਸੁਖ ਦੇਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਹੈ, (ਉਸ ਦੇ ਬਰਾਬਰ ਦਾ ਹੋਰ) ਕੋਈ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ,"}}},{"verse_id":60233,"page_no":1426,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਨਿ ਰੇ ਮਨਾ ਤਿਹ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੯॥","translit_en":"kahu naanak sun re manaa teh simarat gat hoi ||9||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Says Nanak, listen, mind: meditating in remembrance on Him, salvation is attained. ||9||","ms":"Says Nanak, hearken thou, O my soul, meditating on Him, salvation is obtained."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! ਆਖ—ਹੇ ਮਨ! ਉਸ (ਦਾ ਨਾਮ) ਸਿਮਰਦਿਆਂ ਉੱਚੀ ਆਤਮਕ ਅਵਸਥਾ (ਭੀ) ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤ ਹੋ ਜਾਂਦੀ ਹੈ ।੯।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5488,"next":5490}}
files.shabads/10/5490.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5490,"source_id":"G","writer_id":6,"raag_id":44,"page_no":1427,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":60234,"last_verse_id":60235,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Guru Tegh Bahaadur Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Mehl 9","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੯"},"verses":[{"verse_id":60234,"page_no":1427,"line_no":1,"gurmukhi":"ਜਿਹ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਤਿਹ ਭਜੁ ਰੇ ਤੈ ਮੀਤ ॥","translit_en":"jeh simarat gat paieeaai teh bhaj re tai meet ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Remembering Him in meditation, salvation is attained; vibrate and meditate on Him, O my friend.","ms":"Remember thou Him, O my friend, by contemplating whom one is emancipated."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਮਿੱਤਰ! ਤੂੰ ਉਸ ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਦਾ ਭਜਨ ਕਰਿਆ ਕਰ, ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਮਰਦਿਆਂ ਉੱਚੀ ਆਤਮਕ ਅਵਸਥਾ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤ ਹੁੰਦੀ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":60235,"page_no":1427,"line_no":1,"gurmukhi":"ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਨੁ ਰੇ ਮਨਾ ਅਉਧ ਘਟਤ ਹੈ ਨੀਤ ॥੧੦॥","translit_en":"kahu naanak sun re manaa aaudh ghaTat hai neet ||10||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Says Nanak, listen, mind: your life is passing away! ||10||","ms":"Says Nanak, hearken, O mortal, thy age is diminishing ever."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! ਆਖ—ਹੇ ਮਨ! ਸੁਣ, ਉਮਰ ਸਦਾ ਘਟਦੀ ਜਾ ਰਹੀ ਹੈ (ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਦਾ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਨਾਹ ਵਿਸਾਰ) ।੧੦।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5489,"next":5491}}
files.shabads/10/5491.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5491,"source_id":"G","writer_id":6,"raag_id":44,"page_no":1427,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":60236,"last_verse_id":60237,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Guru Tegh Bahaadur Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Mehl 9","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੯"},"verses":[{"verse_id":60236,"page_no":1427,"line_no":2,"gurmukhi":"ਪਾਂਚ ਤਤ ਕੋ ਤਨੁ ਰਚਿਓ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਚਤੁਰ ਸੁਜਾਨ ॥","translit_en":"paa(n)ch tat ko tan rachio jaanahu chatur sujaan ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Your body is made up of the five elements; you are clever and wise - know this well.","ms":"O Clever and wise man, know that thy body is make up of five elements."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਚਤੁਰ ਮਨੁੱਖ! ਹੇ ਸਿਆਣੇ ਮਨੁੱਖ! ਤੂੰ ਜਾਣਦਾ ਹੈਂ ਕਿ (ਤੇਰਾ ਇਹ) ਸਰੀਰ (ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਨੇ) ਪੰਜ ਤੱਤਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਬਣਾਇਆ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":60237,"page_no":1427,"line_no":2,"gurmukhi":"ਜਿਹ ਤੇ ਉਪਜਿਓ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਲੀਨ ਤਾਹਿ ਮੈ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੧੧॥","translit_en":"jeh te upajio naanakaa leen taeh mai maan ||11||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Believe it - you shall merge once again into the One, O Nanak, from whom you originated. ||11||","ms":"Be thou sure, O Nanak, that thou shall blend with Him, from whom thou have sprung."},"pu":{"ss":"(ਇਹ ਭੀ) ਯਕੀਨ ਜਾਣ ਕਿ ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਤੱਤਾਂ ਤੋਂ (ਇਹ ਸਰੀਰ) ਬਣਿਆ ਹੈ (ਮੁੜ) ਉਹਨਾਂ ਵਿਚ ਹੀ ਲੀਨ ਹੋ ਜਾਇਗਾ (ਫਿਰ ਇਸ ਸਰੀਰ ਦੇ ਝੂਠੇ ਮੋਹ ਵਿਚ ਫਸ ਕੇ ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਦਾ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਕਿਉਂ ਭੁਲਾ ਰਿਹਾ ਹੈਂ? ।੧੧।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5490,"next":5492}}
files.shabads/10/5492.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5492,"source_id":"G","writer_id":6,"raag_id":44,"page_no":1427,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":60238,"last_verse_id":60239,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Guru Tegh Bahaadur Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Mehl 9","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੯"},"verses":[{"verse_id":60238,"page_no":1427,"line_no":3,"gurmukhi":"ਘਟ ਘਟ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਜੂ ਬਸੈ ਸੰਤਨ ਕਹਿਓ ਪੁਕਾਰਿ ॥","translit_en":"ghaT ghaT mai har joo basai sa(n)tan kahio pukaar ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Dear Lord abides in each and every heart; the Saints proclaim this as true.","ms":"The saints proclaim that the Venerable Lord abides in all hearts."},"pu":{"ss":"ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾਂ ਨੇ ਉੱਚੀ ਕੂਕ ਕੇ ਦੱਸ ਦਿੱਤਾ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਹਰੇਕ ਸਰੀਰ ਵਿਚ ਵੱਸ ਰਿਹਾ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":60239,"page_no":1427,"line_no":3,"gurmukhi":"ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਹ ਭਜੁ ਮਨਾ ਭਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਉਤਰਹਿ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੧੨॥","translit_en":"kahu naanak teh bhaj manaa bhau nidh utareh paar ||12||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Says Nanak, meditate and vibrate upon Him, and you shall cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||12||","ms":"Says Nanak, contemplate thou Him, O my soul, that thou may cross the terrible world ocean."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! ਆਖ—ਹੇ ਮਨ! ਤੂੰ ਉਸ (ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ) ਦਾ ਭਜਨ ਕਰਿਆ ਕਰ, (ਭਜਨ ਦੀ ਬਰਕਤਿ ਨਾਲ) ਸੰਸਾਰ-ਸਮੁੰਦਰ ਤੋਂ ਤੂੰ ਪਾਰ ਲੰਘ ਜਾਹਿਂਗਾ ।੧੨।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5491,"next":5493}}
files.shabads/10/5493.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5493,"source_id":"G","writer_id":6,"raag_id":44,"page_no":1427,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":60240,"last_verse_id":60241,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Guru Tegh Bahaadur Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Mehl 9","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੯"},"verses":[{"verse_id":60240,"page_no":1427,"line_no":4,"gurmukhi":"ਸੁਖੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਿਹ ਪਰਸੈ ਨਹੀ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥","translit_en":"sukh dhukh jeh parasai nahee lobh moh abhimaan ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"One who is not touched by pleasure or pain, greed, emotional attachment and egotistical pride","ms":"Whomsoever touch not pleasure, pain, avarice, worldly love and self-conceit."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਿਸ ਮਨੁੱਖ (ਦੇ ਹਿਰਦੇ) ਨੂੰ ਸੁਖ ਦੁਖ ਨਹੀਂ ਪੋਹ ਸਕਦਾ, ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਅਹੰਕਾਰ ਨਹੀਂ ਪੋਹ ਸਕਦਾ (ਭਾਵ, ਜਿਹੜਾ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਸੁਖ ਦੁਖ ਵੇਲੇ ਆਤਮਕ ਜੀਵਨ ਵਲੋਂ ਨਹੀਂ ਡੋਲਦਾ, ਜਿਸ ਉਤੇ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਅਹੰਕਾਰ ਆਪਣਾ ਜ਼ੋਰ ਨਹੀਂ ਪਾ ਸਕਦਾ) "}}},{"verse_id":60241,"page_no":1427,"line_no":4,"gurmukhi":"ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਨੁ ਰੇ ਮਨਾ ਸੋ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥੧੩॥","translit_en":"kahu naanak sun re manaa so moorat bhagavaan ||13||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"- says Nanak, listen, mind: he is the very image of God. ||13||","ms":"Says Nanak, hearken, O man, He is the very image of the Lord."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! ਆਖ—ਹੇ ਮਨ! ਉਹ ਮਨੁੱਖ (ਸਾਖਿਆਤ) ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਦਾ ਰੂਪ ਹੈ ।੧੩।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5492,"next":5494}}
files.shabads/10/5494.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5494,"source_id":"G","writer_id":6,"raag_id":44,"page_no":1427,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":60242,"last_verse_id":60243,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Guru Tegh Bahaadur Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Mehl 9","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੯"},"verses":[{"verse_id":60242,"page_no":1427,"line_no":5,"gurmukhi":"ਉਸਤਤਿ ਨਿੰਦਿਆ ਨਾਹਿ ਜਿਹਿ ਕੰਚਨ ਲੋਹ ਸਮਾਨਿ ॥","translit_en":"ausatat ni(n)dhiaa naeh jeh ka(n)chan loh samaan ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"One who is beyond praise and slander, who looks upon gold and iron alike","ms":"He who is above praise and dispraise and, to whom gold and iron are alike;"},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਿਸ ਮਨੁੱਖ (ਦੇ ਮਨ) ਨੂੰ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਨਹੀਂ (ਡੁਲਾ ਸਕਦੀ) ਨਿੰਦਿਆ ਨਹੀਂ (ਡੁਲਾ ਸਕਦੀ), ਜਿਸ ਨੂੰ ਸੋਨਾ ਅਤੇ ਲੋਹਾ ਇਕੋ ਜਿਹੇ (ਦਿੱਸਦੇ ਹਨ, ਭਾਵ, ਜੋ ਲਾਲਚ ਵਿਚ ਨਹੀਂ ਫਸਦਾ),"}}},{"verse_id":60243,"page_no":1427,"line_no":5,"gurmukhi":"ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਨਿ ਰੇ ਮਨਾ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਤਾਹਿ ਤੈ ਜਾਨਿ ॥੧੪॥","translit_en":"kahu naanak sun re manaa mukat taeh tai jaan ||14||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"- says Nanak, listen, mind: know that such a person is liberated. ||14||","ms":"Says Nanak, hearken thou, O man, deem thou him to be emancipated."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! ਆਖ—ਹੇ ਮਨ! ਸੁਣ, ਇਹ ਗੱਲ (ਪੱਕ) ਜਾਣ ਕਿ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਮੋਹ ਤੋਂ ਛੁਟਕਾਰਾ ਮਿਲ ਚੁੱਕਾ ਹੈ ।੧੪।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5493,"next":5495}}
files.shabads/10/5495.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5495,"source_id":"G","writer_id":6,"raag_id":44,"page_no":1427,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":60244,"last_verse_id":60245,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Guru Tegh Bahaadur Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Mehl 9","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੯"},"verses":[{"verse_id":60244,"page_no":1427,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਹਰਖੁ ਸੋਗੁ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਨਹੀ ਬੈਰੀ ਮੀਤ ਸਮਾਨਿ ॥","translit_en":"harakh sog jaa kai nahee bairee meet samaan ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"One who is not affected by pleasure or pain, who looks upon friend and enemy alike","ms":"He, who is affected not by pleasure or pain and to whom friend and foe are a like."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਿਸ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਦੇ ਹਿਰਦੇ ਵਿਚ ਖ਼ੁਸ਼ੀ ਗ਼ਮੀ ਆਪਣਾ ਜ਼ੋਰ ਨਹੀਂ ਪਾ ਸਕਦੀ, ਜਿਸ ਨੂੰ ਵੈਰੀ ਤੇ ਮਿੱਤਰ ਇਕੋ ਜਿਹੇ (ਮਿੱਤਰ ਹੀ) ਜਾਪਦੇ ਹਨ, "}}},{"verse_id":60245,"page_no":1427,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਨਿ ਰੇ ਮਨਾ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਤਾਹਿ ਤੈ ਜਾਨਿ ॥੧੫॥","translit_en":"kahu naanak sun re manaa mukat taeh tai jaan ||15||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"- says Nanak, listen, mind: know that such a person is liberated. ||15||","ms":"Says Nanak, hearken thou, O my soul, deem thou him to be emancipated."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! ਆਖ—ਹੇ ਮਨ! ਸੁਣ, ਤੂੰ ਇਹ ਗੱਲ ਪੱਕੀ ਸਮਝ ਕਿ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਮਾਇਆ ਦੇ ਮੋਹ ਤੋਂ ਖ਼ਲਾਸੀ ਮਿਲ ਚੁੱਕੀ ਹੈ ।੧੫।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5494,"next":5496}}
files.shabads/10/5496.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5496,"source_id":"G","writer_id":6,"raag_id":44,"page_no":1427,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":60246,"last_verse_id":60247,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Guru Tegh Bahaadur Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Mehl 9","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੯"},"verses":[{"verse_id":60246,"page_no":1427,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਭੈ ਕਾਹੂ ਕਉ ਦੇਤ ਨਹਿ ਨਹਿ ਭੈ ਮਾਨਤ ਆਨ ॥","translit_en":"bhai kaahoo kau dhet neh neh bhai maanat aan ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"One who does not frighten anyone, and who is not afraid of anyone else","ms":"Whosoever frightens none nor is afraid of anyone."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਿਹੜਾ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਕਿਸੇ ਨੂੰ (ਕੋਈ) ਡਰਾਵੇ ਨਹੀਂ ਦੇਂਦਾ, ਅਤੇ ਕਿਸੇ ਦੇ ਡਰਾਵੇ ਨਹੀਂ ਮੰਨਦਾ (ਡਰਾਵਿਆਂ ਤੋਂ ਘਬਰਾਂਦਾ ਨਹੀਂ)"}}},{"verse_id":60247,"page_no":1427,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਨਿ ਰੇ ਮਨਾ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਤਾਹਿ ਬਖਾਨਿ ॥੧੬॥","translit_en":"kahu naanak sun re manaa giaanee taeh bakhaan ||16||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"- says Nanak, listen, mind: call him spiritually wise. ||16||","ms":"Says Nanak, her thou, O my soul, call thou him, a men of Divine knowledge."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! ਆਖ—ਹੇ ਮਨ! ਸੁਣ, ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਆਤਮਕ ਜੀਵਨ ਦੀ ਸੂਝ ਵਾਲਾ ਸਮਝ ।੧੬।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5495,"next":5497}}
files.shabads/10/5497.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5497,"source_id":"G","writer_id":6,"raag_id":44,"page_no":1427,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":60248,"last_verse_id":60249,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Guru Tegh Bahaadur Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Mehl 9","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੯"},"verses":[{"verse_id":60248,"page_no":1427,"line_no":8,"gurmukhi":"ਜਿਹਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਸਗਲੀ ਤਜੀ ਲੀਓ ਭੇਖ ਬੈਰਾਗ ॥","translit_en":"jeh bikhiaa sagalee tajee leeo bhekh bairaag ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"One who has forsaken all sin and corruption, who wears the robes of neutral detachment","ms":"He, who has abandoned all sins and has donned the garb of detachedness."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਿਸ (ਮਨੁੱਖ) ਨੇ (ਕਾਮ, ਕੋ੍ਰਧ, ਲੋਭ, ਮੋਹ, ਅਹੰਕਾਰ, ਨਿੰਦਾ, ਈਰਖਾ, ਆਦਿਕ ਅਨੇਕਾਂ ਰੂਪਾਂ ਵਾਲੀ) ਸਾਰੀ ਦੀ ਸਾਰੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਤਿਆਗ ਦਿੱਤੀ, (ਉਸੇ ਨੇ ਹੀ ਸਹੀ) ਵੈਰਾਗ ਦਾ (ਸਹੀ) ਭੇਖ ਧਾਰਨ ਕੀਤਾ (ਸਮਝ) ।"}}},{"verse_id":60249,"page_no":1427,"line_no":8,"gurmukhi":"ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਨੁ ਰੇ ਮਨਾ ਤਿਹ ਨਰ ਮਾਥੈ ਭਾਗੁ ॥੧੭॥","translit_en":"kahu naanak sun re manaa teh nar maathai bhaag ||17||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"- says Nanak, listen, mind: good destiny is written on his forehead. ||17||","ms":"Says Nanak, hear thou, O my soul, good destiny is writ on that man's brow."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! ਆਖ—ਹੇ ਮਨ! ਸੁਣ, ਉਸ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਦੇ ਮੱਥੇ ਉਤੇ (ਚੰਗਾ) ਭਾਗ (ਜਾਗਿਆ ਸਮਝ) ।੧੭।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5496,"next":5498}}
files.shabads/10/5498.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5498,"source_id":"G","writer_id":6,"raag_id":44,"page_no":1427,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":60250,"last_verse_id":60251,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Guru Tegh Bahaadur Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Mehl 9","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੯"},"verses":[{"verse_id":60250,"page_no":1427,"line_no":9,"gurmukhi":"ਜਿਹਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਮਤਾ ਤਜੀ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਭਇਓ ਉਦਾਸੁ ॥","translit_en":"jeh maiaa mamataa tajee sabh te bhio udhaas ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"One who renounces Maya and possessiveness and is detached from everything","ms":"He who abandons wealth and worldly love and is detached from everything."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਿਸ (ਮਨੁੱਖ) ਨੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਦਾ ਮੋਹ ਛੱਡ ਦਿੱਤਾ, (ਜਿਹੜਾ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਮਾਇਆ ਦੇ ਕਾਮਾਦਿਕ) ਸਾਰੇ ਵਿਕਾਰਾਂ ਵਲੋਂ ਉਪਰਾਮ ਹੋ ਗਿਆ,"}}},{"verse_id":60251,"page_no":1427,"line_no":9,"gurmukhi":"ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਨੁ ਰੇ ਮਨਾ ਤਿਹ ਘਟਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥੧੮॥","translit_en":"kahu naanak sun re manaa teh ghaT braham nivaas ||18||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"- says Nanak, listen, mind: God abides in his heart. ||18||","ms":"Says Nanak, hearken, thou, O man, within his mind, abides the Lord."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! ਆਖ—ਹੇ ਮਨ! ਸੁਣ, ਉਸ ਦੇ ਹਿਰਦੇ ਵਿਚ (ਪਰਤੱਖ ਤੌਰ ਤੇ) ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਦਾ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਹੋ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ ।੧੮।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5497,"next":5499}}
files.shabads/10/5499.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":5499,"source_id":"G","writer_id":6,"raag_id":44,"page_no":1427,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":60252,"last_verse_id":60253,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":"Guru Tegh Bahaadur Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Salok Mehl 9","raag_unicode":"ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੯"},"verses":[{"verse_id":60252,"page_no":1427,"line_no":10,"gurmukhi":"ਜਿਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਤਜੀ ਕਰਤਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਨਿ ॥","translit_en":"jeh praanee haumai tajee karataa raam pachhaan ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"That mortal, who forsakes egotism, and realizes the Creator Lord","ms":"The mortal, who forsakes ego and realises his Creator-Lord."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਿਸ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਨੇ ਕਰਤਾਰ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰ ਨਾਲ ਡੂੰਘੀ ਸਾਂਝ ਪਾ ਕੇ (ਆਪਣੇ ਅੰਦਰੋਂ) ਹਉਮੈ ਤਿਆਗ ਦਿੱਤੀ, "}}},{"verse_id":60253,"page_no":1427,"line_no":10,"gurmukhi":"ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਵਹੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨਰੁ ਇਹ ਮਨ ਸਾਚੀ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੧੯॥","translit_en":"kahu naanak vahu mukat nar ieh man saachee maan ||19||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"- says Nanak, that person is liberated; O mind, know this as true. ||19||","ms":"Says Nanak, emancipated is that man. Deem thou this as true, O my soul."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! ਆਖ—ਹੇ ਮਨ! ਇਹ ਗੱਲ ਸੱਚੀ ਸਮਝ ਕਿ ਉਹ ਮਨੁੱਖ (ਹੀ) ਮੁਕਤ ਹੈ ।੧੯।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":5498,"next":5500}}
